Method: 在决策Transformer中增加TTT层，构建Decision Titan模型，用于离线强化学习；在X-Maze（T-Maze的扩展，用于测试序列记忆）环境中评估性能，并通过可视化门控值随时间的变化来探究记忆机制的学习过程。

Result: Decision Titan能学习比上下文窗口长20倍范围的长时依赖，泛化到训练数据长度1.7倍的序列；但时间泛化依赖于所用的时间嵌入，长时依赖学习能力依赖于相关信息编码方式。

Conclusion: TTT框架可有效增强离线强化学习中的长时记忆，但时间嵌入和编码方式对泛化与长时依赖学习起关键作用。

Abstract: Long-term dependencies remain a major challenge for sequential decision-making in the field of AI: RNNs suffer from vanishing gradients and the limited expressivity of vector-based hidden states, whilst Transformer-based models are limited by the quadratic scaling of attention. Recent work has proposed tackling this problem with the Test-Time Training (TTT) framework, which stores episodic memories in the parameters of a neural network through gradient descent at both train and test-time. This approach has seen success in the domain of Natural Language Processing, however, to the best of our knowledge it has not yet been applied to the domain of Reinforcement Learning (RL), nor has there been a study analysing how this memory practically functions. In this paper, we study the potential of the TTT framework for offline RL by augmenting a Decision Transformer with TTT layers, dubbed the Decision Titan. We analyse performance and properties of the model in the X-Maze environment, an extension of T-Maze designed to test sequential memory, and investigate how the memory mechanism learns by visualising gate values over time. Our key findings are that Decision Titan can learn long-term dependencies with ranges 20x longer than the context window, generalises to lengths 1.7x the training data, but crucially temporal generalisation depends on the time embeddings used, and the ability to learn long-term dependencies depends on how the relevant information is encoded.

</details>


### [103] [AnyJev Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00831)
*Jiamu Zhang,Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Evan Chen,Zixiang Nie,Kelly Wan,Liangjie Hong,Ninghao Liu,Liang Wu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: AnyJev 无需训练即可从预训练指令微调语言模型的单次前向读取中获取类型化决策，并修正标签先验与选项位置偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类型化决策系统需专门训练模型，成本高；希望直接利用预训练指令微调语言模型读取概率化选项决策。

Method: 在答案位置将下一词分布限制到选项 token；除以无标签输入估计的标签先验；对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转平均对数概率；并用无标签状态上的停止规则减少所需 prefill 次数。

Result: 两个 20 选项任务上，旋转将顺序翻转率从 0.33 降至 0.14 和 0.18，并在 11/11 模型上提升准确率；停止规则在部分单元格以 10.6/18 次旋转达到 0.008 验证界，服务运行中为 7.3 次旋转，vLLM 上每秒决策数提升 2.2 倍。

Conclusion: AnyJev 证明无需梯度更新或参数修改即可从预训练指令微调语言模型可靠读取类型化决策，并通过旋转平均与停止规则显著改善偏差、准确率和推理效率。

Abstract: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

</details>


### [104] [Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00858)
*Saram Abbas,David Thomas,Naeem Soomro,Rishad Shafik,Rakesh Heer,Kabita Adhikari*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本研究开发反事实方向测试和单调约束框架，检测并修正XGBoost模型在癌症复发预测中的方向反转问题，且不损失性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床期望癌症严重程度越高复发风险越大，但无约束XGBoost模型却学习到相反关系，而传统判别、校准和SHAP均无法察觉此反转。

Method: 基于BOXIT试验472例患者数据，开发反事实方向测试（逐个恶化定向特征检查风险是否下降）和单调约束修正（约束方向来自EORTC和EAU风险系统），在50折交叉验证中与无约束XGBoost和逻辑回归比较。

Result: 无约束模型在90.2%的癌原位和74.3%的肿瘤分期反事实中反转方向；判别（ΔAUC 0.005, p=0.47）、校准和SHAP幅度均未察觉。单调约束消除所有违规，判别性能无损失（0.723 vs 0.718），且优于EORTC（p=8.9e-16）。

Conclusion: 学习到方向反转的模型能通过所有常规检查；反事实方向测试配合预指定单调约束的单次重拟合可无性能损失地捕获此失败，应作为临床部署前的常规步骤。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($Δ$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [105] [FedLore: Communication and Memory Efficient Federated Learning via Shared Gradient Low-Rank Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01620)
*Junkang Liu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出FedLore，通过每轮共享低秩优化基并跨轮刷新，解决子空间碎片化问题，实现低秩坐标下的精确聚合，并允许累积更新超出单轮秩预算，在联邦预训练中优于低秩适配器基线，通信与优化器状态内存更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦训练基础模型受限于客户端内存与通信成本；LoRA类方法虽降低开销但固定秩预算限制适配，梯度低秩优化虽灵活但独立选择的客户端子空间导致子空间碎片化：局部投影与数据异质性交互使聚合方向产生偏差，且聚合会增大更新秩与通信成本，因此精确的局部梯度压缩未必保持全局下降。

Method: FedLore在每轮内共享一个低秩优化基并跨轮刷新该基；共享基使得在低秩坐标下可精确聚合，消除投影偏差；子空间刷新使累积模型更新可超过每轮秩预算。作者刻画聚合偏差，并在全局梯度覆盖条件、标准光滑性与方差假设及有界梯度异质性下，为投影SGD变体建立O(T^{-1/2})的平稳性界。

Result: 在视觉与语言任务（包括联邦预训练）上，FedLore优于所评估的低秩适配器基线，并达到或超过全参数训练，同时降低通信与优化器状态内存。

Conclusion: 共享低秩优化基并跨轮刷新可有效消除子空间碎片化带来的聚合偏差，在低通信与低内存约束下实现优于低秩适配器甚至全参数训练的联邦基础模型训练性能。

Abstract: Federated training of foundation models is constrained by client memory and communication costs. LoRA-based methods reduce these costs through low-rank adapters, but their fixed rank budget can limit adaptation. Gradient low-rank optimization offers greater flexibility, yet independently chosen client subspaces create a problem we term \emph{subspace fragmentation}: local projections interact with data heterogeneity to bias aggregated directions, while aggregation can increase update rank and communication cost. Thus, accurate local gradient compression need not preserve global descent. We propose \texttt{FedLore}, which shares a low-rank optimization basis within each round and refreshes it across rounds. The shared basis enables exact aggregation in low-rank coordinates and eliminates the identified projection bias. Subspace refresh allows the accumulated model update to exceed the per-round rank budget. We characterize the aggregation bias and establish an $O(T^{-1/2})$ stationarity bound for the projected-SGD variant under a global-gradient coverage condition and standard smoothness and variance assumptions, with bounded gradient heterogeneity. Experiments on vision and language tasks, including federated pre-training, show that \texttt{FedLore} outperforms the evaluated low-rank adapter baselines and matches or exceeds full-parameter training, while reducing communication and optimizer-state memory.

</details>


### [106] [Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00873)
*Hongyu Cao,Xinyuan Wang,Arun Vignesh Malarkkan,Kunpeng Liu,Haifeng Chen,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该文将数据稀缺且不平衡、协变量偏移、验证集与测试环境不一致等问题统一为AWL-CS问题，并提出IGDPR框架，通过不变势引导扩散生成与原型重加权实现稳定合成与适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业应用中表格数据稀缺且不平衡，训练与部署分布存在协变量偏移，验证集常与未见测试环境不一致，标准生成模型仅模仿过时源分布，导致增强与适应流程不稳定。

Method: 提出IGDPR（Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting）统一框架：1）用不变势引导扩散采样，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性；2）基于原型的重加权策略，通过结构簇而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声。

Result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，该方法通过增强对稳健学习最有益的数据，提升了数据质量。

Conclusion: IGDPR能同时解决生成指导偏差与分布密度重加权不稳定问题，为协变量偏移下的增强与加权学习提供有效方案。

Abstract: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

</details>


### [107] [Measuring the Stability Assumption Behind Action Chunking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01626)
*Aryan Goyal*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文通过注入动作误差并测量其在开环与闭环执行下的传播速率，重新审视动作分块（action chunking）提升行为克隆性能的机制，发现误差放大普遍存在，且闭环重规划难以可靠收缩误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有解释（如时间一致性、缩短决策时域、表征学习、减少误差累积）无法完整说明动作分块为何有效；作者转而研究动作误差进入系统后的传播动力学。

Method: 在十二个操作任务（来自三个基准套件）中，于每个状态注入小动作误差，分别在开环（不重规划地回放剩余分块）和闭环（扰动后策略重规划）两种执行模式下测量误差增长或收缩速率，并将状态标记为收缩、扩张或未解析；同时考察拟合时域的影响，并训练预测器从相机帧和本体感觉推断传播标签。

Result:  confidently stable状态罕见，而误差放大在可解析传播速率的状态中普遍存在；传播速率强烈依赖拟合时域，放大通常前载，短窗口会高估长时域传播；开环传播可从视觉与本体感觉恢复，闭环传播仅部分可恢复，因其还依赖扰动后策略行为。

Conclusion: 误差累积论不足以完整解释动作分块：被动开环动力学与策略重规划均不能一致地收缩注入误差，重规划也很少将开环放大转为稳定收缩；因此闭环反应性应通过扰动与树覆盖导向的训练显式习得，而非期望其从标准模仿学习中可靠涌现。

Abstract: Action chunking improves the performance of policies learned by behavioural cloning, and several mechanisms have been proposed to explain why, including temporal consistency, horizon reduction, representation learning, and reduced error compounding. We instead study what happens to an action error once it enters the system. At each state, we inject a small action error and measure how fast it grows or shrinks under two execution regimes: open-loop, where the rest of the chunk is replayed without replanning, and closed-loop, where the policy replans after the perturbation. The fitted rate labels each state as contracting, expanding, or unresolved. Across twelve manipulation tasks from three benchmark suites, we find that confidently stable states are rare, while error amplification is common among states whose propagation rate can be resolved. We further find that the measured propagation rate depends strongly on the fitting horizon: amplification is typically front-loaded, so short windows can overestimate longer-horizon propagation. Finally, we train predictors on these labels and find that a state's open-loop regime can be recovered from camera frames and proprioception alone, while its closed-loop propagation is only partially recoverable because it also depends on how the policy acts after the perturbation. These results suggest that error-compounding arguments alone do not provide a complete account of action chunking: neither passive open-loop dynamics nor policy replanning consistently contracts an injected error, and replanning rarely turns open-loop amplification into confident contraction. This suggests that closed-loop reactivity should be trained explicitly, using perturbation- and tree-coverage-oriented training to expose policies to deviations they must recover from, rather than expected to emerge reliably from standard imitation learning.

</details>


### [108] [Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00888)
*Prachi Badarayani,Aidan Jay,Chenghui Zhou,Dayquan Julienne,Yuan Gao,Tianwei Chen,George Zerveas,Ishmam Zabir,Xiren Zhou,Chris Quirk,Xia Song*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文研究在冻结的推理模型上，通过轻量级后训练多令牌预测（MTP）头来达到与联合预训练相当的吞吐量加速，并提出验证松弛和自适应控制优化服务时系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MTP家族模型（如MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）需在数万亿token的完整预训练中联合训练MTP头，成本极高。作者探究是否仅用目标生成的思维链进行后训练即可达到相同加速效果，并优化服务时系统。

Method: 1) 在冻结的Qwen3-8B上，用约2.5B token的交叉熵后训练K=3链式MTP头；2) 提出链感知的草稿令牌验证松弛规则，允许有界偏离主干分布；3) 提出自适应控制器动态选择推理时激活的MTP头数。

Result: 1) 后训练方案在数学、编码和知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B预期加速，且MTP训练token少10^3-10^4倍；2) 验证松弛使每个基准预期加速提升12%-16%，同时保持任务准确率；3) 自适应控制器在固定最大MTP草稿长度下恢复高达11%-14%的加速损失。

Conclusion: 轻量级后训练即可在冻结推理模型上实现高效MTP加速，验证松弛和自适应控制能进一步优化服务时吞吐量，大幅降低训练成本。

Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

</details>


### [109] [CoEvolve: Construct-to-Edit Visual Grounding with Bidirectional State Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01710)
*Dongwei Sun,Yujie Zhang,Bowen Yao,Pei Liu,Jing Yao,Xiangyong Cao*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出CoEvolve框架，将视觉定位解耦为显式状态构建与编辑，通过区域演化强化和双向去噪精炼器提升定位精度与可编辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉定位模型将目标识别、空间推理和边界估计压缩为单次终端预测，自由形式理由虽语言显式但缺乏可测量、可编辑的空间状态，导致中间定位错误难以诊断和纠正，最终框易出现错误区域和不精确边界。

Method: CoEvolve框架包含：区域演化强化（RER）将定位分析组织为渐进语义-空间轨迹，每步推理提交显式候选区域；双向去噪精炼器（BDR）以推理文本为固定语义上下文，通过双向同位置重建精炼轨迹坐标场。采用几何与行为级目标提供目标几何和编辑偏好信号，用于巩固可靠候选、保留准确输入或向标注校正。

Result: 在自然图像和遥感定位评估中，9B骨干的CoEvolve定位精度可媲美高达241B参数的模型；在受控损坏下，单次BDR通过使平均框重叠率提升超过27个百分点，展现了对严重定位错误的强恢复能力；状态源比较进一步支持显式状态构建与源匹配编辑的互补性。

Conclusion: CoEvolve通过显式状态构建与编辑的分离，有效诊断和纠正中间定位错误，显著提升定位精度与鲁棒性，且参数效率高。

Abstract: Visual grounding localizes an object described by language with a bounding box. Most multimodal grounding models compress target identification, spatial reasoning, and boundary estimation into one terminal prediction. Free-form rationales make reasoning linguistically explicit but do not necessarily expose measurable, editable spatial states. Intermediate localization errors are therefore difficult to diagnose and correct, allowing incorrect region choices and imprecise boundaries to persist in the final box. We introduce CoEvolve, a construct-to-edit framework that separates grounding into explicit state construction and state editing. Region-Evolution Reinforcement (RER) organizes grounding analysis into a progressive semantic--spatial trajectory, with each reasoning step committing to an explicit candidate region. Bidirectional Denoising Refiner (BDR) treats the reasoning text as fixed semantic context and refines the trajectory's coordinate fields through bidirectional same-position reconstruction. Geometry- and behavior-level objectives provide target geometry and edit-preference signals for consolidating reliable candidates, preserving accurate inputs, or correcting toward annotations. Evaluations cover natural-image and remote-sensing grounding. With a 9B backbone, CoEvolve rivals models up to 241B parameters in grounding accuracy. Under controlled corruption, a single BDR pass improves mean box overlap by over 27 percentage points, demonstrating strong recovery from substantial localization errors. State-source comparisons further support the complementarity of explicit state construction and source-matched editing. The project is at https://sundongwei.github.io/CoEvolve_Project/.

</details>


### [110] [Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00894)
*Yair Schiff,Omer Belhasin,Roy Uziel,Matan Rusanovsky,Ran Zilberstein,Marianne Arriola,Gilad Turok,Guanghan Wang,Volodymyr Kuleshov,Michael Elad*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出Clock Diffusion框架，通过位置相关的噪声调度实现半自回归连续扩散语言模型，支持变长生成和KV缓存，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续扩散模型缺乏变长生成和KV缓存等实用功能，且质量落后于自回归和离散扩散模型。

Method: 引入位置相关噪声调度定义半自回归连续扩散模型，提出Clock Diffusion框架及块和滑动窗口两种特例，并设计Cache Grab采样器结合置信度阈值和自推测解码。

Result: ClockDLMs在OpenWebText上达到最优扩散似然界，在GSM8K上超越连续基线并匹配或超过离散扩散模型。

Conclusion: Clock Diffusion有效解决了连续扩散模型的实用限制，并通过高效采样器进一步提升质量和效率。

Abstract: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [111] [TopK-Guided: Adaptive, Budget-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01763)
*Mukund Agarwalla,Chih-Jen Lin*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法TopK-Guided，通过令牌级稀疏度自适应与块级敏感度预算分配，提升大语言模型激活稀疏推理的困惑度和下游准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练激活稀疏方法存在权衡：阈值法（如TEAL）逐令牌自适应但不严格控制实际稀疏度，TopK法（如WINA）强制固定稀疏度但对所有令牌使用相同预算；两者还在敏感度差异很大的Transformer块间采用相同预算。

Method: TopK-Guided结合有界的令牌级稀疏度自适应与敏感度感知的块级预算分配，无需训练。

Result: 在Llama-2和Llama-3模型上，TopK-Guided在困惑度和下游准确率上均持续优于TEAL和WINA，同时保持与WINA基本相同的稀疏度相关投影计算量，在高稀疏度下增益最大。

Conclusion: 消融实验表明两个组件提供互补改进，TopK-Guided有效解决现有方法的局限。

Abstract: Activation sparsity speeds up large language model (LLM) inference by setting unimportant activations to zero so that the corresponding computations can be skipped. Existing training-free methods, however, make different trade-offs: threshold-based methods such as TEAL adapt the sparsity level to each token but do not tightly control the realised sparsity, while TopK-based methods such as WINA enforce a fixed sparsity level but use the same sparsity budget for every token. Both also apply the same budget across transformer blocks, despite large differences in block sensitivity. We introduce TopK-Guided, a training-free method that addresses both limitations by combining bounded token-level sparsity adaptation with sensitivity-aware block-level budget allocation. Across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, TopK-Guided consistently improves perplexity and downstream accuracy over TEAL and WINA while preserving essentially the same sparsitydependent projection compute as WINA, with the largest gains at high sparsity. Ablations show that both components provide complementary improvements.

</details>


### [112] [Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00895)
*Sidney Bender,Benedikt Kunz,Ahmed Zeid,Shinichi Nakajima,Klaus-Robert Müller,Marco Morik*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出 DiDAE，将冻结的基础模型包装为条件扩散解码器，通过解缠字典的闭式反事实编辑，快速发现并修复分类器中的虚假关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型易受虚假相关和“Clever Hans”策略影响，而现有可解释机器学习方法无法在无元数据条件下修复基础模型。

Method: DiDAE 用条件扩散解码器包裹冻结基础模型；反事实为沿解缠字典方向的闭式编辑后解码；字典可监督（Procrustes）或无监督（SVD、稀疏自编码器）；无需梯度，速度比 SOTA 快至多 2000 倍；并引入反事实知识蒸馏（CFKD）修复下游分类器。

Result: 在六个数据集（两个合成、四个真实）上评估；三个数据集的基准中反事实与 SOTA 相当或更优；CFKD 修复下游分类器时优于基于元数据的校正；可对预训练字典与训练分类器进行排序，返回分类器实际读取的少数方向，每个方向经反事实因果验证，并沿教师标记的虚假方向修复分类器。

Conclusion: DiDAE 提供即插即用工作流（开源 Peal 库），结合公共字典与预训练解码器，仅需廉价线性蒸馏和分类器微调即可实现虚假关联发现与修复。

Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

</details>


### [113] [When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00898)
*Ada Fang,Nikitha Thoduguli,Lukas Fesser,Hanlin Zhang,Sham M. Kakade,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 六种生物推理模型中，基础模型表征对任务性能的实际贡献有限，且准确率提升并不代表模型真正利用了生物输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究以基准准确率作为LLM能对生物基础模型表征和生物文本进行推理的证据，作者旨在检验这一假设是否成立。

Method: 在DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务上测试六种生物推理模型；通过扰动单一生物输入、构造证据冲突、拟合线性探针及分析推理轨迹来评估各输入的实际贡献。

Result: Evo2和ESM3对BioReason与BioReason-Pro性能贡献很小，打乱DNA序列几乎不影响疾病预测准确率，证据冲突时模型分别有97.9%和99.7%跟随文本；线性探针仍能预测任务目标，说明基础模型编码了相关信息但未有效提升性能。ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2、CellWhisperer的基础模型输入有贡献，Cell2Sentence-Scale中差异表达基因有贡献；BioReason-Pro的SFT与RL检查点及42个BioReason检查点显示准确率提升不代表生物输入贡献增加，且推理轨迹存在错误或遗漏。

Conclusion: 当前后训练策略不能确保基础模型表征真正贡献于任务性能。

Abstract: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

</details>


### [114] [RealCompanion: Benchmarking Human Understanding from Reasoning over Longitudinal Real-World Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01780)
*Arman Behnam,Sunglyoung Kim,Liangwei Yang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 论文发布真实人机陪伴关系数据集 bench，含10段关系、27,218条消息及派生标注文件，揭示长期对话记忆的三个关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准通过生成人物与问题来规避隐私，但预设了何为重要；需用真实人机陪伴记录检验AI对用户的长期理解能力。

Method: 构建 bench 数据集：10段真实关系、最长120天、27,218条消息，配套 profile、persona、chat ground truth 与问题集，每条标签附推理轨迹并逐阶段对照对话核验；并评测记忆检测器与三种 agent 系统。

Result: 近期窗口即可覆盖95.9%探针所需消息，仅2.2%真正需要记忆；96%的证据增益来自无需记忆的消息；现有检测器无法判断真实消息何时需要记忆，人工问题泄漏线索，将消息标注为记忆可提升使用率10–14个百分点；三种 agent 系统在31倍成本差下取得相同 persona 重建 F1。

Conclusion: 长期同伴理解中，记忆需求稀疏且检测困难，池化指标具误导性；真实数据基准 bench 揭示了记忆使用与成本效率的关键差距。

Abstract: A companion that talks with a person for months should come to understand them. It should remember what they said, infer who they are, and know when the past bears on the message in front of it. Testing this requires a real person's record, and such records are private, so benchmarks generate the person and the questions and settle in advance what matters. We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.

</details>


### [115] [Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01781)
*Lu-Chin Chang,Suguman Bansal*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出首个无模型且具渐近保证的可达性强化学习算法Quasar，用于无非终止极大端分量（MEC）的MDP片段，显著降低内存并提升采样效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可达性RL的渐近最优保证仅依赖基于模型的方法，需显式估计MDP转移概率，内存和样本开销大，阻碍实际部署。

Method: Quasar采用经典Q学习框架，通过时序差分更新直接学习最优策略，无需估计转移概率；针对无MEC的MDP片段，将内存从O(|S|^2|A|)降至O(|S||A|)。

Result: 在标准定量验证基准集上，Quasar收敛到最优策略所需样本数比此前基于模型的最好方法少几个数量级，同时内存占用大幅降低。

Conclusion: 该工作为可达性学习及规范引导RL的实际部署迈出了具体一步，证明了无模型渐近保证的可行性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

</details>


### [116] [Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01834)
*Yaodong Yang,Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Xingyu Fan,Weixun Wang,Jinpeng Li,Tianpei Yang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该论文发现判断模型JE V在仅需评估输入信息的任务中表现优异，但在需要模拟预测的任务中失败，提出让代码负责模拟、模型负责评估的混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型如JE V能单次调用返回选项概率，适合作为智能体的动作选择层，但尚不清楚其可信赖的决策边界。

Method: 在反思测试、单次矩阵博弈、文本游戏ALFWorld和机器人控制任务上测试JE V，区分评估与模拟两类决策，并对比代码提供模拟时的性能。

Result: JE V在认知反思测试中解决99%反直觉问题，但在博弈中因未给出对手动作而表现次优，在ALFWorld中忽略前置子目标（如未洗刀直接放入抽屉），然而单独询问对手动作或给定动作时JE V通常回答正确，表明失败源于单次调用同时进行模拟与评估。

Conclusion: 让代码执行预测或模拟，JE V通过其通用评估能力可成为专家控制器，在ALFWorld前瞻和机器人物理模拟中验证了该混合架构的有效性。

Abstract: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

</details>


### [117] [Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00976)
*Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Minseon Gwak,Soon Hoe Lim,Pan Li,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出变分流匹配（VSF），在保持流匹配（SF）计算效率的同时实现概率预测，可生成多未来轨迹并提升长时预测与世界模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂动力系统存在内在随机性与观测不完整，同一状态可演化出多种未来，需要概率预测；现有流匹配方法计算开销大，而流匹配（SF）虽高效却只能给出确定性单一轨迹，无法表达多未来。

Method: VSF 在物理时间中学习连续速度场，同时引入以目标动力为条件的隐变量分布，将 SF 扩展为概率式生成；通过隐变量采样产生多条未来轨迹，并保持 SF 的物理时间生成效率，可作为即插即用预测器集成到基于 JEPA 的世界模型中。

Result: 在确定性与随机动力系统上，VSF 在预测精度和分布保真度上优于对比方法；在超过 1000 步的长时滚动预测及分岔动力学场景中具有优势；集成到 JEPA 世界模型后改善了时间动态与导航、运动规划、操作任务的目标导向成功率。

Conclusion: VSF 在保留流匹配高效物理时间生成能力的同时实现概率预测，兼顾精度、分布质量与长时稳定性，并可无缝增强现有世界模型。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

</details>


### [118] [Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00978)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出TS-Router框架，利用预训练时序基础模型估计多种异常检测器的相对能力，并为每个目标序列选择合适专家，实现跨数据集泛化的时间序列异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）因异构时序动态导致正常性定义与检测准则不同，难以跨数据集泛化；直接为时序基础模型固定异常评分机制会忽略这种差异。

Method: 将基础模型用于协调专用异常准则而非施加统一准则；基于预训练时序表征估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，从标注模拟任务中提取软能力监督，部署时无需目标异常标签，仅对选定专家进行无监督拟合，并在表征覆盖与条件能力稳定性下给出Top-k集合能力遗憾界。

Result: 在16个真实世界基准和四种互补评价指标上，TS-Router取得最佳总体平均排名；使用多个冻结TSFM编码器的受控消融实验支持预训练表征用于能力估计与自适应专家选择。

Conclusion: 以基础模型协调专用检测准则的“通才表征、专家检测”视角有效，TS-Router在无需目标异常标签的部署条件下提升了跨数据集TSAD的泛化性能，代码已公开。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

</details>


### [119] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出了AVSD-Scenes，一个面向城市环境的配对音视频场景描述数据集，包含12,291条描述，并验证了多模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言描述能提供丰富的音视频城市场景语义表示，但联合描述听觉与视觉信息的数据集仍然有限。

Method: 基于TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes数据集，先用Qwen2-Audio-7B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B分别生成音频与视觉描述，再用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506和Gemma-3-27B-it等大语言模型融合为多模态描述；通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类、LLM-as-a-judge评估和人工主观评估进行基准测试。

Result: 多模态描述相比单模态描述提升了语义对齐和跨模态检索性能，并保留强场景判别信息；城市场景分类准确率最高达94.5%，融合音频、视觉和描述嵌入后提升至95.4%；即使在提示指令中移除场景标签，描述仍具高场景判别性。

Conclusion: 多模态描述能有效捕捉音视频内容中的互补语义信息，而非仅反映标签信息，验证了AVSD-Scenes数据集的构建质量与实用价值。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [120] [Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00988)
*Shan Yu,Xuening Wu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出监督式代数计数场ACF，从无配体结构预测隐蔽口袋残基，预测可追溯且外部验证优于P2Rank。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐蔽配体结合口袋在实验解析的无配体结构中不可见，难以从受体几何直接识别；同时预测背后的结构测量与学习证据需可直接审查。

Method: 构建监督式代数计数场（ACF），将显式几何、理化与拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表；推理时无需序列搜索、结构模板迁移或蛋白质语言模型，每个预测分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重和空间聚合重建。在CryptoBench及两个锁定外部集合上评估，区分排序性能与残基调用预算效应。

Result: 在57个后CryptoBench无配体-复合物单元的外部集上，ACF的平均配对ROC-AUC比P2Rank高+0.044（多重性校正95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]）；优势依赖数据集：官方折叠ROC-AUC和匹配预算F1差异未定，第二个外部评估未证实增加结构特征带来增益。

Conclusion: ACF提供紧凑预测器，具有外部验证信号，并给出从结构测量与训练计数到残基分数的可审查路径。

Abstract: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.

</details>


### [121] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 对十个开源大语言模型进行反事实审计，评估其在儿科急诊分诊（ESI）预测中的偏见敏感性，发现偏见不随模型规模或医学预训练而系统性降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊中人口统计学、社会经济和系统背景信息可能不当影响分诊等级判定；开源LLM被越来越多用于隐私保护的本地临床决策支持，但反事实偏见在不同模型家族、规模、医学领域模型及领域适配模型间的差异尚不清楚。

Method: 基于真实与手册式临床案例构建配对反事实变体，每次仅改变一个人口统计学、社会经济、医疗可及性、行为、社会或系统背景变量，保持临床表现固定；对十个开源LLM（包括Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、QLoRA微调Qwen2.5-7B、MedGemma变体、MedLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B）进行儿科ESI预测，测量反事实偏移率、分诊不足、分诊过度、偏移超过一个ESI等级的比例、平均偏移和平均绝对偏移。

Result: 反事实敏感性差异显著，且未随模型规模增大或医学领域预训练而一致下降；微调Qwen2.5-7B总体敏感性最低（任意偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），而基础模型为16.02%和0.1706；部分更大或医学领域模型偏移更显著；分层与相关性分析揭示了聚合率掩盖的临床重要方向性和共同失败模式。

Conclusion: 反事实审计是一种轻量、临床可解释的框架，可用于在临床部署前比较开源LLM的公平性风险。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [122] [GLoC-EHR: Evidence-Cited Clinical Reasoning over Global Context and Local EHR Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01076)
*Chaiho Shin,Kwangsoo Kim*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出GLoC-EHR多模态语言模型，通过全局与局部记忆编码电子健康记录，并采用证据引用推理，在多项临床结局预测任务中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化电子健康记录包含临床代码序列，回答临床问题需同时利用整体轨迹上下文和支持答案的特定事件，现有零样本大语言模型直接读取序列化记录效果不佳。

Method: GLoC-EHR以固定大小的全局记忆编码轨迹上下文，局部记忆编码选定事件；先学习从全局记忆生成住院过程摘要、从局部记忆生成掩码概念描述，与临床文本对齐；再通过理由微调和分组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练模型在回答前引用证据，奖励包括正确答案和记录支持的证据。

Result: 在三个MIMIC-IV结局任务上，GLoC-EHR直接回答时宏AUROC最高，远超零样本LLM；带证据引用推理时宏AUROC接近直接多任务版本，且目标中的证据项减少无支持证据；局部记忆在严格匹配下增加独特支持发现，宏AUROC无显著变化；无需再训练即可迁移至EHRSHOT，性能与EHR-BERT相当，并在两个未见实验室问题上优于其自身骨干的零样本提示。

Conclusion: GLoC-EHR通过全局与局部记忆及证据引用训练，有效提升电子健康记录临床问答性能，并具备良好的迁移能力。

Abstract: Structured electronic health records (EHRs) contain a patient's clinical trajectory as a sequence of clinical codes. Answering clinical questions from such records requires both the context of the whole trajectory and the specific events that support the answer. We introduce GLoC-EHR, a multimodal language model that reads a contextual encoding of the record through a fixed-size global memory of the trajectory and a local memory of selected events. The model learns to generate hospital-course summaries from the global memory and descriptions of masked concepts from the local memory, aligning both with clinical text. It is then trained to cite evidence before answering, through rationale fine-tuning followed by group relative policy optimization (GRPO) with rewards for correct answers and record-supported evidence. On three MIMIC-IV outcome tasks, GLoC-EHR attains the highest macro AUROC among the compared models when it answers directly, whereas zero-shot LLMs reading the serialized record fall far behind. With evidence-cited reasoning, it stays close to its direct multi-task counterpart in macro AUROC, and the evidence terms of the objective reduce unsupported evidence at a similar macro AUROC. The local memory adds distinct supported findings, particularly under strict matching, without a detectable change in macro AUROC. Without retraining, GLoC-EHR transfers to EHRSHOT on par with EHR-BERT and answers two unseen laboratory questions better than zero-shot prompting of its own backbone.

</details>


### [123] [Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02036)
*Xin Heng*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出全局一致性问题的不可实现定理，并设计局部到全局运行时语义框架，通过九项实验证明：局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体各自做出局部有效决策，却联合产生无效结果，这并非模型智能不足，而是共享状态失败所致，即全局一致性问题。

Method: 首先提出观察-别名不可实现性定理，给出策略能保证有效动作的精确边界；随后提出局部到全局运行时语义X=(H,C,G,F;D)，包括拓扑H、范畴C、群胚G、层F和最小历史D；最后通过九项研究在受控修订基准、TeamBench、tau2-bench Telecom等场景测试失败及其边界。

Result: 在受控修订基准中，同一前沿模型在决定事件可见时得40/40，隐藏时仅12-17/40（与随机1/3一致），恢复一个权威事实后恢复40/40；TeamBench中普通团队5/5超预算，可见实时计数仍有4/5违规，提交强制后0/5；tau2-bench Telecom中，静默回滚后当前状态检查得0.07，而框架得1.00；传统求解器已拥有完整相关状态时与框架持平。

Conclusion: 反直觉的结论是：局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。

Abstract: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

</details>


### [124] [Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02038)
*Yimeng Liu,Mi Zhang,Younsuk Dong,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出物理锚定的LLM智能体Mimir，通过双时间尺度修复机制，在灌溉长期物理控制中实现低控制成本与节水。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究多集中于即时反馈、可重置的短时任务；长期物理控制中动作改变未来状态、错误累积，且需在不改写物理规则的前提下从经验中学习。

Method: Mimir围绕两个修复时间尺度：快尺度通过结构化物理接口与确定性模拟器，将LLM输出转为提案，经数值检查、修订和有界确定性动作选择后执行；慢尺度将反复出现的失败模式固化为持久上下文原则以调节未来提案，同时物理模型、评估器和执行约束保持不可变。

Result: 在跨多个地点、作物和年份的统一回顾性评估下，Mimir取得所评估参考中最低的汇总控制成本，灌溉量比历史调度回放少约51%；消融显示移除前向模拟、验证修订或持久上下文均提高控制成本；模型规模与模型家族研究未发现随LLM增大而单调增益。

Conclusion: 持久物理智能体可将语义推理与有界、证据驱动的自我改进结合，同时将物理真值与执行器权限保留给显式数值机制。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

</details>


### [125] [How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01110)
*Bangji Yang,Jingyuan Li,Jiajun Fan,Yi Evie Zhang,Ruihan Guo,Hongba Ma,Neil He,Chumeng Liang,Qinglong Zheng,Zhanghan Ni,Ge Liu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出SELF-POT基准，在统一预算下跨竞赛数学、编程和智能体任务评估模型的测试时扩展潜力，并计入选择与评审成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展研究多局限于单一领域，且常忽略选择过程的成本，难以公平比较模型在额外推理下的真实收益。

Method: SELF-POT将静态任务的候选覆盖率与最终准确率分离，跟踪修订中的正确性转换，并在智能体环境同时度量协议完成度与任务成功率；以Direct预算的固定倍数为统一预算规则，比较直接推理、并行采样与自我修订，并将包括选择与评审在内的每次模型调用按美元计费。

Result: 在350个封存任务、五个低成本推理模型上，以Claude Opus 5.5 Direct为参考，收益随领域、选择规则和失败处理而变化；编程候选池回放中，公共样例选择将正确提交从376提升至500个计划单元中的453，同时节省12-49%逻辑API成本，判题失败时保留候选可零成本恢复61次提交；数学池中带回退的判题得186次正确提交，投票得182次，投票节省12-21%逻辑API成本。

Conclusion: 受控回放表明选择与失败处理会显著改变相同生成候选所实现的收益，并量化了模型判题器的边际价值。

Abstract: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

</details>


### [126] [Latent Information Sharing for Accelerating Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01126)
*Seungjun Lee,Ensieh Khazaei,Dimitrios Hatzinakos,Baturalp Buyukates,Sunwoo Lee*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种新的潜在信息共享方案，通过共享少量隐藏层激活来直接缓解联邦学习中的客户端漂移，提升训练效率与模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中的客户端漂移是阻碍全局模型高效训练的关键挑战，现有方法未能充分解决数据异构性问题。

Method: 设计一种潜在信息共享机制，在客户端间共享少量隐藏层激活，并分析其对联邦优化的影响，同时保持收敛保证与数据隐私。

Result: 实验表明，该方法在固定通信轮次预算下，相比FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedPVR、FedProto和SplitFed等基线，实现了更高的模型精度，且未引入过多通信开销。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了一种有前景的新知识聚合方案，并全面分析了激活共享对联邦优化的影响，证明其能有效缓解客户端漂移并提升训练效率。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a communication-efficient distributed learning paradigm. However, client drift remains one of the most critical challenges, hindering the efficient training of a global model. In this study, we propose a novel latent information sharing scheme that directly mitigates data heterogeneity across clients. Our theoretical and empirical results show that sharing a small amount of hidden-layer activations significantly improves training efficiency while preserving convergence guarantees and data privacy. Furthermore, we compare our method with existing FL approaches designed to address client drift, including FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedPVR, FedProto, and SplitFed, and demonstrate superior model accuracy under a fixed round budget without incurring excessive communication overhead. Overall, this work presents a promising new knowledge aggregation scheme and provides a comprehensive analysis of the impact of activation sharing on federated optimization.

</details>


### [127] [Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01133)
*Bangji Yang,Jiajun Fan,Hongba Ma,Ruihan Guo,Ge Liu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出策略空间缩放概念，用SURGE方法融合同一RL训练中的两个检查点，在不增加训练或推理计算的情况下生成更强策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统缩放推理增加RL训练或推理计算，本文发现已完成RL训练历史可产生比优化器访问的检查点更强的策略，旨在扩展可部署策略集。

Method: SURGE将高精度锚点与生成更短响应的供体检查点表示为共享初始化的变化，对锚点更新进行谱分解，保留主导成分并融入供体互补成分，固定保留比例后直接从权重确定块大小。

Result: 在DeepSeek和Nemotron数学推理及OLMo编码历史上，SURGE平均准确率超越两个输入检查点且推理token少于锚点；DeepSeek AIME24达54.17%（原生最高50.83%），OLMo HumanEval+达83.7%（82.8%）。

Conclusion: 存储的RL历史是可复用的缩放资源，训练运行的能力不必止于最佳检查点；几何控制实验表明RL更新结构比权重位移或token减少更重要。

Abstract: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

</details>


### [128] [Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02070)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出因果记忆策略CMP，通过对检索本身进行干预恢复记忆效用的可识别性，解决检索层面的正性违反问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆增强大语言模型需决定保留哪些记忆，现有方法基于被检索到的记忆估计其对任务性能的影响；但从未被检索的记忆其效用无法识别，这是仅关注记忆操作的诊断无法发现的检索层面正性违反。

Method: CMP在检索上施加干预，为按已知倾向性采样的记忆保留固定数量的上下文槽位，采用平衡分配设计下的自归一化逆倾向性加权估计记忆效用；理论上证明了经由检索的记忆效用因果分解、估计量的无偏性与精确方差，以及不可逆操作下的最优决策规则。

Result: 在LongMemEval上有54%、LoCoMo上有67%的必需记忆识别失败，且在已部署的记忆系统中依然存在；CMP将必需与非必需记忆的区分能力从0.54提升至0.66 AUC；同时发现即使效用可识别也不足以支撑保留决策：单查询效用在其估计查询上可达0.78 AUC，但保留策略可用的任何聚合方式都无法预测记忆在未见查询上的价值。

Conclusion: 检索层面的可识别性是记忆效用估计的关键前提，CMP通过干预检索恢复识别并提升区分度；但记忆保留决策还需解决跨查询泛化的聚合难题。

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

</details>


### [129] [Parameter-Efficient Distributionally Robust Adaptation of Tabular Foundation Models under Subpopulation Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01143)
*Seonghwi Kim,Sung Ho Jo,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出DR-TFM，一种参数高效的分布鲁棒自适应框架，无需真实组标注，通过调整注意力机制提升表格基础模型在子群体偏移下的最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）在平均准确率上表现强劲，但在子群体偏移（训练与部署时群体比例变化）下对代表性不足群体表现较差，且现有方法通常依赖真实组标注。

Method: DR-TFM仅微调现有查询缩放网络或新增并训练一个查询缩放网络，以调整对带标签上下文示例的注意力，其余参数冻结；使用基于训练数据估计的组或源条件分布构建两种鲁棒目标。在TabPFN-3上仅更新预训练模型0.016%的参数。

Result: 在五个表格基准上，DR-TFM在无真实组标注下平均最差组准确率显著高于预训练TFM和对比鲁棒基线，同时保持有竞争力的平均组准确率；在ACS Income及另外四种TFM上也提升了平均最差组准确率。

Conclusion: DR-TFM是一种无需真实组标注、参数高效的分布鲁棒自适应方法，能有效提升表格基础模型在子群体偏移下的最差组性能。

Abstract: Despite strong mean accuracy, tabular foundation models (TFMs) can perform poorly on underrepresented groups under subpopulation shift, where group proportions change between training and deployment. We propose DR-TFM, a parameter-efficient distributionally robust adaptation framework that requires no true group annotations. DR-TFM adjusts attention to labeled context examples by fine-tuning an existing query scaling network or adding and training one, while keeping all other parameters fixed. We instantiate the framework with two robust objectives using estimated groups or source conditional distributions derived from training data. For TabPFN-3, adaptation updates only 0.016% of the pretrained model's parameters. Across five tabular benchmarks, DR-TFM achieves substantially higher average worst-group accuracy than pretrained TFMs and the compared robust baselines without true group annotations, while maintaining competitive mean group accuracy. DR-TFM also improves average worst-group accuracy on ACS Income and across four additional TFMs.

</details>


### [130] [A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02116)
*Javier Diaz Esteban-Herreros,David Muñoz-Valero,Raquel Martínez-España,Jose M. Juarez,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个比较可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医学摘要零样本分类中的表现，重点解决不同归因方法解释不一致的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决可解释人工智能中的分歧问题，即不同归因方法对同一输入和预测产生不同解释，并评估模型在医学文本分类中的可解释性和稳定性。

Method: 在Medical Abstracts语料上实现自然语言推理引擎，每个诊断类别使用五个增强假设，每类平衡采样一千篇文本；比较五种解释方法：SHAP和LIME（模型无关）、occlusion和Input x Gradient（深度学习特定）、Attention x Gradient（Transformer特定）；通过top-token归因标准化解释，并使用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。

Result: 在定义明确的临床领域达到高预测准确率，但在高语义模糊下性能下降；解释稳定性与预测确定性直接对应，单义类别中强收敛，诊断不确定时显著下降；定性错误审计发现三种系统性失败机制：词汇超敏、语义重叠和归因连贯性丧失。

Conclusion: 结果支持在审计基于Transformer的医学文本分类模型时，结合使用多种解释方法和定量一致性指标，并建议优先考虑特定临床本体而非宽泛诊断标签。

Abstract: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

</details>


### [131] [VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200)
*Qiushi Han,Keya Hu,Linlu Qiu,Cathy Wu,Kaiming He*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出视觉外挂 VISTA，使通用多模态模型具备长时程视觉能力，在交互环境中显著提升推理与任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型具备强推理能力，但缺乏合适的外挂来释放其在多样交互环境中的潜力。

Method: VISTA 让模型通过视觉观察直接感知环境，维护无损视觉记忆以原始形式保存历史观察，模型可主动检索并重组视觉输入进行推理；设计简洁，可低成本迁移到多种视觉环境。

Result: 在 ARC-AGI-3 上，Claude Opus 5.0 的相对人类行动效率从 40.68 提升至满分 100.00，完成全部 25 个公开游戏，所用动作比首次参与的人类少 57.4%；在涵盖多种视觉游戏与谜题的另外三个基准上，显著优于使用同一基础模型加最小外挂的基线。

Conclusion: VISTA 有望成为推动多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中发展的通用视觉外挂。

Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

</details>


### [132] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 论文提出 ScholarCatalyst 基准，通过 184 位作者对 207 篇计算机科学论文的标注，评估 AI 系统能否在项目开始时的文献库中检索出对研究有启发的前期工作，发现智能体搜索并不优于嵌入检索，即便使用强大模型也仅达 0.51 R@20，表明模型缺乏专家式检索直觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究伟大科学家的核心能力之一：在浩瀚文献中敏锐识别能推动新问题的前期想法。当前 AI 虽在开放问题上有所进展，但在这种专家直觉上仍远逊于人类，因此需要构建可量化的评估基准来推动相关训练方法的发展。

Method: 构建自动化流水线实现可扩展的作者标注，邀请 184 位近期计算机科学论文的通讯作者对 207 篇论文进行标注，指出哪些候选前期工作实际或可能推动了其项目，并附上详细理由。基于此提出检索任务：给定初始研究问题，仅从项目开始时可获取的文献中检索相关论文。对比评估了嵌入检索、智能体搜索以及基于 Claude Fable 5.1 的智能体。

Result: 智能体搜索（0.42 Recall@20）并不优于嵌入检索（0.48 Recall@20），尽管前者将同一检索器作为工具调用。即便使用可能在训练中见过完整论文的 Claude Fable 5.1 构建的智能体，也仅达到 0.51 R@20。

Conclusion: 结果表明需要新的训练方案来赋予模型在广泛语料库中搜索的专家直觉。ScholarCatalyst 是迈向能对半成型想法指出所需前期研究的科学智能体的一步。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


### [133] [CAGE-NAS: Certified Functional Descent for Efficient Model Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01173)
*Santiago Florido Gomez,Stéphane Rivaud*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: CAGE-NAS 提出一种基于函数空间可容许性准则的神经网络渐进式生长方法，仅在表示无法支持认证的函数梯度下降步时才进行保函数扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络渐进生长需要判断当前表示是否仍足以支持优化，以及何时应扩展；现有方法缺乏在函数空间中对这一决策的明确准则。

Method: 在函数空间中，通过函数梯度近似的可容许性准则做决策：只要表示能够实现一个被认证的函数梯度下降步，就固定架构；准则失败时，执行保函数扩展并重新评估新表示。主要实例研究切空间诱导的族，使用函数梯度的正则化投影。

Result: 在具有精确认证的受控设置中，CAGE-NAS 生成的架构在相同参数预算内所有可容许替代方案中，按留出 RMSE 位于 99.8 百分位以上，且在生长轨迹中无需枚举这些替代方案。

Conclusion: CAGE-NAS 通过函数空间可容许性准则有效指导架构生长，在受控条件下能以较少搜索获得高性能架构。

Abstract: The progressive growth of neural networks requires deciding when the current representation remains sufficient for optimization and when it should be expanded. CAGE-NAS formulates this decision in function space through an admissibility criterion on approximations of the functional gradient. As long as a representation enables a certified Functional Gradient Descent step, the architecture remains fixed; when the criterion fails, a function-preserving expansion is applied and the resulting representation is evaluated again. As the main instance, we study the family induced by the tangent space, using a regularized projection of the functional gradient. In a controlled setting with exact certification, CAGE-NAS produces architectures positioned above the 99.8th performance percentile by held-out RMSE among all admissible alternatives within the same parameter budget, without enumerating them during the growth trajectory.

</details>


### [134] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出一种辅助损失，将成功准则量作为训练目标，提升潜在世界模型在规划任务中的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在世界模型通过潜在空间距离评估动作序列，但任务成功由物理量（成功准则量）判定；现有模型将成功准则量仅作为输入，其潜在状态对末端执行器位置的编码误差大于成功准则允许值，无法区分成功与失败候选动作。

Method: 在训练时，于编码器和预测器输出上添加线性头，回归成功准则量，并将回归误差加入训练损失；训练后丢弃该线性头，因此测试时模型、代价和输入保持不变。

Result: 在PushT和cube任务上，成功率分别绝对提升3.5%和3.4%，且两项提升均具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 成功准则指定了世界模型潜在状态必须保留的信息，并可直接作为训练目标使用。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [135] [Model validation in machine learning: A scenario-based guide from hold-out splits to nested group cross-validation in biomedical and applied research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01284)
*Mehmet Baygin,Sengul Dogan,Turker Tuncer*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该教程系统综述了模型验证方法，并通过八种受控场景对比了有缺陷与防泄漏设计，强调验证方法无普适最优，且独立单元须匹配部署目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不合理的划分会产生乐观且稳定的性能估计，因此需要阐明各类验证方案的适用条件与泄漏风险，以正确评估完整学习流程在新数据上的表现。

Method: 综述留出法、训练/验证/测试设计、重复随机子抽样、k折与重复分层交叉验证、留一法与留p法、分组感知验证及嵌套分组交叉验证，并结合EEG片段、配对眼OCT图像、重复临床测量和多中心数据；用八个受控场景比较缺陷与防泄漏设计，包括全局特征选择、归一化泄漏、依赖记录、中心混合、重复使用测试集和估计器不稳定性，另提供MATLAB与scikit-learn模板及决策树和报告清单。

Result: 通过锁定的混淆矩阵与可审计指标及可重复模拟，量化了偏差、方差、指标聚合、不确定性和计算成本，显示不同验证方案在多种泄漏场景下的表现差异。

Conclusion: 没有普适最优的验证方法；独立单元必须与预期部署目标一致，且所有依赖数据的操作都必须排除用于性能估计的观测。

Abstract: Model validation estimates the performance of a complete learning procedure on new data. However, an invalid split can produce an optimistic and stable result. This tutorial reviews hold-out validation, train/validation/test designs, repeated random subsampling, k-fold and repeated stratified cross-validation, leave-one-out and leave-p-out schemes, group-aware validation, and nested group cross-validation. General machine-learning principles are linked to EEG epochs, paired-eye OCT images, repeated clinical measurements, and multicenter data. Eight controlled scenarios compare flawed and leakage-safe designs: seven use locked confusion matrices with auditable metrics, and one uses a reproducible repeated-study simulation. The scenarios cover global feature selection, normalization leakage, dependent records, center mixing, repeated test-set use, and estimator instability. Bias, variance, metric aggregation, uncertainty, and computational cost are also examined. A data-size matrix, a decision tree, and reporting checklists are provided. Reproducible MATLAB templates and scikit-learn counterparts are included. The results show that no validation method is universally best. The independent unit must match the intended deployment target. Every data-dependent operation must also exclude the observations used for performance estimation.

</details>


### [136] [EP-Flow: Disordered Crystal Structure Prediction without Site-Level Annotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01315)
*Qiuliang Liu,Liming Wu,Qi Li,Zhonglong Peng,Chang Chen,Xiaolong Chen,Wenbing Huang,Shifeng Jin*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该文提出占用分布矩阵（ODM）统一表示无序晶体结构，并设计熵多面体流匹配框架EP-Flow，从化学式直接生成满足约束的无序晶体结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型多针对有序晶体，而功能材料常存在取代混合、空位或间隙无序；已有方法要么假设确定性占位，要么依赖难以获取的位点级无序标注，无法仅由化学式预测无序结构。

Method: 将无序晶体结构预测形式化为ODM，即连续的位置-物种占用表示，需满足位置占用、质量守恒与非负性约束，构成依赖化学式的运输多面体；提出EP-Flow，通过边缘约束流匹配将异质多面体规范化到共享双中心空间，学习保持边缘的流，并用Sinkhorn逆映射恢复可行占用，同时生成占用、分数坐标与晶格参数。

Result: 在基于COD与MPDS构建的化学式条件无序CSP基准上，EP-Flow取得最优性能，显著优于适配的有序晶体生成器；分析表明其能恢复稀疏且化学上有意义的局部无序模式，而非仅匹配全局组成统计。

Conclusion: EP-Flow为化学式条件下的无序晶体结构预测提供了统一且有效的生成框架，能够生成满足约束并具有局部化学意义无序模式的结构。

Abstract: Generative models have made rapid progress in ordered crystal structure prediction, yet many functional materials are intrinsically disordered, with substitutional mixing, vacancies, or interstitial species controlling their properties. Existing crystal generators either assume deterministic site occupations or require site-level disorder annotations, which are often unavailable when the chemical formula is the primary input. We formulate disordered crystal structure prediction through an Occupancy Distribution Matrix (ODM), a continuous site-by-species representation that unifies ordered crystals, solid solutions, vacancy disorder, and interstitial occupancy. A valid ODM must satisfy coupled site-wise occupancy, mass-conservation, and non-negativity constraints, placing each sample on a formula-dependent transportation polytope. We propose Entropic Polytope Flow (EP-Flow), a marginal-constrained flow matching framework that canonicalizes heterogeneous polytopes into a shared double-centered space, learns a marginal-preserving flow, and recovers feasible occupancies through a Sinkhorn inverse map. By jointly generating occupancies, fractional coordinates, and lattice parameters, EP-Flow achieves state-of-the-art performance on formula-conditioned disordered CSP benchmarks derived from COD and MPDS, substantially outperforming adapted ordered-crystal generators. Analyses further show that EP-Flow recovers sparse and chemically meaningful local disorder patterns rather than merely matching global composition statistics.

</details>


### [137] [Prediction-powered Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01317)
*Pascal Janetzky,Yuxin Wang,Michael Klar,Stefan Feuerriegel*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出PPNAS，结合少量真实性能标签和大量零成本代理信息，通过预测推断提升神经架构搜索的标签效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NAS中可靠性能标签稀缺（训练评估代价高），而零成本代理（ZCP）虽廉价但噪声大，如何有效结合这两种监督源尚不明确。

Method: 基于预测推断（PPI）的PPNAS方法，融合少量有性能标签的架构和大量有ZCP信息的架构；利用ZCP提供的序数信息构建额外成对排序监督，并通过PPI去偏ZCP与真实性能排名间的系统差异。

Result: 在端到端基于预测器的NAS中，PPNAS在有限评估预算下达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: PPNAS是首个面向标签高效NAS的预测推断方法，有效融合了有限真实标签与大规模ZCP监督。
