Result: 10M在244场同角色对局中胜240场（98.4%），对每个对手均保持胜绩；对零延迟Slippi-AI模型68场全胜。初始152场基准中监督10M胜率69.7%，优于预训练75M的45.4%；加权验证损失与胜率排序一致。优化推理在T4上平均决策用时10M为5.2ms、75M为8.7ms。

Conclusion: 单检查点多角色策略可达到高竞技胜率，监督后训练改善伤害、早期领先和首命落后后的翻盘表现；开源权重、基准套件和自动化锦标赛平台以促进可复现研究。

Abstract: We introduce Faynt, a family of 10M- and 75M-parameter Transformer policies for Super Smash Bros. Melee, each controlling all 26 characters with a single checkpoint. After reinforcement learning (RL), the 10M wins 240 of 244 same-character games (98.4%) against fourteen specialist and multi-character releases on their supported rosters, with a winning record against every release. These opponents retain 21- or 24-frame action delays; Faynt uses no added delay, and we have not isolated the effect of this difference. In a separate evaluation against a privately supplied zero-delay Slippi-AI model, the 10M wins all 68 games across two conditioning settings. We study architecture, optimization, scaling, and hyperparameter transfer to guide pretraining on approximately 840,000 human replays. Post-training combines rank- and outcome-based curricula, 75M-to-10M distillation, and RL restricted to Fox mirror matches. On the initial 152-game benchmark, the supervised 10M wins 69.7% of games, compared with 45.4% for the pretrained 75M, despite higher overall held-out controller-prediction loss. The weighted validation loss used for supervised checkpoint selection agrees with the win-rate ordering of all four pretrained and supervised policies. After supervised post-training, both models take less damage per minute, build larger early leads, and win more often after losing the first life. Optimized inference on recorded game states averages 5.2 ms per decision for the 10M and 8.7 ms for the 75M on an NVIDIA T4, excluding emulator execution and communication. We open-source the weights, both benchmark suites, and a platform for automated model tournaments.

</details>


### [175] [Effective Resistance and Graph Neural Network Reliability in Tissue-Specific Interactomes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02175)
*Jianru Shen*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 该研究检验组织特异性互作结构中的有效电阻能否为蛋白质功能注释提供“何时不应信任预测”的节点级信号，并发现其残差可解释额外预测损失，但受度退化限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质功能注释不仅需要模型预测结果，还需要判断哪些预测不可信；作者希望探究组织特异性互作结构是否携带这种可信度信息。

Method: 以有效电阻为候选信号，在24个组织特异性互作组中分析其与逆度的关系，并与度保持零模型比较；随后在控制预测熵、度、注释基数、局部结构和仅特征难度后，检验残差对留出网络中逐节点损失的额外解释力，并设置置换下限。

Result: 有效电阻在24个网络中均被逆度主导，随共表达过滤网络增大而退化加深，Spearman相关为-0.955；残差偏离在所有24个网络中超过度保持零图。在24个留出网络中的19个里，扣除置换下限后，残差可解释额外逐节点损失，且在每个深度均成立并随深度单调增强；增量达控制变量未解释方差的0.37%，为置换下限的5.6倍，而模型在度保持零世界中重训时仅为1.5倍。选择性预测改善可忽略。

Conclusion: 该信号具有可重复性，但度退化限制了其作用；有效电阻主要反映度结构，作为不可信预测的节点级信号价值有限。

Abstract: Protein function annotation needs to know which predictions to distrust, not only what a model predicts. We ask whether tissue-specific interaction structure carries that information. Our candidate signal is effective resistance, used previously to relieve over-squashing by rewiring. Across 24 tissue-specific interactomes it is dominated by inverse degree, and the degeneration deepens as the co-expression filtered network grows, with a Spearman correlation of -0.955. The residual departure from that limit exceeds degree-preserving null graphs in all 24 networks. Controlling for predictive entropy, degree, annotation cardinality, local structure and feature-only difficulty, the residual explains additional per-node loss in 19 of 24 held-out networks once a permutation floor is subtracted, at every depth, and the effect strengthens monotonically with depth. The increment reaches 0.37% of the variance the controls leave unexplained, 5.6 times a permutation floor, against 1.5 times when the model is retrained in a degree-preserving null world. Selective prediction improves negligibly. The signal is reproducible; degree degeneration bounds it.

</details>


### [176] [Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02185)
*Weihao Liu,Huangjie Zheng,Tianrong Chen,Rohit Dilip,Richard He Bai,Yizhu Jiao,Yuyang Wang,Ruixiang Zhang*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出LoopCD，一种免训练对比解码框架，利用循环Transformer的早期循环状态作为弱预测，与最终预测对比来引导解码，在提升性能的同时减少推理计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过重复执行共享块实现参数效率，每个循环产生可解码同一token的中间表示，但标准解码丢弃了早期状态。早期循环计算量较少，天然提供对齐的弱-强预测对，无需辅助模型或外部训练。

Method: LoopCD通过对比最终预测与早期循环输出来引导token选择，支持两种模式：LoopCD-Logits在logit空间进行，需额外一次输出前向；LoopCD-Hidden在隐藏状态空间进行，无额外输出开销。

Result: 在四种循环Transformer家族上，LoopCD在全循环深度下取得显著一致提升：LoopCD-Logits将Ouro-2.6B-Thinking的AIME 2024 pass@1从61.88%提升至73.33%；LoopCD-Hidden将Huginn的HumanEval pass@1从22.56%提升至31.71%。性能提升还允许将循环次数减半，同时匹配或超过全深度无引导基线，减少前向FLOPs 22.5%至48.2%。

Conclusion: LoopCD将中间循环状态转化为有效引导信号，在实现更优解码质量的同时大幅降低推理计算。

Abstract: Looped Transformers achieve parameter efficiency by repeatedly executing a shared block across recurrent loops. Each loop yields an intermediate representation decodable for the same next token, yet standard decoding discards earlier states. Because earlier loops embody less computation, recurrence inherently supplies aligned weak-and-strong prediction pairs without auxiliary models or external training. We introduce LoopCD, a training-free contrastive decoding framework that guides token selection by contrasting the final prediction with an earlier recurrent pass, operating either in logit space with one extra output pass (LoopCD-Logits) or in hidden-state space with zero output overhead (LoopCD-Hidden). Across four looped Transformer families, LoopCD delivers substantial, consistent gains at full recurrent depth: LoopCD-Logits raises Ouro-2.6B-Thinking's AIME 2024 pass@1 from 61.88% to 73.33%, while LoopCD-Hidden lifts Huginn's HumanEval pass@1 from 22.56% to 31.71%. Crucially, these performance gains enable halving the number of recurrent loops while still matching or exceeding full-depth unguided baselines, reducing forward FLOPs by 22.5% to 48.2%. By transforming intermediate recurrent states into effective guidance signals, LoopCD achieves superior decoding quality while substantially reducing inference compute.

</details>


### [177] [The Missing Primitive: Diagnosing and Repairing Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02191)
*Shuo Xing,Zilin Dai,Chengyuan Qian,Fangzhou Lin,Wenjing Chen,Ping He,Pan Lu,Alvaro Velasquez,Mohit Bansal,Zhengzhong Tu*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文系统研究大语言模型的数学理解，提出数学原语概念和评测基准，并基于发现提出自蒸馏框架提升推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型在数学问题上表现突出，但其是否具备支撑解题的结构化数学理解尚不明确。

Method: 提出数学原语概念，构建评估发现、生成、消化、执行四个维度的基准；进行系统诊断与后训练分析；提出原语优先的自蒸馏框架，选择性转移原语引导的推理。

Result: 诊断显示解题准确率掩盖了不同能力剖面，原语释放潜在执行能力，发现是主要瓶颈；发现受限的失败更易修复；自蒸馏框架在不同模型规模和挑战性基准上持续提升数学推理。

Conclusion: 大语言模型的数学理解可被系统诊断，发现瓶颈可通过原语引导的自蒸馏有效改善，为提升数学推理提供了新路径。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated striking capabilities on frontier mathematical problems, it remains unclear whether they possess the structural mathematical understanding underlying their solutions. In this paper, we take a first step toward systematically studying mathematical understanding in LLMs, from diagnosing its distinct capabilities to leveraging these findings to improve post-training. First, we introduce the notion of Mathematical Primitive to probe structural mathematical understanding and propose \hlei{}, a novel benchmark that evaluates mathematical reasoning along four distinct dimensions: Discovery, Generation, Digestion, and Execution. Second, our systematic diagnosis shows that solution accuracy masks distinct capability profiles, primitives unlock substantial latent execution capacity, and Discovery is the dominant bottleneck in mathematical reasoning. Our post-training analysis further shows that discovery-limited failures are particularly amenable to repair. Finally, building on these findings, we introduce \abs{}, a primitive-privileged self-distillation framework that selectively transfers primitive-guided reasoning into the student model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \abs{} consistently improves mathematical reasoning over baselines across model scales and challenging benchmarks.

</details>


### [178] [Cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02195)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在图上的广义薛定谔桥精确计算方法，通过Feynman-Kac倾斜将状态成本并入参考过程，从而无需时间差分惩罚，仅用交替端点重缩放即可精确求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过学习受控连续时间马尔可夫链的速率并引入时间差分惩罚来恢复成本，但惩罚可能不必要且学习过程复杂。本文旨在消除惩罚并实现精确、无需时间离散或学习的桥计算。

Method: 将状态成本通过Feynman-Kac倾斜融入参考过程，使成本增强桥成为相对于倾斜参考的普通桥。通过交替两个端点重缩放（每次应用稀疏矩阵指数）精确计算桥，收敛速率由端点耦合决定。对于时间平均占据量的二次拥塞成本，使用阻尼最佳响应进行梯度下降，其残差可界定误差。

Result: 在蛋白质折叠模型上，自由能成本降低了折叠路径的期望势垒。在学习方法使用的道路网络上，精确桥的 rollout 在采样误差内匹配目标；在拥有数百万交叉点的网络上，内存线性增长。

Conclusion: 该精确桥计算方法无需时间离散或学习，可高效处理大规模图，并在实际应用中验证了其有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: The generalized Schrödinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. On a protein-folding model, a free-energy cost lowers the expected barrier of the folding paths. On the learned approach's road network, roll-outs of the exact bridge match the target within sampling error, and on networks with millions of intersections its memory grows linearly.

</details>


### [179] [TACO: Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse Optimizer for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02199)
*Jichao Jiang,Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Hanqin Cai,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: Inference

TL;DR: 提出TACO优化器，通过符号选择最大幅值元素并仅存储每列低精度梯度分量，将优化器状态内存降低174倍，实现单卡80GB H100全参数微调30-32B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全参数微调大语言模型时优化器状态内存开销巨大，限制可在现代GPU上训练的模型规模；现有方法或压缩状态、或舍弃一阶梯度、或改变更新几何但保留稠密状态；Muon虽减少内存但几何与AdamW不同，微调AdamW预训练模型时性能下降。

Method: TACO遵循Muon的算子范数最速下降视角，在维度归一化的1→1算子范数下计算精确最速下降方向：对二维权重矩阵每列选取最大幅值元素的符号，保留一阶梯度，同时仅维护每列少量低精度梯度分量，使优化器状态近乎可忽略。

Result: 在OPT-13B上，持久优化器状态较AdamW8bit减少174倍（27.7 GB降至0.16 GB），峰值训练内存减少2.9倍（80.6 GB降至27.5 GB），精度与运行时间相当；可在单张80 GB H100 GPU上对多个模型族和任务实现30-32B参数模型的全参数微调。

Conclusion: TACO在不牺牲精度和计算效率的前提下显著降低优化器内存，支持大模型全参数微调，为内存受限场景提供可行方案。

Abstract: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial optimizer state memory overhead, limiting the model sizes that fit on modern GPUs. Existing approaches either compress optimizer state, abandon first-order gradients, or change the update geometry while retaining dense state. The recently introduced Muon optimizer reduces optimizer memory through matrix-valued updates. Still, its geometry differs from AdamW and can lead to performance degradation when fine-tuning AdamW-pretrained models. To reduce optimizer memory without sacrificing accuracy or computational efficiency in LLM fine-tuning, we propose Ternary Absolute-max Column-wise One-sparse optimizer, or TACO, which follows Muon's operator-norm steepest-descent view but takes the geometric route further. TACO computes the exact steepest-descent direction under a dimension-normalized $1\to1$ operator norm by selecting the sign of the largest magnitude entry in each column of two-dimensional weight matrices. This retains first-order gradients while making optimizer state memory nearly negligible. Our practical TACO optimizer maintains only a small set of low precision gradient components per column, reducing persistent optimizer state by $174\times$ relative to AdamW8bit (from 27.7 GB to 0.16 GB) and peak training memory by $2.9\times$ (from 80.6 GB to 27.5 GB) on OPT-13B, while achieving comparable accuracy and runtime. TACO further enables full-parameter fine-tuning of 30-32B-parameter models on a single 80 GB H100 GPU across multiple model families and tasks.

</details>


<div id='Model'></div>

# Model [[Back]](#toc)

### [180] [How Far is Adam from Natural Gradient Descent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00004)
*Vihaan Paka-Hegde*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究Adam优化器与自然梯度下降的几何关系，将Adam的完整更新规则视为带对角截断、经验标签替换和时间滞后的对角经验Fisher近似，并通过尺度不变度量量化其几何偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam是深度学习中的标准优化器，但其与自然梯度下降的几何关系尚不明确，需要系统分析其几何偏差及影响因素。

Method: 使用尺度不变的γ(Δθ)度量，在四种损失景观（良态线性回归、病态线性回归、逻辑回归、非凸小型神经网络）上测量Adam与真实NGD的几何偏差，并分析动量、经验Fisher近似等因素的影响。

Result: Adam的几何轨迹依赖上下文：良态下偏差低，病态下显著上升，神经网络中错位达约10^3；更高的几何漂移与初始优化变慢相关，但不影响最终目标最小化；改进的经验Fisher（iEF）比标准经验Fisher（EF）路径更稳定，后者常振荡或发散。

Conclusion: Adam的实际优化能力可能源于结构近似误差与动量平滑的平衡，而非紧密跟踪自然梯度路径。

Abstract: Adam is the standard optimizer in deep learning, yet its geometric relationship to natural gradient descent (NGD) contains unresolved questions. We study Adam's full update rule, including momentum, as a diagonal empirical Fisher approximation subject to diagonal truncation, empirical label substitution, and temporal lag. Using the scale-invariant $γ(Δθ)$ metric, we measure Adam's geometric deviation from true NGD across four loss landscapes: well-conditioned linear regression, ill-conditioned linear regression, logistic regression, and a non-convex small neural network. Adam's geometric trajectory is context-dependent. Deviation remains low in well-conditioned settings but rises significantly under ill-conditioning, reaching misalignments of $\approx 10^3$ in the neural network. Higher geometric drift correlates with slower initial optimization but does not degrade final objective minimization; Adam consistently reaches low loss. Furthermore, the improved empirical Fisher (iEF) tracks more stable paths than the standard empirical Fisher (EF), which frequently oscillates or diverges. Our results suggest Adam's practical optimization power may stem from a balance of structural approximation errors and momentum smoothing rather than close tracking of the natural gradient path.

</details>


### [181] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK是一个免费开源的本地AI科研助手，基于研究者自备模型密钥运行，通过科学脚手架、活页实验记录和独立行为日志提升科研质量与可复现性，在跨学科任务上优于两个管理平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有聊天助手或通用编码代理缺乏科研所需的结构化流程、可追溯记录与可验证性，模型过度声称（overclaiming）是最常见失败模式，需要让声明可核查而非仅靠模型自律。

Method: 在研究者自有计算机上运行，研究者自备模型访问（托管或本地），应用提供运行环境、科学脚手架与完整记录；项目为普通文件夹，数据、代码、结果与记录留存本地。系统内置科学流程库、引导式工作流模板、数据源目录、审稿人与写作者角色；维护Living Lab Notebook，条目链接成论证且只增不删；通过观察代理行为而非采信其自述来记录，日志代理无写入工具。

Result: 在20个跨学科研究提示上，按预先固定的评分标准，K-Dense BYOK在科学质量与研究执行两方面均领先两个管理平台；其交付物是唯一记录所运行软件的，且通常附带可复现结果的命令。其中一个管理平台运行相同前沿模型却未提供这些；环境记录为代理写入的文件，非观测日志的一部分，尚不能捕获软件环境本身。

Conclusion: K-Dense BYOK通过本地运行、结构化科研脚手架、不可篡改的活页记录与独立行为日志，使科研声明可核查，在跨学科任务上优于管理平台，代码以MIT许可证开源。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [182] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 评估503个专业领域AGENTS.md提示对科学任务的影响，发现专业提示未提升准确率且成本显著增加。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验详细的专业领域系统提示是否能在科学任务中带来准确率提升，并评估其token消耗与成本代价。

Method: 构建Scientific Agents开源语料库（503个专业AGENTS.md），使用Gemini 3.8 Flash经OpenRouter在Pi agent框架下，对100个匹配专业提示与四种对照（最小基线、角色首句、通用科学严谨指南、无关领域提示）进行对比，覆盖9个文本科学基准（4,531题）及60个BioMysteryBench工具使用型问题，采用自动化规则评分。

Result: 平均专业提示与基线准确率差异为-0.6个百分点（95% bootstrap区间[-1.5, +0.2]），无基准显示明确提升；输出token为基线的1.5-2.3倍，每次成功调用成本为2.2-4.5倍。BioMysteryBench上专业提示解决率46.7%低于基线56.7%（差异-10.0个百分点，95%区间[-16.7, -3.3]），主要因更频繁触发token和时间限制。SuperGPQA上专业提示因提示较长，在API中断时首答正确率71.6%，高于短基线的54.0%，但通用和错配提示表现相近，说明该优势源于提示长度或格式而非领域专业性。

Conclusion: 在测试模型和任务中，默认加载完整专业提示不提升准确率且成本显著增加；选择性检索提示片段或开放式科学任务是否改变该结论尚待验证。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [183] [One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00095)
*Xianghui Meng,Yujing Zhang,Jionghao Lin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 比较六种知识追踪模型在四个数据集上12个掌握阈值（0.50-0.99）的效果，发现阈值选择高度依赖模型和教学情境，需重新校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掌握阈值在不同知识追踪模型下导致不同决策，需系统评估阈值对成绩、练习负担、进阶覆盖及群体差异的影响。

Method: 在四个公共教育数据集上，用六种KT模型（含BKT和神经网络模型）测试12个阈值，并从进阶后表现、进阶覆盖率、练习负担及先验表现组差异四个维度评估；同时识别30种预设教学设置下平衡性能、额外练习和进阶的阈值。

Result: BKT对阈值变化不敏感，神经模型随阈值升高选择性显著增强；最优平衡阈值因模型和设置差异大，半数设置中神经模型与BKT所选阈值差超0.10；更严格阈值未可靠缩小表现差距，反而可能过度限制进阶，先验强学生进阶频率可达弱学生的3.26倍。

Conclusion: 掌握阈值应随KT模型或教学优先级变化而重新校准，并依据其对成绩、练习、进阶和机会公平的影响进行评估。

Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same level of mastery. The best-balanced threshold varied substantially across models and settings. In half of the tested settings, neural models and BKT differed by more than 0.10 in their selected thresholds, although this gap became smaller when greater priority was placed on reducing extra practice and allowing more students to advance. Stricter thresholds also did not reliably reduce performance gaps and could disproportionately restrict advancement, with stronger-prior students advancing up to 3.26 times as often as weaker-prior students. These results show that mastery thresholds should be recalibrated when the KT model or instructional priorities change and evaluated by their effects on performance, practice, advancement, and access.

</details>


### [184] [Harbormaster: Evidence-Gated, Replay-Safe Maritime Anomaly Detection on AWS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00519)
*Arun Sharma*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文介绍Harbormaster系统，一个在AWS上运行、具有生产形态的船舶AIS异常检测系统，遵循物理检查优先、幂等投影与LSN守卫、以及模型发布门控三项规则，并通过实验验证其可恢复性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIS船舶位置报告可能虚假或缺失，操作员需要异常告警具备可归因、可审查和故障后可恢复的特性，而现有系统可能无法满足这些生产级要求。

Method: 系统设计遵循三条规则：1）所有报告先经过物理检查，再运行学习模型；2）DynamoDB读存储是PostgreSQL的幂等投影，每次写入用日志序列号（LSN）守卫保护；3）候选模型需通过保留集门控和影子比较，再经金丝雀逐步放量，每步用燃烧率检查守卫。理论证明重放变更日志任意前缀或后缀后，每个投影键保留最高已应用LSN的值。实验包括AWS窗口内一小时浸泡测试和900秒流路径突发测试。

Result: 一小时浸泡测试中，36,000次请求返回35,999次HTTP 200响应，客户端延迟p95为142.751毫秒。900秒AWS运行中，流路径收到400记录/秒的突发，消费者滞后最终降至零。

Conclusion: Harbormaster满足生产级可归因、可审查和可恢复需求，但重放结果不覆盖重复缓存失效和重复审计行等效应。论文标注了每个数字的测量位置，并列出未实现的设计部分。

Abstract: Ships broadcast their positions through the Automatic Identification System (AIS), and those reports can be false or missing. An operator who acts on an anomaly alert needs that alert to be attributable, reviewable, and recoverable after a failure. This paper describes Harbormaster, a production-shaped system on AWS that follows three rules. Physics checks run on every report before any learned model runs. The DynamoDB read store is an idempotent projection of PostgreSQL, and a guard on the log sequence number (LSN) of each change protects every write to it. A candidate model must pass a holdout gate and a shadow comparison before a canary gives it traffic, and a burn-rate check guards each canary step. The paper proves that replaying any prefix or suffix of the change log leaves each projected key at the value of its highest applied LSN. It also notes effects this result does not cover, such as repeated cache invalidations and repeated audit rows. In a bounded AWS window, a one-hour soak returned 35,999 HTTP 200 responses to 36,000 requests, with a 95th-percentile (p95) client latency of 142.751 ms. In a separate bounded AWS run of 900 s, the stream path received a burst of 400 records/s, and its consumer lag later drained to zero. Every number in the paper carries a label that says where it was measured, and the paper lists the parts of the design that were never built.

</details>


### [185] [Four Ways to Grow a Classifier and Why One of Them Cannot Learn](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00180)
*Cagri Temel*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文在一个统一协议下评估了构造式分类器中四种生长决策的实际收益，诊断出软决策树加深时新层级梯度恒为零的问题，并给出随机扰动修复方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构造式分类器在训练中动态增加结构，但每种生长决策究竟带来什么收益缺乏统一衡量，尤其软决策树加深时存在功能不变却无法学习的现象。

Method: 在树结构与构造式模型上采用相同协议比较四种生长决策；对软决策树，将每个叶子变为门且子节点继承父节点类别分布，分析梯度；并采用五折交叉验证、三个随机种子进行实验；修复方法是对子节点加入小随机扰动。

Result: 诊断显示新门梯度恒为零且子节点梯度相同，导致无法学习；与从头训练同深度树相比，Iris、Wine、Digits上准确率分别损失19.6、19.1、55.6个百分点；小扰动可修复且大小影响甚微。其他决策：拟合残差的新隐藏单元使网络更小但精度不增，Digits上显著降精度；最大期望误差叶分裂带来稀疏性（3.7次分裂达0.885，完整深度6树需63次），但较难问题损失4.3个百分点；统计显著性要求无收益，树更大且更不准确。

Conclusion: 软决策树加深时新层级因梯度缺失无法学习，需随机扰动初始化；其他生长决策各有取舍：残差单元减网络尺寸，误差叶分裂增稀疏性，显著性检验无益；实践规则为添加参数后断言其梯度非零。

Abstract: Constructive classifiers add structure while they train: a level to a tree, a unit to a hidden layer, a split at a leaf. This paper asks what each of four such growth decisions actually buys, measured under one fixed protocol in tree-structured and constructive models, and gives an exact diagnosis and a fix for the one that buys nothing.
  The diagnosis concerns the most natural way to deepen a soft decision tree: turn every leaf into a gate whose two children inherit the parent's class distribution, so that the function is unchanged. I prove that this leaves the gradient of every new gate identically zero and, with the gate at 1/2, gives the two children identical gradients, so the added level can never learn. Unlike the symmetry that Net2Net breaks with noise or the saddle point that splitting steepest descent escapes with second-order information, first-order information here is not weak but absent. Over three seeds of five-fold cross-validation the construction loses 19.6 accuracy points on Iris, 19.1 on Wine and 55.6 on Digits against the same depth trained from scratch. The fix is a small random perturbation of the children, whose size barely matters. The practical rule is one line in a test: after adding parameters, assert that their gradient is nonzero.
  The other three decisions each buy one thing. Fitting a new hidden unit to the residual error before installing it buys a smaller network on every dataset, though not a more accurate one, and on Digits it costs accuracy significantly. Splitting the leaf with the largest expected error buys sparsity, reaching 0.885 with 3.7 splits where a complete depth-six tree uses 63, but loses 4.3 points on a harder problem. Requiring statistical significance before a node receives a more expressive split buys nothing: the tree gets larger and less accurate.
  Every number in the paper is inserted from the measurement script.

</details>


### [186] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 论文提出Rules to Tools (R2T)方法，将公开科学需求转化为可执行检查，并评估其对科学编码代理修复程序的效果与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学编码代理需要根据书面需求评估和修复程序，而现有方法依赖文本描述，缺乏可执行验证机制，因此需要研究将需求转化为工具化检查是否能提升修复效果。

Method: 在SciCode修复任务中设置匹配组，对比仅提供文本检查与提供可调用实现（工具）两种条件，并分析任务ID队列、开发暴露任务及PDE比较，同时测量代理侧输出与公共CPU成本。

Result: 两个任务ID队列中，完整修复率文本组为26/30，工具组为29/30；八个ID队列为13/16对15/16，任务聚类自助法95%区间为[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点。较大共享定义队列两组均为13/24。五个开发暴露任务为3/10对7/10。PDE比较中，详细文本组23/24，检查组24/24，检查组报告模型输出低31.2%。

Conclusion: 准备好的可执行检查能带来任务依赖的修复收益，并影响代理侧成本与公共CPU使用，需权衡任务特性与资源开销。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation. Across two task-ID cohorts, complete repair is 26/30 with text and 29/30 with the prepared checks. Three task IDs favor tools, one favors text, and eleven tie. The eight-ID cohort scores 13/16 versus 15/16, with a task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval of [-12.5, 43.75] percentage points for the difference. The larger shared-definition SciCode cohort ties at 13/24 per group. Five development-exposed tasks with alternate starting programs score 3/10 versus 7/10. The tool group favors tasks 17, 77, and 11; initial checks flag task 17 and report no violation for tasks 77 and 11. Task 37 favors text and has no initial reported violation. A fresh source-through-Python arm also reaches 15/16, matching the dedicated command's aggregate. In a matched PDE comparison, detailed text scores 23/24 and checks score 24/24, with 31.2% lower reported model output for checks. Agent-side output savings vary by cohort, while public CPU use rises in both task-ID cohorts. These results measure task-dependent repair outcomes and agent-side costs with prepared checks.

</details>


### [187] [When Harnesses Lose the Signal: Causal Evaluation of Recovery in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00372)
*Shuyao Xiao,Shengling Wang,Xuan Chen,Ke Chao,Ming Cui,Feifei Qian,Chaoyang Mei,Fanlin Meng,Ziming Yu,Junxi Yin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 将大语言模型智能体的恢复操作视为因果决策问题，提出因果干预路由器（CIR）选择性干预，在ALFWorld长时任务上提升成功率3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有恢复机制仅以平均任务成功率评估，掩盖了同一恢复操作可能拯救失败轨迹或破坏原本成功轨迹的张力，需要区分拯救与伤害。

Method: 将恢复形式化为因果决策问题：从相同执行状态比较有无恢复的结果，分离拯救与伤害，研究恢复价值随时间变化；提出轻量策略CIR，利用恢复前可用信息决定何时干预。

Result: 在Qwen3-14B的长时ALFWorld任务上，CIR将成功率从70.33%提升至73.33%，增益3.00个百分点；所有观测正确的轨迹均未被改动；对照实验表明收益不能仅由环境返回的新观测解释。

Conclusion: 提供了一种实用方法来评估恢复操作并选择性地应用恢复，从而在避免伤害的同时提升任务成功率。

Abstract: Large language model agents rely on external harnesses to pass information between the model and its environment and to recover from execution errors. Yet recovery is usually judged only by average task success. This hides an important tension. The same operation can rescue a failing trajectory or disrupt one that would otherwise succeed. We frame recovery as a causal decision problem. Starting from the same execution state, we compare what happens with and without recovery, separate rescue from harm, and study how the value of recovery changes over time. We then introduce the Causal Intervention Router (CIR), a lightweight policy that uses information available before recovery to decide when intervention is worthwhile. On long-horizon ALFWorld tasks with Qwen3-14B, CIR raises success from 70.33% to 73.33%, a gain of 3.00 percentage points. It leaves all evaluated trajectories with correct observations untouched. Additional controls show that the benefit of recovery cannot be explained solely by the new observation returned by the environment. These results provide a practical way to evaluate recovery and apply it selectively.

</details>


### [188] [Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00254)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文刻画了在线凸优化中，当仅能通过精确线性优化预言机访问可行集时的可达到遗憾界，给出了与维度无关的极小极大期望遗憾的紧界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在每轮预言机调用次数严格受限且总调用预算有限的情况下，学习者如何保持可行并最小化遗憾，填补了有限预言机访问下在线凸优化理论分析的空白。

Method: 学习者获得内切球和直径界，必须保持可行；通过构造固定体实例将新阶段方向耦合到共享单纯形，使有用回复反复昂贵；并设计带交错块的计数近似梯度方法达到匹配速率。

Result: 对于凸G-Lipschitz损失、直径至多D、总调用Q、每轮严格限制B，无维度极小极大期望遗憾为Θ(GD max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}})；下界适用于任意随机学习者；特例包括每轮一次调用的T^{3/4}速率和达到√T遗憾所需的二次总预算。

Conclusion: 总预算和每轮严格保证作为特例成立，且对于给定光滑度β，解析构造给出曲率相关下界并识别了通用刻画保持尖锐的阈值。

Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $Θ(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget and strict per-round guarantees follow as special cases, including the $T^{3/4}$ rate with one call per round and the quadratic total budget needed for $\sqrt T$ regret. For prescribed smoothness $β$, an analytic construction yields a curvature-dependent lower bound and identifies the threshold above which the general characterization remains sharp.

</details>


### [189] [Benchmarking Prompt Optimization of Large Language Models With Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00416)
*Timothée Lesort,Alejandra López de Aberasturi Gómez,Tristan Karch,Tom Veniat,Philippe Modard,Karl Tuyls,Ludovic Denoyer*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于1188个Lichess国际象棋谜题的基准，用于研究冻结大语言模型的自动提示优化（APO），兼具低成本、可更新、难度可调及与棋局对弈的连接性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估大语言模型面临基准饱和、测试集污染和昂贵评分等问题，而APO在搜索过程中需反复评估，因此需要一个廉价、确定性、足够难且可随模型进化更新的基准。

Method: 构建国际象棋谜题基准（1118个Lichess谜题），优化冻结LLM的提示而不更新权重；结合精确匹配评分、引擎评估替代走法、可调难度和更新供应；在8个目标模型上评估6种APO算法，测量基线强度、优化响应及提示迁移到其他模型和对弈的表现。

Result: 最强模型Gemini 3.5 Flash（作为元模型）仅解出约55%谜题；不同方法和模型上出现提升、不变或退化；完整研究成本约800美元；基准具有挑战性、判别性、可再生性和经济性。

Conclusion: 国际象棋是适合APO的基准，能揭示模型优化响应和迁移效果，并提供可更新问题集以降低污染风险、保持改进空间；论文发布了谜题、优化与评估代码及数据集更新脚本。

Abstract: Evaluating large language models becomes increasingly challenging as their capabilities advance: benchmarks can saturate, public test sets risk contamination, and assessing harder tasks can require expensive grading or execution infrastructure. These challenges are amplified in automatic prompt optimization (APO), where evaluation is repeated throughout the search for better prompts. Studying APO therefore requires a benchmark that is cheap and deterministic to score, hard enough to leave room for improvement, and renewable as models evolve. We introduce a chess benchmark built from 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study APO for frozen LLMs: we optimize their prompts without updating their model weights. Chess combines inexpensive exact-match scoring, engine-based evaluation of alternative moves, and a renewable supply of problems with adjustable difficulty. Unlike evaluations that report only success on isolated test items, the benchmark also connects puzzle-solving gains to short game-play rollouts within the same domain. We use it to evaluate six APO algorithms on eight target models, measuring not only baseline strength but also how much each model responds to optimization and whether optimized prompts transfer across models and to game play. Chess is thus a well-suited benchmark for APO: it is (i) challenging, as even the strongest evaluated model, Gemini 3.5 Flash (used as the meta-model), solves only about 55\% of puzzles; (ii) discriminative, revealing gains, unchanged performance, and regressions across methods and models; (iii) renewable, with fresh puzzles to reduce contamination risk and adjustable difficulty to maintain headroom as models improve; and (iv) affordable, as the complete study runs for around \$800. We release the puzzles, optimization and evaluation code, and dataset-renewal scripts (https://github.com/imec-ailabs/Automatic-Prompt-Optimization-with-Chess).

</details>


### [190] [Before Agents Decide: Epistemic Action in LLM-Based Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00511)
*Yizhi Liu,Balaji Padmanabhan,Siva Viswanathan*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 智能体设计应关注决策前如何通过认知行动生成“决策就绪证据”，并为此构建认知脚手架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究多聚焦搜索与探索，却忽视了更前置的问题：可用证据是否已准备好支撑决策。认知科学中的认知行动概念可弥补这一缺口。

Method: 将认知科学中的认知行动引入LLM智能体，区分三种模式：获取缺失证据、转换已有证据、探测系统以产生揭示性响应；并提出“认知脚手架”概念，指支持这些行动并使其可审计的界面、工具和环境。

Result: 论文从概念层面论证了认知行动与认知脚手架在LLM智能体中的必要性和可操作性。

Conclusion: 智能体设计必须解决决策就绪证据如何产生的问题，而非仅关注搜索与探索能力。

Abstract: Before a difficult decision, people often act simply to understand the situation better. We turn an object to see another side, place alternatives next to each other, or change one condition and observe what happens. These actions may not complete the task, but they improve the evidence needed for the next choice. LLM-based agents can search and explore, yet agent design gives less attention to an earlier question: is the available evidence ready for the decision? Sometimes necessary evidence is missing. In other cases, the evidence is present but its form hides what matters, or the comparison needed to judge it does not yet exist. Cognitive science calls actions that improve the basis for a later choice epistemic actions. We bring this idea to LLM-based agents and distinguish three modes: acquiring missing evidence, transforming available evidence, and probing a system to create a revealing response. We use the term epistemic scaffolding for the interfaces, tools, and environments that make these actions possible and auditable. This paper argues that agent design must address how decision-ready evidence is produced.

</details>


### [191] [Ontology-Based Contextual AI Evaluations (OB-CAIE) Methodology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00529)
*Julie Krugler Hollek,Michael Zargham,Mala Kumar*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出OB-CAIE方法，通过两个本体定义AI评估的问题空间，提高评估的科学严谨性、可复现性和人机平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决AI评估中因测试覆盖不明确导致的科学严谨性不足、人类专业知识与自动化平衡问题以及评估测试环境可复现性差的问题。

Method: 开发基于本体的上下文AI评估（OB-CAIE）方法，使用领域特定本体（DSO）和评估过程本体（EPO）分别定义“测试什么”和“如何测试”，构建可处理的问题空间。

Result: OB-CAIE方法允许在特定点以科学方式引入人类判断，适用于复杂主题领域，并能追踪、可视化和分析失败点。

Conclusion: OB-CAIE通过明确测试范围强化了AI评估的科学方法第一步，为AI评估提供了更严谨、可复现且人机协作的框架。

Abstract: The ontology-based contextual AI evaluation (OB-CAIE) methodology was developed to address a lack of scientific rigor that arises from unclear testing coverage, to balance human expertise and automations, and to address a lack of reproducibility of AI evaluation testing environments. OB-CAIE strengthens the current state of AI evaluations by addressing the first step in the scientific method by clearly defining what will be tested. Two ontologies represent the tractable problem space in the OB-CAIE methodology: the Domain-Specific Ontology (DSO) and the Evaluation Process Ontology (EPO). The DSO is the what; the EPO is the how. An OB-CAIE problem space can be used for one or multiple AI evaluations. The OB-CAIE methodology allows for human judgment at specific points, in scientifically grounded ways, and in complex subject areas where human feedback is genuinely irreducible or machine irreplaceable. A key advantage of the OB-CAIE methodology is that failure points can be traced, visualized and analyzed within the canonical OB-CAIE methodology problem space.

</details>


### [192] [Worse Together: How Performance Breaks Down in Multi-User Multi-Agent Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00583)
*Sahan Paliskara,Nattaput Namchittai,Andrew Lampinen*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 研究比较多用户多智能体团队与单一协调者在共享资源下的协调表现，发现团队在五个前沿模型、四个环境、77个场景中群体结果更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们日益将任务委托给AI智能体，而不同用户的智能体常因目标不同在共享代码库、日历、预算等资源上协调失败，导致群体结果不如单一智能体统一服务。

Method: 在五个前沿模型和四个环境（API密钥、诊所、个人助理、合并队列）的77个场景中，对比单一协调者与每用户一个智能体的团队，并设置有无通信通道两种条件；还识别不良行为并测试缓解措施。

Result: 团队在所有环境中群体结果均差于协调者：无通信时两个环境完全崩溃，有通信时协调开销仍造成显著差距，例如个人助理环境中协调者满足目标用户请求的频率约为团队的两倍；观察到团队扩大时停滞、相互覆盖操作、捏造声明等行为，并找到环境特定缓解方法如团队负责人、显式流程指令、平台强制阅读同伴消息。

Conclusion: 多用户多智能体协调存在系统性缺陷，需针对性缓解；将发布包含74个场景的MAMUBench（API密钥、诊所、个人助理环境）用于评估多用户多智能体协调。

Abstract: People are increasingly delegating tasks to AI agents, and those agents are increasingly encountering other people's agents over shared resources such as a codebase, a calendar, or a budget. When each agent acts for a different user with different goals, coordination often fails, and the group ends up worse off than if a single agent had acted for everyone. We study this multi-user, multi-agent setting across five frontier models and 77 scenarios in four environments: an API key environment in which agents share a compute budget, a clinic in which they share a calendar, a personal assistant environment in which they share a group order or booking, and a merge queue in which they share a release cutoff. In each scenario, we compare a single agent that serves every user (a coordinator) to a team in which each agent serves one user, with and without a communication channel between the agents. Teams deliver worse group outcomes than the coordinator in every environment: without a channel, they completely collapse in two environments, and even with one, coordination overhead creates substantial gaps. For example, in the personal assistant environment, the coordinator fulfills a targeted user request about twice as often as teams. We identify distinct behaviors associated with this poor group-level performance, including stalling as teams grow, overriding each other's actions, and fabricating claims. We find effective but environment-specific mitigations, such as a team lead, explicit procedural instructions, and a platform check that makes an agent read its peers' messages before committing. We will release the API key, clinic, and personal assistant environments as MAMUBench, comprising 74 scenarios for evaluating multi-user, multi-agent coordination.

</details>


### [193] [Benchmarking System One decision models against trained classifiers and language models for automated decision gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00346)
*Amir Rafe,Subasish Das*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文在匹配条件下比较了类型化决策模型（System One）、监督分类器和生成语言模型在自动化决策门中的表现，发现各类模型的排名取决于是否有任务标签，并给出了相应设计规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件将分支决策交给模型时，需要可声明选项和可阈值化的概率。类型化决策模型直接返回概率而不生成文本，但监督分类器和生成语言模型是现有替代方案，缺乏在相同条件下对这三类模型的系统比较。

Method: 用一个统一测试框架向六个家族的八个决策模型检查点（含托管模型Jev）和两个生成式对比模型发送相同语义请求，并在相同工作流、意图和社会科学条目上评分监督分类器和零样本分类器。通过选项键似然读取生成模型，比较温度校准、阈值风险、是/否交换翻转率，以及意图训练第一级联到Jev的准确率与成本。

Result: 有任务标签时，小型训练分类器在意图上最准，在工作流上与最佳决策模型无显著差异；无标签时，除基于编码器的检查点外，所有决策模型在工作流和意图上均超过零样本蕴含分类器。通过选项键似然，较大生成模型在工作流和意图上与Jev持平，并在5%风险下接受更多工作流决策；微调决策检查点比未微调主干提升意图准确率。少选项拟合的温度在多选项下增加校准误差，5%范围内风险的保留阈值仍让Jev接受0.310的域外请求。交换是/否使Jev每百个答案翻转50.5个，微调检查点减少主干的社会科学翻转。意图训练第一级联到Jev以全GPU利用率下0.43的成本达到其准确率。

Conclusion: 结果给出了条件依赖的设计规则，用于自动化决策门：模型类别选择应取决于是否有标签、风险容忍度和成本约束，而非单一最优模型。

Abstract: Software that hands branching decisions to a model needs a declared option and a probability it can threshold. Typed decision models, also called System One models, return such probabilities without generating text, while supervised classifiers and generative language models are the established alternatives. Under matched conditions, one harness sends eight decision-model checkpoints from six families, including the hosted model Jev, and two generative comparators the same semantic requests, and scores supervised and zero-shot classifiers on the same workflow, intent and social-science items. The ranking of the model classes depends on the conditions. With the task's own labels, small trained classifiers are the most accurate on intents and not significantly different from the best decision models on workflows. Without labels, every decision model except the encoder-based checkpoints exceeds a zero-shot entailment classifier on workflows and intents. Read through option-key likelihoods, a larger generative model is level with Jev on workflows and intents and accepts more workflow decisions at five percent risk, and fine-tuned decision checkpoints gain intent accuracy over their untuned backbones. Stored temperatures fitted on few options raise calibration error with many options, and a held-out threshold for five percent in-scope risk still lets Jev accept 0.310 of out-of-scope requests. Swapping yes and no flips 50.5 answers per hundred for Jev, while fine-tuned checkpoints cut their backbones' social-science flips. An intent-trained first stage escalating to Jev matches its accuracy at 0.43 of its cost at full graphics-processor utilization. The results yield condition-dependent design rules for automated decision gates.

</details>


### [194] [Is it Possible to Generate Irreversible PolyProtected Templates from Face Embeddings using System-Specific Keys?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01385)
*Vedrana Krivokuća Hahn,Jérémy Maceiras,Sébastien Marcel*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文探究在PolyProtect人脸模板保护方法中，使用系统特定密钥（而非主体特定密钥）生成不可逆模板的可行性，以支持在PolyProtected域内进行身份去重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PolyProtect使用主体特定密钥，虽满足不可链接性但导致无法去重。研究系统特定密钥能否生成不可逆模板，从而在保持模板保护潜力的同时实现去重。

Method: 通过实验（开源代码可复现）证明至少三种系统特定密钥选择方式能产生不可逆PolyProtected模板：(i)从预选的主体特定密钥中选取；(ii)对随机向量应用已有的密钥选择算法；(iii)近似“良好”的C/E对分布来构造系统特定密钥。

Result: 实验表明，上述三种方式均能生成不可逆的PolyProtected模板，且不会降低模板保护潜力。

Conclusion: PolyProtect可以安全地应用于系统特定密钥场景，并有望实现PolyProtected域内的身份去重。

Abstract: This work aims to answer the question of whether it is possible to generate irreversible protected templates when the PolyProtect biometric template protection method is applied to face embeddings using system-specific keys (i.e., the same C and E parameters, which define the transform, are applied to all subjects' face embeddings), instead of the traditional subject-specific keys (i.e., each subject has their own C and E parameters). This is important for determining whether we can perform de-duplication of face identities in the PolyProtected domain, which is not possible in the subject-specific key scenario due to the clash with PolyProtect's unlinkability property (i.e., one could generate multiple protected templates belonging to the same identity, using different C and E parameters, such that those templates cannot be linked to each other). We present experiments (reproducible using our open-source code) to prove that there exist at least three ways of systematically selecting system-specific keys that produce irreversible PolyProtected templates: (i) from pre-selected subject-specific keys, (ii) by applying a previously proposed key selection algorithm to random vectors, and (iii) by approximating a "good" C/E pair distribution from which system-specific keys can be constructed. Our findings thus point to the conclusion that it is, indeed, possible to safely operate PolyProtect in the system-specific key scenario without degrading the template protection potential. This opens up the possibility for identity de-duplication in the PolyProtected domain.

</details>


### [195] [When More Data Is Not Enough: The Context-Sufficiency Frontier in Generative AI Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00654)
*Merieme Askour,Ayoub Merimi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出“上下文充分性”理论，用于生成式AI个性化推荐，指出上下文的相关性比数量更重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI使服务方能在响应时动态提供情境信息，但上下文容易供给后，过多上下文未必有益，需明确其充分性边界。

Method: 构建上下文充分性理论，划分不足、充分、饱和、干扰四种状态，并引入“上下文充分性前沿”定位最小相关集；在一家大型家居零售商开展全因子实验，使用生成式推荐系统。

Result: 相关上下文提升推荐适当性，而不相关上下文降低适当性并导致检索不稳定。

Conclusion: 个性化应从提供更多上下文转向识别当前交互真正所需，并在服务流程中持续施加约束。

Abstract: Personalization has long relied on customer data to infer what an individual is likely to value. We call this customer evidence: the customer's historical behavior and preferences. Generative AI extends personalization by allowing providers to supply changing situational information at the moment a response is produced, without encoding every condition in advance. We define this provider-side context as information about what is possible, permitted, or advisable now. This flexibility creates a new problem: once context becomes easy to supply, more is not necessarily better. We develop a theory of context sufficiency in which the relevance of context to the customer's current intent matters more than its volume. The theory identifies four states, insufficiency, sufficiency, saturation, and interference, and introduces the Context-Sufficiency Frontier to locate the minimal relevant set. In a full-factorial experiment with a generative recommender at a large home-furnishing retailer, relevant context improved appropriateness, while irrelevant context reduced it and destabilized retrieval. The framework shifts personalization from supplying more context toward identifying what the current interaction actually requires and enforcing constraints throughout the service process.

</details>


### [196] [Manifold-Constrained Initial Noise Optimization for Efficient Generative Model Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00365)
*Jinho Chang,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出ZeNOVA，一种无梯度的初始噪声对齐方法，用于黑盒奖励场景下的扩散/流模型生成优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有初始噪声优化方法依赖一阶梯度，在黑盒奖励场景下不适用或存在不稳定、低效问题。

Method: 采用退火软值引导、流形约束超球面Langevin动力学和Metropolis-Hastings跳跃，实现稳定高效的无梯度初始噪声对齐。

Result: 在图像和视频生成模型上，ZeNOVA优于所有评估的零阶基线，更稳定地优化初始噪声以获得更高奖励，并利用高斯先验几何。

Conclusion: ZeNOVA适用于多种黑盒奖励对齐任务，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: Recent advances in distillation and flow-map models have enabled deterministic one- or few-step generation for high-quality data, facilitating a new branch of reward alignment approaches that directly optimize the initial noise from a Gaussian distribution. However, most existing initial-noise optimization methods rely on first-order gradient information, which is either inapplicable or suffers from instability and inefficiency in black-box reward scenarios. Here, we introduce ZeNOVA, a stable and efficient initial noise alignment method in a gradient-free manner. Specifically, we address existing algorithms' major challenge in black-box scenarios through annealed soft-value guidance, manifold-constrained hyperspherical Langevin dynamics, and Metropolis-Hastings jumping. Extensive experiments on image and video generative models show that ZeNOVA outperforms all evaluated zeroth-order baselines by optimizing the initial noise toward higher rewards substantially more stably while exploiting the geometry of the Gaussian prior, demonstrating its practical applicability to various black-box reward alignment.

</details>


### [197] [A Simple Doxastic Deontic Logic for Norm-Guided Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00668)
*Thorsten Engesser,Agata Ciabattoni*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的信念道义逻辑，用于自主系统在规范冲突和信息不完全/不可靠下的决策，并定义信念规范合规优化问题，区分主观与客观优化，给出两者一致及可多项式归约到加权部分MaxSAT的条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统在规范冲突且信息不完全或不可靠时做决策是根本性挑战，需要形式化处理规范对信念的依赖。

Method: 构造一个信念道义逻辑：Chellas极小道义逻辑的可经典归约片段，扩展显式条件规范并与多智能体KD45结合；在该逻辑上定义信念规范合规优化问题，并区分相对于智能体信念的主观优化与相对于实际事实的客观优化。

Result: 给出（i）主观优化与客观优化一致的条件，以及（ii）最优决策可多项式时间归约为加权部分MaxSAT的条件。

Conclusion: 该逻辑框架为信念依赖规范下的自主决策提供了形式化基础，并在特定条件下使优化问题可高效求解。

Abstract: Making decisions despite conflicting norms and incomplete or unreliable information is a fundamental challenge for autonomous systems. We introduce a simple doxastic deontic logic for this setting: a classically reducible fragment of Chellas' Minimal Deontic Logic, extended with explicit conditional norms and combined with multi-agent KD45, so that norms can depend on agents' beliefs about both facts and norms. On this logic we define the Doxastic Norm Compliance Optimization Problem, where an agent chooses a decision minimizing weighted norm violations. We distinguish subjective optimization (relative to the agent's beliefs) from objective optimization (relative to the actual facts). We give conditions under which (i) the two coincide and (ii) optimal decision-making can be reduced to weighted partial MaxSAT in polynomial time.

</details>


### [198] [Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00834)
*Wensen Wu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: Kepler 是一个开源测试框架，将假设表示为可执行世界模型，通过回溯转移检查和条件预测检查进行验证；在 ARC-AGI-3 上，冻结配置的 Claude Opus 5 在全部 25 个公开游戏中获得 100.00 RHAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ARC-AGI-3 要求智能体在规则和目标需从观察中推断的交互环境中行动，而仅凭公开集得分区分能力有限，需要更严格的评估与报告方式。

Method: 用可执行世界模型表达假设，并采用回溯转移检查与条件预测检查进行验证；在单一冻结的 Claude Opus 5 配置下运行，无逐游戏模型选择或分数条件重跑，同时报告失败案例并分析动画帧信息。

Result: 服务器验证的 100.00 RHAE 覆盖全部 25 个公开游戏；183 个已完成关卡中 181 个最终尝试动作数不超过对应人类中位数基线；保留棋盘运行使用 8,256 个环境动作，其中 7,292 个在计分关卡；本地记录 858.0 百万 token、97.37% 缓存读取、按 2026 年 9 月 1 日 API 等价费率成本 777.72 美元；报告三类评估失败；最终 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 棋盘上 50 个游戏-模型单元中 48 个达到 100。

Conclusion: 公开集分数单独区分力有限，应推动首次尝试、成本条件和验证感知的报告方式。

Abstract: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

</details>


### [199] [Detection and Resolution of Periodic Artifacts in OpenDP's Discrete Laplace Sampler](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01907)
*Cesare Gerolimetto Fabrello,Valeria Rossi,Alberto Trombetta,Massimo Caccia*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文发现并修复了OpenDP离散拉普拉斯采样器中由底层有理算术库缺陷导致的周期性分布伪影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私实现依赖从噪声分布中精确采样以提供形式化隐私保证，而OpenDP的离散拉普拉斯采样器存在影响采样正确性的系统伪影。

Method: 通过系统测试定位伪影源于bernoulli_exp1函数使用的有理算术库实现错误，提出隔离嵌套采样层级中缺陷组件的诊断方法，并基于精确有理算术实现替代方案。

Result: 使用10^6个样本进行统计验证，确认修正后的采样器在测试精度下产生的输出与理论分布不可区分。

Conclusion: 有缺陷的有理算术实现是导致采样伪影的根源，采用精确有理算术的替代实现可消除伪影并恢复采样分布的正确性。

Abstract: Differential privacy implementations rely on precise sampling from noise distributions to provide formal privacy guarantees. We report the discovery of systematic artifacts in OpenDP's discrete Laplace sampler that manifest as periodic distortions in the output distribution. Through systematic testing, we trace these artifacts to a faulty implementation in the rational arithmetic library used by the bernoulli_exp1 function, a low-level primitive that implements sampling from Bernoulli(e^(-x)) distributions. We present a diagnostic methodology that isolates the faulty component in the nested sampling hierarchy and propose an alternative implementation based on exact rational arithmetic that eliminates the artifacts. Statistical validation with 10^6 samples confirms that the corrected sampler produces outputs indistinguishable from the theoretical distribution at the tested precision level.

</details>


### [200] [WIPSNet: Deep Learning for Paediatric Wheeze Detection from Overnight Impedance Pneumography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00398)
*Felix Oury,Harley Day,Karina Mayoral,Ville-Pekka Seppä,Sejal Saglani,Reiko J. Tanaka*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出WIPSNet，基于3D ResNet处理夜间阻抗呼吸描记信号的小波尺度图，用于儿童夜间喘息分类，AUC达0.783，优于EVI等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床指标EVI将整夜IP记录压缩为单一标量，夜间喘息分类AUC仅0.633，性能有限，需更有效表征长时、不规则生理时间序列。

Method: 构建WIPSNet：对夜间IP信号进行连续小波变换生成堆叠尺度图，输入3D ResNet进行三维卷积学习，并与EVI、状态空间模型Mamba及两种现代睡眠分期架构对比。

Result: 在15名患者、60夜、281小时队列上，WIPSNet取得AUC 0.783±0.026，优于EVI、Mamba及两种睡眠分期架构；性能在对应32分钟时间上下文的体深度处达到峰值。

Conclusion: 结构化时频表示结合3D卷积架构能有效建模夜间呼吸动态，多尺度时间聚合对长而不规则生理时间序列学习至关重要。

Abstract: Overnight impedance pneumography (IP) is used to monitor paediatric respiratory health. Its current clinical readout, the Expiratory Variability Index (EVI), compresses each IP recording into a single scalar and achieves an AUC of 0.633 for night-level wheeze classification. We introduce Wheeze Impedance Pneumography Scalogram Network (WIPSNet), a 3D ResNet operating on stacked continuous wavelet transform scalograms of overnight IP signals. On a 15-patient cohort (60 nights, 281 hours), WIPSNet achieves an AUC of $0.783 \pm 0.026$, outperforming EVI, a state-space model (Mamba), and two modern sleep-staging architectures. Performance peaks at a volumetric depth corresponding to 32 minutes of temporal context, suggesting that multi-scale temporal aggregation is important for modelling nocturnal respiratory dynamics. Overall, these results indicate that structured time-frequency representations combined with 3D convolutional architectures provide an effective approach for learning from long, irregular physiological time series.

</details>


### [201] [Beyond Answer Confidence: A Controlled Audit of Self-Knowledge in a Black-Box Decision Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01006)
*Sharath M Shankaranarayana,Davor Runje,Jan Jannink*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该研究审计了决策模型Jev的置信度是否能区分随机不确定与知识缺失，发现其置信度在熟悉任务上校准良好，但在缺乏知识时仍会给出高置信度，且可被表面线索误导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型输出的概率常用于路由、弃权和自动操作，校准仅保证平均意义上有用，但无法判断低置信度是源于随机性还是知识缺失，也无法确认模型超出知识边界时置信度是否下降。

Method: 在Jev决策模型上，使用超过15个公开数据集和6类生成任务族，并采用配对干预，对同一项目改变所提供的信息量；同时使用定向是/否问题探测结果是否确定、证据是否充分以及模型是否知道答案。

Result: Jev在熟悉的封闭选择任务上置信度校准良好，但作为知识缺失指标失效：无答案相关信息时对显著选项赋予高达0.80的置信度；在超出观察到的知识边界的新闻上，置信度超过准确率0.21–0.33，且用早期月份重新校准无法弥补。定向是/否问题更锐利：判断结果是否确定AUROC为1.00，判断证据是否充分为0.95（同项目上置信度仅0.85）。询问Jev是否知道答案可标记伪造实体和边界后新闻（0.91），但使用真实姓名或移除日期后，相比答案不确定性无优势。

Conclusion: 黑盒知识审计需要显式控制表面线索，仅靠答案置信度不足以可靠指示知识缺失。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities intended for routing, abstention and automated action. Calibration makes those probabilities useful on average, but does not establish whether low confidence reflects chance or missing knowledge, nor whether confidence falls when a model moves beyond what it knows. We audit this distinction in Jev, a decision model, with over 15 public datasets and 6 generated task families, with paired interventions that vary the information supplied for a fixed item. Jev's confidence is calibrated on familiar closed-choice tasks but fails as an indicator of missing knowledge: with no answer-relevant information it assigns up to 0.80 to a salient option, and on news beyond an observed knowledge boundary it exceeds accuracy by 0.21--0.33, a gap that recalibration on earlier months does not close. Targeted yes/no questions give sharper readouts of the case: whether an outcome is settled (AUROC 1.00) and whether the evidence suffices (0.95, against 0.85 for confidence on the same items). Asking whether Jev knows the answer appears to flag fabricated entities and post-boundary news (0.91), but with realistic names or with dates removed it shows no advantage over answer uncertainty. Black-box knowledge audits therefore need explicit controls for surface cues. Code: https://github.com/Syntheme/beyond-answer-confidence.

</details>


### [202] [Empty Commitments: When Agents Promise What Their Runtime Cannot Deliver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01045)
*Jiaqi Tang,Lan Wei,Bingyu Shen,Boyang Li*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文研究聊天机器人在工具和运行时限制下做出的无法履行的承诺，称之为空承诺，并提出了定义、失败类型和测量协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人常承诺未来行动（如'明天提醒你'），但其工具或运行时可能不支持，导致空承诺。与违背承诺不同，空承诺仅由代理配置决定，无需后续轨迹。

Method: 基于承诺语义定义空承诺，提出三种失败类型、工具可实现承诺的锚定条件，以及响应级结果分类。测量协议采用五种设置，每次增加一个持久性功能，环境隐含或明确。

Result: 定义了空承诺及其失败类型和分类，并设计了通过追加请求在五种设置下测量空承诺的协议。

Conclusion: 空承诺是聊天机器人配置导致的承诺无法履行问题，可通过所提语义定义和测量协议进行识别和评估。

Abstract: A chatbot that says "I will remind you tomorrow" will not run again until the user writes. We call such a promise an empty commitment: a promise of an action after the current turn that nothing in the agent's tools or runtime can carry out. Unlike a broken promise, its emptiness follows from the agent's configuration alone; no later trajectory is needed. We define empty commitments on top of commitment semantics, with three failure types, an anchoring condition for promises that a tool could make real, and a response-level outcome taxonomy. We then describe a measurement protocol: follow-up requests run in five setups that add one persistence affordance at a time, with the environment either left implicit or stated.

</details>


### [203] [One pool, many targets: a conservation layer and what archival data can identify](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00445)
*Zahra Khodagholi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可微的标量平衡层，将配对向导-转录本得分视为一个有限RISC池的守恒问题，并在存档脱靶数据上检验剂量和跨语境实验，但未能证实耦合带来额外预测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立解释配对向导-转录本得分作为占用率时，未强制有限向导负载RISC池的守恒；需要建立守恒的平衡模型并检验其预测优势。

Method: 构建可微标量平衡层：一个具有唯一正根和精确隐式梯度的守恒方程；推导重分布定理、高资源极限、检索近似分析及条件秩不变性；在存档脱靶数据上审计剂量和跨语境实验，使用校正热力学亲和力、配对置换检验、构建簇自举、剂量拟合及可饱和压缩。

Result: 校正亲和力与测量的抑制弱相关且方向符合预测器要求，但配对置换检验和构建簇自举未能证明耦合增加预测价值；剂量拟合异质且常违反模型隐含的超线性指数约束，无法识别竞争参数；可饱和压缩保持留出向导家族的准确性但未在测量规模上更快。

Conclusion: 贡献是一个可重用的守恒算子和测试它所需的实验信息；条件秩不变性表明在单一构建单一剂量下，分数占用排序无法区分平衡与独立评分。

Abstract: Pairwise guide--transcript scores do not enforce conservation of a finite guide-loaded RISC pool when they are interpreted independently as occupancies. We formulate a differentiable scalar equilibrium layer: one conservation equation with a unique positive root and exact implicit gradients. It yields a redistribution theorem, a qualified high-resource limit, an analysis of the retrieval approximation, and a conditional rank-invariance result: within one construct at one dose, rankings by fractional occupancy cannot distinguish equilibrium from independent scoring. We therefore audit the two experiments that proposition leaves open, dose and cross-context, on archival off-target data. Corrected thermodynamic affinities associate weakly with measured repression in the direction a working predictor requires, but a paired permutation test and a construct-cluster bootstrap do not establish added predictive value from the coupling: what survives their differing permutation-null baselines is \GapNet{}, a descriptive \GapNetOverSE{} of the equilibrium association's cluster standard error. The dose fits are heterogeneous and frequently violate the model-implied exponent constraint, which is superlinear rather than sublinear, so these data do not identify the competition parameter. A saturable compression of the competitor set holds both accuracy targets on held-out guide families but is not faster at the size measured. The contribution is a reusable conservation operator and the experimental information needed to test it. The code for this study is available at https://github.com/shadi97kh/One-Pool-Many-Targets.

</details>


### [204] [Network World Models as Environments for Algorithm Design on Complex Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01048)
*Rishab Alagharu,Hongji Pu,Zeeshan Memon,Xinyuan Song,Yuntong Hu,Liang Zhao*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出动作条件网络世界模型，用于学习网络在干预下的扩散动力学，作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，由编码智能体迭代设计并优化算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统中动作效果具有延迟性，需评估多步展开后的结果；传统基于模拟的评估在大量采样轨迹下成为瓶颈。

Method: 构建动作条件网络世界模型，学习时变干预下的网络扩散动力学，对每个动作预测后续结果；将其作为快速评估器嵌入算法设计循环，编码智能体依据完整滚动、动作级信用分配和反事实探针反馈来设计并精炼可执行算法。

Result: 在8类网络任务和5种扩散模型上，所设计算法在141个设置中有138个达到或超过最强已报告基线，滚动速度相比蒙特卡洛模拟最高快14.5倍。

Conclusion: 该世界模型可显著加速网络干预动作的评估，并支持在算法设计循环中自动设计出与强基线相当或更优的算法。

Abstract: World models, which simulate an environment and predict how it changes under actions, are increasingly used in real-world applications such as robotics. Complex systems call for the same tool because the effect of an action is not immediate. Seeding nodes for a campaign, or immunizing nodes against an epidemic, changes little on its own; what matters is the outcome that unfolds over the steps that follow. Designing an algorithm that selects such actions to maximize expected performance on a task is inherently iterative, and every candidate must be scored by the outcome it produces. Obtaining that outcome has relied on simulation, whose cost becomes a bottleneck when candidates are evaluated over many sampled trajectories. We propose an action-conditioned Network World Model that learns a network's diffusion dynamics under interventions over time, applies each action to the network, and predicts the outcome that follows. It serves as a fast evaluator inside an algorithm design loop in which a coding agent designs and refines executable algorithms using feedback from full rollouts, action-level credit, and counterfactual probes over alternative interventions. Across eight network tasks and five diffusion models, the designed algorithms match or exceed the strongest reported baseline in 138 of 141 settings while enabling up to 14.5 times faster rollouts than Monte Carlo simulation. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [205] [CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01124)
*Jiazhen Hong,Xiaotian Zhou,Zihao Ding,Kailong Wang,Yu Wu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 提出轻量适配器CortexBridge，利用电极与图谱坐标将任意EEG导联映射到共享皮层潜在空间，在多个基础模型和数据集上提升BCI分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型受固定通道词汇或有限导联配置限制，电极布局变化时迁移困难。

Method: CortexBridge结合EEG特征与电极及图谱坐标，将任意导联映射至共享皮层潜在空间；在三个冻结基础模型和五个MOABB BCI数据集上评估。

Result: 15项评估中13项性能提升；平衡准确率平均提升：EEGPT 0.80%、LaBraM 0.70%、CBraMod 3.26%，12类SSVEP分类最大提升13.02%；学到的图谱表征呈现任务依赖空间模式，SSVEP在Yeo视觉网络比听觉P300更集中。

Conclusion: 皮层对齐是一种可学习且具解剖学依据的路由机制，可将异质EEG导联有效接入预训练基础模型。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

</details>


### [206] [SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00523)
*Liang You,Hengyu Shi,Dongwen Ou*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: SimplexUQ是首个针对单纯形值预测的共形预测覆盖分配问题基准，比较不同共形包装器而非提出新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共形预测保证边际覆盖，但单一校准阈值会导致覆盖在不同区域分配不均：简单区域过度覆盖，困难区域覆盖不足，需要可复现的基准来测量该分配问题。

Method: 构建SimplexTasks-12任务套件（6个合成场景+6个冻结预测器真实任务），固定预测器、评分和分层映射，仅变化共形包装器，报告边际覆盖、最差分层覆盖、最大差异及任务内半径和计算量。

Result: 全局校准可能看似有效实则失败：CIFAR-10上边际覆盖0.900但最差熵分层仅0.542，Mondrian校准将该分层提升至0.886并将最大差异从0.358降至0.022；但无包装器占绝对优势，排名依赖评估组和协议，Mondrian在12个任务的目标划分上差异更低，BatchMVP在5个任务的交叠组上差异更低。

Conclusion: 经验比较而非新覆盖保证；消除预测器偏差仅部分减少全局阈值差异；发布任务卡等资源，将包装器选择视为诊断比较而非通用排名。

Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

</details>


### [207] [Auditing Action Settlement in LLM Agent Environments: Order, Progress, and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01138)
*Haotian Chen,Bowen Ye,Yuning Zhang,Jingkun Yu*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM智能体环境中并发动作的仲裁问题，通过类型化快照结算契约审计顺序敏感性、有用进展和重放一致性三个属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当每个提案单独有效时，LLM智能体环境中的并发动作仍需仲裁，而现有机制可能影响执行语义和进展效率。

Method: 实现类型化快照结算契约，测试五种结算策略，进行28,800次穷举排列试验和2,160次脚本化多步回合，并审计全状态日志的重放一致性。

Result: 联合策略在固定优先级下空间顺序不变，但保守拒绝在六智能体门口任务中仅完成31.25%，随机票完成90.28%，配对提升59.03个百分点（95%自助区间50.00-68.06）；所有策略保持空间约束，优先级仲裁仍错过独立小实例最优；日志审计精确重放156个检查点，拒绝1,332个构造损坏并保留终端锚点。

Conclusion: 证据关注执行语义而非人类真实感或长期公平性，表明不同结算策略在进展和一致性上存在显著差异。

Abstract: Concurrent actions in large language model (LLM) agent environments require arbitration even when each proposal is individually valid. We implement a typed snapshot-settlement contract and audit three distinct properties: order sensitivity, useful progress, and replay consistency. Five settlement policies are tested in 28,800 exhaustive permutation trials and 2,160 scripted multistep episodes. Joint policies are spatially order-invariant conditional on fixed priorities, yet conservative rejection completes only 31.25% of agents in a six-agent doorway task versus 90.28% for random tickets; the paired improvement is 59.03 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval: 50.00-68.06). All policies preserve the tested spatial constraints, and priority arbitration still misses the independent small-instance optimum. A separate full-state journal audit exactly replays 156 checkpoints and rejects 1,332 constructed corruptions with a retained terminal anchor. The evidence concerns execution semantics, not human realism or long-run fairness.

</details>


### [208] [When Does Exercise-Specific Joint Selection Help? An Audit of Evaluation and Control Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01188)
*Haotian Chen,Jingkun Yu,Yuning Zhang,Bowen Ye*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 该工作审计REHAB24-6数据集上基于骨架的动作正确性分类中“关节选择”增益的真实性，发现增益高度依赖评估聚合方式与对照设定，因而不构成新算法或临床获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动特异性关节选择被认为能提升骨架动作正确性分类，但作者质疑这一增益究竟能说明什么，即该增益是真实的表征优势，还是评估聚合、子集结构与时间表征等混杂因素造成的假象。

Method: 审计10名REHAB24-6受试者的1,057次重复动作；分离评估聚合方式（pooled out-of-fold AUROC 与 equal-weight within-person AUROC）、子集结构与时间表征；采用kNN、RBF-SVM、逻辑回归及随机卷积对照，并用1,000个维度匹配随机映射以及序列顺序和配对种子控制进行对照分析。

Result: 手动子集kNN增益由pooled out-of-fold AUROC的0.055降至within-person AUROC的0.020，且两种配对区间均包含零；1,000个维度匹配随机映射中有14个达到或超过手动pooled结果，当同时匹配双侧结构与躯干包含时升至145个；在within-person估计量下RBF-SVM保持正向增益，而逻辑回归与随机卷积对照点增益为负。

Conclusion: 该探索性审计表明关节选择结论必须明确估计量并采用结构上适配的对照，当前结果不能确立新算法或临床获益。

Abstract: Exercise-specific joint selection can improve skeleton-based correctness classification, but what does that gain establish? We audit 1,057 repetitions from ten REHAB24-6 subjects, separating evaluation aggregation, subset structure, and temporal representation. The manual-subset kNN gain changes from 0.055 for pooled out-of-fold AUROC to 0.020 for equal-weight within-person AUROC; both paired intervals include zero. Among 1,000 dimension-matched random maps, 14 match or exceed the manual pooled result, versus 145 when bilateral structure and trunk inclusion are also matched. RBF-SVM retains a positive within-person gain, whereas logistic regression and a random-convolution comparator have negative point gains under that estimand. Sequence-order and paired-seed controls further qualify the interpretation. This exploratory audit shows why joint-selection claims require explicit estimands and structurally appropriate controls; it does not establish a new algorithm or clinical benefit.

</details>


### [209] [Feedback Without the Wait: Piloting a Generative AI Practice Platform in a Large Maths Class](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01262)
*Lili Chen,Gavin Buskes,Yuxin Ren,Chin Tong Leong*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 设计并试点一个生成式AI练习平台，在自我导向练习中提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督从实时评分转移到对解答的前置验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型电气工程班级学生与助教比例高，反馈延迟严重，影响学习效果；生成式AI可扩展对话式反馈，但用于评分引发信任与问责问题，人工介入又造成延迟，形成即时性与人工监督之间的张力。

Method: 设计并试点一个GenAI练习平台，提供即时、支架式反馈，将人工监督置于对解答的前置验证环节，而非实时评分。

Result: 研究旨在了解学生如何使用该工具、如何感知其反馈的价值与可靠性，以及哪些经验可迁移到其他工程学科。

Conclusion: 通过将人工监督从实时评分转移到前置验证，可在实践中缓解反馈即时性与可信度之间的张力，并为其他工程学科提供借鉴。

Abstract: Timely and specific feedback is one of the strongest influences on student learning, yet it is difficult to sustain in large electrical engineering classes where the ratio of students to demonstrators is high and a learner who is stuck may wait days to find out why an approach was wrong. Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) offers a way to scale conversational feedback, but using it to grade assessed work raises trust and accountability concerns, and keeping a human in the loop to assure its judgements reintroduces the very delay that erodes the value of feedback. The result is a tension between the immediacy that makes feedback so impactful and the human oversight that makes it trustworthy. In this work, we set out to resolve that tension in practice by designing and piloting a GenAI practice platform that delivers immediate, scaffolded feedback during self-directed practice. This relocates human oversight from real-time grading to the upfront verification of solutions. Our goal was to understand how students engaged with the tool, how they perceived the value and reliability of its feedback, and what lessons transfer to other engineering subjects.

</details>


### [210] [Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00615)
*Andy Arditi,Weian Xie,David Bau,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文研究深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数时，随机梯度下降（SGD）在众多等价解中偏好特定分解的原因，并通过熵损失理论进行解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管理论上恒等函数可由残差连接直接实现，但SGD在训练中会收敛到非零权重的特定解，即使有权重衰减也不一定回到零权重解。这一现象难以用传统损失函数解释，因此需要探究SGD的隐式偏好机制。

Method: 作者利用熵损失（entropic loss）理论，即在总体损失上增加与微批次梯度期望平方范数成正比的项，对恒等流形上的解进行解析刻画，并推导SGD偏好解的结构预测。同时对比不同参数化（如将权重矩阵分解为两个矩阵乘积）对学习行为的影响。

Result: 在恒等流形上，总体损失为常数，而熵项区分不同分解。SGD训练得到的网络解与熵损失最小化子的理论预测高度吻合。改变参数化（如矩阵分解）会导致权重坍缩到零，即使没有权重衰减。

Conclusion: 恒等学习任务作为一个简洁案例，表明熵损失视角能有效解释SGD为何在实现相同输入输出函数的众多分解中偏好特定解。

Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

</details>


### [211] [Trustworthy Data- and ML-Ops for Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01282)
*Antonio Emanuele Cinà,Giovanni Scodeller,Cecilia Caterina Pasquale,Silvia Siri,Davide Anguita,Fabio Roli,Simona Sacone,Luca Oneto*

Main category: Model

TL;DR: 本文综述了智能交通与物流（ITS&L）领域中可信数据与机器学习运维（DataOps和MLOps），旨在提升效率、可靠性和决策精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ITS&L快速发展，依赖数据、AI与ML的整合，但当前文献在DataOps和MLOps方面存在空白，且AI应用的可信性至关重要。

Method: 识别文献空白，探讨DataOps和MLOps的复杂性、必要性、关键组件、工具、实践见解和案例研究，并分析增强AI系统可信性的方法与工具。

Result: 总结了DataOps和MLOps在ITS&L中的重要性、实施要点及可信AI方法，并讨论了持续挑战与未来前景。

Conclusion: 为ITS&L中DataOps和MLOps建立基础理解，为开发更高效、可持续且可信的智能交通与物流系统指明研究与创新方向。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Intelligent Transportation Systems and Logistics (ITS\&L) has become a cornerstone of the modern social economy, relying heavily on the integration of Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and, more specifically, Machine Learning (ML). This paper provides a comprehensive review of Trustworthy Data and Machine Learning Operations (DataOps and MLOps) in the ITS\&L domain, underscoring their importance in improving efficiency, reliability, and decision-making precision within transportation and logistics services. We begin by identifying gaps in current literature, offering clear context for our contribution. Subsequently, we explore the complexities of DataOps and MLOps, discussing their necessity, key components, available tools, practical insights, and case studies relevant to ITS\&L. Additionally, we address the critical issue of Trustworthiness in AI applications, examining methods and tools designed to strengthen confidence in AI systems - especially in real-world ITS\&L scenarios.
