Result: 在GSM8K和Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，128次更新时固定选择器质量0.6329，均匀采样0.5482，格式反馈0.6037；仅元数据交叉拟合校准在八种子下达到0.6476±0.0139（中位数0.6481，配对95%区间[+0.079,+0.122]），目标运行token为63,276，记录总成本189,642 token和3.48 GPU小时；完整FAER-UTILITY达到0.6624，目标运行token为62,844，GPU小时为4.26；格式反馈选择的记录正确率0.6953，固定选择器为0.3594。

Conclusion: 完成对比表明，学习器感知效用选择可提升下游学习质量，且缓存级正确率与下游排名存在差异；报告还给出了学习器感知消融、同种子差距、策略优化行和严格零样本迁移结果。

Abstract: Replay selectors often rank cached trajectories by format feedback, confidence, freshness, or response length, although cache-level correctness and downstream learner utility are distinct objectives. We formalize this selection-to-learning gap and introduce FAER as an auditable full-trajectory replay framework. Its training-free fixed selector is a protocol baseline; FAER-UTILITY is the learner-aware selector fitted on disjoint calibration blocks. The normalized gradient alignment is reported as a baseline, while a disposable optimizer-aware virtual update supplies a magnitude-aware utility surface. The audit contract freezes observed fields and replay traces before evaluation labels are joined. On GSM8K with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the matched learner study reports quality 0.6329 for the fixed selector, compared with 0.5482 for uniform and 0.6037 for format-feedback under 128 updates. Metadata-only cross-fitted calibration reaches $0.6476\!\pm\!0.0139$ over eight seeds (median 0.6481; paired 95% interval $[+0.079,+0.122]$) at 63,276 target-run tokens; its recorded full cost is 189,642 tokens and 3.48 GPU-hours including calibration. The completed FAER-UTILITY row reaches 0.6624 at 62,844 target-run tokens and 4.26 GPU-hours. Format-feedback selects records with correctness 0.6953, compared with 0.3594 for the fixed selector, despite the different downstream ranking. The completed comparison surfaces report the learner-aware ablation, same-seed gap, policy-optimization rows, and strict zero-shot transfer.

</details>


### [287] [T2SPO: Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00388)
*Bo-Wen Zhang,Junwei He,Maoqi Liu,Feiran Li,Song-Lin Lv,Wentao Ma,Rongyi Lin,Shuhan Zhong,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出T2SPO方法，利用成功轨迹为LLM智能体的中间步骤提供步级反馈，在ALFWorld和WebShop上持续优于GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步交互任务中奖励通常仅反映最终结果，无法指导哪些中间决策推动了任务进展，导致策略学习缺乏细粒度监督信号。

Method: T2SPO从成功轨迹中推导剩余距离目标，并与沿途状态表示配对；以这些样本为条件，用预训练TabPFN回归器估计新轨迹中各状态的剩余成功距离，相邻状态间距离估计的变化作为辅助信用分配给各步骤，与任务级监督共同训练；新完成的轨迹持续刷新回归器的上下文而不更新其参数。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，使用1.5B与7B语言模型的实验表明，T2SPO在整体任务成功率上持续优于GRPO。

Conclusion: 利用历史成功轨迹进行步级信用分配，可为LLM智能体提供有效的中间监督，且无需参数更新即可持续吸收新经验，提升多步交互任务表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to learn multi-step behaviors through interaction with their environments. However, rewards in many interactive tasks reflect only the final outcome, providing limited guidance on which intermediate decisions advance the task. Successful training trajectories contain intermediate states that can provide supervision for subsequent interactions. We introduce Trajectory-to-Step Policy Optimization (T2SPO), a method that uses past interaction trajectories to provide step-level feedback for policy learning. T2SPO derives remaining-distance targets from successful trajectories and pairs them with representations of the states visited along the way. Conditioned on these examples, a pretrained TabPFN regressor estimates the remaining distance to success at each state of a new rollout. Changes in this distance estimate across consecutive states yield auxiliary credit for agent steps alongside task-level supervision. As training proceeds, newly completed trajectories refresh the estimator's context, incorporating new experience without updating its parameters. Experiments with 1.5B and 7B language models on ALFWorld and WebShop show that T2SPO consistently improves overall task success over GRPO.

</details>


### [288] [MatrixReward: Reward from Rubric Matrix for Open-Ended Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00389)
*Zihan Shen,Qi Liu,Zixuan Yang,Yiqun Chen,Chenglong Zhao,Xiaozhao Wang,Lei He*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出MatrixReward，利用采样响应间的成对比较构建轮次×评分标准的胜率矩阵，据此生成数据依赖的评分标准权重和相对贴近度奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式查询生成缺乏标准答案，逐点评分标准信息有限，且将多个评分标准判断合并为单一分数可能掩盖同一提示下样本答案间的相对质量差异。

Method: 对每个评分标准下所有采样响应对进行比较，构建rollout-by-rubric胜率矩阵；用各列离散度衡量评分标准区分度，用列间相关性揭示评分标准重复，得到数据依赖权重并与先验权重结合；经列归一化和加权后，由各评分标准观测最大/最小值定义正负理想剖面，以每个rollout到两个理想剖面的距离确定相对贴近度质量奖励。

Result: 在四个开放式查询问答基准上使用Qwen3-8B评估，MatrixReward平均得分63.02，超过最强基线约2.0%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，由相对比较导出的矩阵可为开放式生成强化学习更合理地构建奖励。

Abstract: Open-ended query generation lacks standard answers, thus necessitating an effective reward mechanism. Pointwise scoring rubrics provide limited information about the relative quality of sample answers under the same prompt; merging multiple rubric judgments into a single score may also mask the differences between these answers. We propose MatrixReward, which constructs rewards from a rollout-by-rubric win-rate matrix obtained by comparing every pair of sampled responses under each rubric. The spread of each matrix column captures how strongly that rubric distinguishes the current rollouts, while correlations between columns reveal rubric repetition; together, these statistics yield data-dependent rubric weights. We combine these weights with the prior weights of rubrics. After column normalization and weighting, the observed per-rubric maxima and minima define positive and negative ideal profiles. Each rollout's distances to these two ideals determine its relative-closeness quality reward. Evaluated using Qwen3-8B on four open-ended query-answering benchmarks, MatrixReward achieves an average score of 63.02, outperforming the strongest baseline by approximately 2.0%. These results support the idea that matrices derived from relative comparisons can be used to construct rewards more reasonably for open-ended generative reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [289] [Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00849)
*Pedro Robles Dutenhefner,Dikshant Shehmar,Wagner Meira,Marlos C. Machado*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: GITA通过将价值函数以k为条件并聚合多尺度优势加权监督，解决了离线目标条件强化学习中折扣导致长时程信号消失以及固定时间抽象尺度无法兼顾近距与远距目标的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线目标条件强化学习在长时程任务中面临两大困难：折扣使远距状态价值差异缩小至函数逼近误差以下，导致无法排序状态；时间抽象虽能恢复长距信号，但单一固定k无法适配所有状态-目标距离，大k牺牲近距区分度，小k牺牲远距信号。

Method: 提出广义隐式时间抽象（GITA），将单个价值函数以k为条件，并在多个k值上聚合优势加权监督训练一个策略：对某状态-目标对赋予更大正优势的尺度对该更新贡献更强，从而无需在局部分辨率与长距信号之间做取舍，也无需选定单一k。

Result: 在OGBench上，GITA优于多种离线GCRL基线，相比HIQL平均成功率提升25个百分点（相对提升73%），相比最强固定k方法OTA提升7个百分点（相对提升14%）。

Conclusion: GITA通过条件化价值函数与多尺度优势加权聚合，同时保留局部分辨率与长程信号，在离线目标条件强化学习的长时程任务上取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks. Discounting shrinks value differences between distant states until they fall below the function approximation error, leaving the agent with no signal for ranking states. Temporal abstraction, which treats k environment steps as a single transition, restores this signal at long range, but no single fixed k suits all state-goal distances: large k preserves value differences across long temporal distances while collapsing distinctions between nearby states, and small k does the reverse. We make this trade-off explicit and introduce Generalized Implicit Temporal Abstraction (GITA), which conditions a single value function on k. GITA trains one policy by aggregating advantage-weighted supervision across multiple k values, so scales assigning larger positive advantages to a state-goal pair contribute more strongly to its update. GITA does not need to choose between local resolution and long-range signal; it retains both without committing to a single k. On OGBench, GITA outperforms a broad range of offline GCRL baselines, raising average success rate across all tasks by 25 percentage points (73% relative improvement) over HIQL. It also improves over the strongest fixed-k method, OTA, by 7 percentage points (14% relative).

</details>


### [290] [ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00906)
*Sungho Park,Wonjoong Kim,Jue Zhang,Wook-Shin Han,Pengfei Gao,Chanyoung Park,Yongqiang Yao,Rao Fu,Elsie Nallipogu,Qingwei Lin,Victor Rühle*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出ActiveSaddler，将LLM智能体harness优化中训练场景的选择建模为自动化课程学习问题，用非平稳多臂老虎机动态调整课程，与harness共同演化并获得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有harness优化方法主要改进harness的更新方式，却固定了产生反馈的训练场景；随着harness演化，最有用的场景会变化，因此训练课程也应随之自适应调整。

Method: 将课程学习建模为非平稳多臂老虎机，动态实例化优化目标；把反复出现的失败抽象为可复用的失败模式臂，估计继续针对各模式的学习进展潜力，在 revisiting 已知弱点与探索新场景之间自适应平衡，并持续更新失败模式集合及其优先级。

Result: 在GAIA2和Terminal-Bench 2.0上，相比使用优化前固定场景顺序的同一harness优化器，测试Pass@1分别提升4.4和7.5个百分点；消融实验表明增益依赖动态构建优化目标、估计其演化效用以及平衡持续优化与新失败发现。

Conclusion: 自动化课程学习是harness优化中一个新的关键优化维度，能使课程与harness协同演化，从而发现更强的harness。

Abstract: Automated harness optimization can substantially improve LLM agents by iteratively updating their prompts, tool interfaces, and control logic from execution feedback. However, existing methods primarily optimize how the harness is updated while largely fixing which training scenarios generate the feedback that drives those updates. As the harness evolves, the scenarios most useful for further optimization can change, suggesting that the training curriculum itself should adapt alongside the harness. We formulate this missing dimension of harness optimization as an automated curriculum learning problem and introduce ActiveSaddler. ActiveSaddler models the evolving curriculum as a non-stationary bandit with dynamically instantiated optimization targets. It abstracts recurring failures into reusable failure-pattern arms, estimates the potential learning progress from further targeting each pattern, and adaptively balances revisiting known weaknesses with exploring unseen scenarios for new ones. Optimization outcomes continually update both the set of discovered failure patterns and their priorities, allowing the curriculum to co-evolve with the harness. Experiments on GAIA2 and Terminal-Bench 2.0 show that ActiveSaddler consistently discovers stronger harnesses, improving test Pass@1 by 4.4 and 7.5 percentage points over the same harness optimizer using a scenario order fixed before optimization, respectively. Ablations further show that these gains depend on dynamically constructing optimization targets, estimating their evolving utility, and balancing continued optimization with new failure discovery. Together, these results establish automated curriculum learning as a new crucial optimization dimension for harness optimization.

</details>


### [291] [OR for AI That Does OR: Routing LLMs up the Escalator inside the OSCAR Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00912)
*Jinzhi Bu,Haixin Tang,Huanan Zhang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出OSCAR框架，用离线模拟器、编码器和审查器验证并改进LLM生成的优化模型，通过序贯决策分配不同LLM调用，实现高精度低成本本地化优化建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可将业务描述转为优化模型，但可执行代码可能错误表达约束或目标，导致求解器求解错误问题；即使解满足运营规则，也可能存在更优方案。组织需要准确、低成本、可本地运行的LLM优化建模框架，并需验证改进及在不同价格和能力LLM间分配尝试。

Method: 开发OSCAR（Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer），使用基于标注决策示例认证的离线模拟器比较候选方案，并超越可行性继续搜索。将寻找下一次认证改进建模为难度未知下的序贯决策：调用哪些LLM及何时停止。在已知先验简化设定下给出成本排序升级最优条件；对一般菜单导出无先验竞争保证。

Result: 在五个基准问题上，OSCAR使用两个小型开放权重LLM（各可单GPU本地部署），在报告设置下达到95%至100%准确率；其单次尝试准确率平均为29%和48%。每个问题五次运行中，Codex和Claude Code平均token成本分别为OSCAR的3.1倍和5.8倍。

Conclusion: OSCAR支持开放权重模型本地或云端运行，取决于预算和保密要求。企业应维护可行与不可行决策的标注示例以明确自然语言运营规则；当LLM解释与标签冲突时，OSCAR遵循标签。随着LLM能力和价格变化，OSCAR的简单操作规则和可调设置帮助企业调整模型选择并受益于进步。

Abstract: Large language models can translate business descriptions into optimization models, but executable code may misrepresent constraints or objectives. A solver can then return an optimal solution to the wrong problem. Even when the solution satisfies the intended operating rules, a better plan may exist. For organizations that repeatedly use optimization modeling, an LLM-based framework should produce accurate formulations at low cost and, ideally, run locally. We study how to verify improvements and allocate attempts across LLMs that differ in price and capability. We develop OSCAR (Optimization modeling by Simulator, Coder, And Reviewer), which uses an offline Simulator certified against labeled decision examples to compare candidates and continues searching beyond feasibility. We model the search for the next certified improvement as sequential decisions under unobserved difficulty: which LLMs to call and when to stop. In a simplified known-prior setting, we give conditions under which cost-ordered escalation is optimal. For general menus, we derive a prior-free competitive guarantee. On five benchmark problems, OSCAR achieves 95% to 100% accuracy at the reported settings using two small open-weight LLMs, each deployable locally on a single GPU. Their single-attempt accuracies average 29% and 48%. In five runs per problem, Codex and Claude Code incur average token costs 3.1 and 5.8 times OSCAR's, respectively. OSCAR supports open-weight models locally or in the cloud, depending on budget and confidentiality requirements. Firms should maintain labeled decision examples of feasible and infeasible decisions to clarify plain-language operating rules. OSCAR follows these labels when an LLM's interpretation conflicts with them. As LLM capabilities and prices change, OSCAR's simple operating rules and adjustable settings help firms adapt their model choices and benefit from these advances.

</details>


### [292] [VeriHarness: Scaling Agentic Verification for Long-Horizon Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00972)
*Caiqi Zhang,Rujun Han,Zifeng Wang,Zoey CuiZhu,Nigel Collier,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 VeriHarness，将生成用 LLM 变为智能体验证器，通过分歧解析与共识挑战提升长周期任务的输出验证能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体承担日益复杂的长周期任务，其输出验证愈发困难；在测试时无参考答案或评分标准，且固定基础模型条件下，需要强化验证能力。重复采样虽能产生含互补正确主张的多个 rollout，但缺乏可靠机制判断哪些主张可信。

Method: 先观察到分歧常暴露正确替代项而共识可能掩盖错误；据此构建 VeriHarness，赋予 LLM 工作空间、证据工具与可复用验证技能，使其成为智能体验证器。其中分歧解析器依据环境证据检验竞争性主张，共识挑战器测试共享主张并搜寻遗漏需求，二者结果指导最终产物的选择与修订。

Result: 在五个长周期工作空间基准和两个前沿模型上，VeriHarness 取得所评估基线中最高的选择得分；证据支撑的修订进一步提升平均性能，相较单次 rollout 在 Gemini 3.5 Flash 上提升 6.2 分，在 Claude Opus 4.8 上提升 6.4 分。验证技能还可从失败反馈中自我改进。

Conclusion: VeriHarness 是扩展长周期智能体验证的新颖且关键方法；作者发布覆盖五个基准与两个模型、约 26,000 条 rollout（成本超 10 万美元）以支持后续智能体验证研究。

Abstract: As LLM agents undertake increasingly complex, long-horizon tasks, verifying their outputs becomes increasingly challenging. We study how verification capability can be strengthened with a fixed base model, without access to reference answers or grading rubrics at test time. Repeated sampling yields multiple rollouts that can contain complementary correct claims, but we need a reliable verification mechanism to determine which claims to trust. We first find that disagreement often exposes correct alternatives, while consensus can conceal errors. These observations motivate VeriHarness, which turns the underlying LLM a generator uses into an agentic verifier by giving it a workspace, evidence tools, and reusable verification skills. A disagreement resolver checks competing claims against environmental evidence, while a consensus challenger tests shared claims and searches for omitted requirements. Their findings guide the selection and revision of the final artifact. Across five long-horizon workspace benchmarks and two frontier models, VeriHarness achieves the highest selection scores among the evaluated baselines. Evidence-backed revision further improves average performance, bringing gains over a single rollout to 6.2 points with Gemini 3.5 Flash and 6.4 points with Claude Opus 4.8. We further show that verification skills can self-improve from failure feedback, demonstrating VeriHarness as a novel and critical approach for scaling long-horizon agentic verification. We release the full pool of approximately 26,000 rollouts across all five benchmarks and both models, produced at a cost of over $100,000, to support future research on agentic verification.

</details>


### [293] [VANDAM: Viewing a nucleotide sequence with DNA molecular priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00411)
*Jeremy Levy,Ariel Larey,Yury Nahshan,Raizy Kellerman,Elay Dahan,Amit Bleiweiss,Guy Leib,Omri Nayshool,Dan Ofer,Tal Zinger,Dan Dominissini,Gideon Rechavi,Marissa Wirth,Simon Lee,Dung Hoang,Noam D. Beckmann,Shane O'Connell,Nicole Bussola,Alexander W. Charney,Yoli Shavit,Nati Daniel*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出VANDAM框架，通过引入DNA分子先验增强基因组基础模型的预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型将DNA视为字符串，采用掩码 token 预测目标，未显式建模对生物功能至关重要的生化、结构和物理特性；这些分子特性可由序列通过生物物理模型估计，其价值在于为训练目标提供可利用的先验。

Method: VANDAM在自监督训练中从池化表示预测区域分子特性；当有功能标签且能奖励保留分子先验时，在输入额外注入局部特征。

Result: 在四种架构家族和九项留出基因组任务上，VANDAM通过补充基于 token 的目标，持续提升下游性能；探测实验表明分子先验的使用可泛化到其他未见分子特性。

Conclusion: 显式引入分子先验可有效增强基因组基础模型的训练与下游任务表现。

Abstract: Contemporary Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) rely on a DNA-as-a-string paradigm that employs masked token prediction objectives for pretraining. However, this abstraction does not explicitly model the biochemical, structural, and physical properties essential to biological function. Many molecular properties can be estimated from sequence using established biophysical models, so their utility lies not in providing an independent modality, but in introducing priors that training objectives can explicitly exploit. We introduce VANDAM, a framework that extends the training of GFMs with DNA molecular priors. In self-supervised training, VANDAM predicts regional molecular properties from pooled representations. When functional labels are available and can reward retaining molecular priors, local features are additionally injected at the input. VANDAM consistently improves downstream performance across four architecture families and nine held-out genomic tasks by complementing token-based objectives. Probing experiments further demonstrate that the use of molecular priors generalizes to other unseen molecular properties.

</details>


### [294] [RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00979)
*Jingtan Wang,Sirajul Salekin,Young mok Jung,Javier Movellan,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low,Manjot Bilkhu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出RISED，利用评分表指导多环境LLM智能体的在线数据选择与策略监督，提升跨环境泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多环境强化学习仅依赖标量奖励，无法捕捉跨环境关系，且全成功/全失败组缺乏组内奖励对比信号。

Method: 用LLM评判器基于共享评分表词汇标记每个轨迹，生成行为画像；据此选择与混合环境批次整体行为组成对齐且减少重叠的数据；正向评分表为在线自蒸馏教师提供特权上下文以进行token级监督，负向评分表引导后续生成避开重复失败模式。

Result: 在不同模型骨干上，RISED在跨环境平均通过率最高，且在每个单独环境中排名第一或第二。

Conclusion: 评分表可超越奖励用途，同时指导数据选择和策略监督，有效提升多环境智能体性能并带来可分析的行为变化。

Abstract: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. This motivates richer textual feedback, such as rubrics describing rollout behaviours, to guide learning. Beyond rubrics' usage as reward, we repurpose rubrics to guide both online data selection and policy supervision. An LLM judge tags each rollout using a predefined rubric vocabulary shared across environments. The resulting profiles guide the selection of data that aligns with the overall behavioural composition of the mixed-environment batch while limiting overlap with already-selected data. Available positive rubrics (describing desired behaviours) provide privileged context for an on-policy self-distillation teacher, supplying additional token-level supervision, while negative rubrics (describing undesired behaviours) guide subsequent rollout generation away from recurring failure modes. Together, these components form RISED. Across model backbones, RISED achieves the highest mean pass rate across environments and ranks first or second in every individual environment. Rubric-based analysis of RISED can further characterize the behavioural changes accompanying these gains.

</details>


### [295] [Source Identification Is Not Fitness Testing: Measuring the Limits of Synthetic-Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00417)
*Joss Armstrong*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 研究测试了生成数据溯源信息的可恢复性及其对选择训练数据、缓解模型退化问题的帮助，发现溯源识别在改写后大幅下降，且溯源与基于参考模型评分的选择策略未导致模型退化出现稳定差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重复使用模型生成数据训练会降低后续模型性能，一种可能的应对是利用数据溯源信息决定哪些生成样本可重用，但溯源能否可靠恢复及其是否有助于识别更好训练数据尚不明确。

Method: 使用金融风险文本，先识别生成段落的来源，再在改写后重复测试；比较两种在生成与再训练三轮中选择生成样本的方式：一种利用来源信息，另一种利用独立参考模型的评分。

Result: 原始段落生成器归因准确率98.7%，转述后降至53.1%，风格改写后降至29.0%；生成与人类检测在测试的人类对比集上接近完美。两种选择规则选出的样本不同，但计划比较未检测到所得模型退化存在稳定差异。

Conclusion: 识别数据来源与识别哪些数据对训练有用是两个不同问题；实验区分了来源身份、面向准则的选择和递归训练结果，溯源分数和所测试的面向准则的代理均未被确立为足以预测未来递归行为。

Abstract: Repeated training on model-generated data can degrade later models. One possible response is to use provenance when deciding which generated examples to reuse. We test both how reliably that provenance can be recovered and whether it helps identify better training data. Using financial-risk text, we first identify the source of generated passages and then repeat the test after rewriting them. Generator attribution is 98.7% accurate on the original passages but falls to 53.1% after paraphrasing and 29.0% after style rewriting. Generated-versus-human detection remains close to perfect against the tested human comparison set. We then compare two ways of selecting generated examples over three rounds of generation and retraining. One uses source information. The other uses a score from a separate reference model. The two rules select different examples, but the planned comparison does not detect a stable difference in the degradation of the resulting models. The results show that identifying where data came from and identifying which data are useful for training are separate problems. The experiment therefore separates source identity, criterion-facing selection, and recursive training outcome: neither the provenance score nor the tested criterion-facing proxy is established as sufficient for future recursive behaviour.

</details>


### [296] [The Life Cycle of a Massive Activation: Stochastic Birth, Weight-Decay-Driven Growth, and Competitive Consolidation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00423)
*S. Aaron McClendon,Jorge Gallego-Feliciano,Antonios Saravanos*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文结合训练轨迹分析与控制干预，揭示Transformer中大量激活（与注意力汇相关）的生命周期，并证明权重衰减因果性地调控其全局激活规模的兴衰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量激活（幅度远超典型激活的残差流坐标）与注意力汇相关，但其规模在训练中如何被调控尚不清楚。

Method: 分析训练轨迹并进行控制干预；消融实验；提出平衡模型（AdamW预条件增长与权重衰减对抗）；扫描权重衰减系数λ；进行优化器测量。

Result: 汇承载通道随随机种子变化但早期稳定；训练后期周围通道侵蚀，汇集中于少数冗余载体；梯度衰减跟随汇标记的集体均方根幅度而非单个通道；去除权重衰减使规模在峰值附近继续上升，保留则下降；峰值时间随λ近似对数线性移动，峰值幅度约按λ^{-1/2}缩放；预条件维持大通道群对抗衰减。

Conclusion: 这些发现将大量激活的生命周期与规模调控训练动力学联系起来，确立权重衰减作为调控激活幅度的训练期杠杆。

Abstract: Massive activations, residual-stream coordinates with magnitudes far larger than typical activations, are associated with attention sinks in transformers, but how their scale is regulated during training remains incompletely understood. Combining training-trajectory analyses and controlled interventions, we trace their emergence, growth, and consolidation. Sink-carrying channels vary across random seeds but stabilize early within each run. Over longer training, surrounding channels erode and the sink concentrates onto a few redundant carriers. Across ablations, gradient attenuation follows the sink token's collective root-mean-square magnitude rather than any single channel, making collective scale central to understanding their effects. Our central result is that weight decay causally controls the turnover of global activation scale. In controlled continuations, removing decay near the peak allows this scale to keep rising, whereas retaining it produces decline even at constant learning rate. We develop a balance model for the rise and peak of massive-activation magnitude, in which AdamW-preconditioned growth opposes weight decay. Sweeping the decay coefficient $λ$ shifts peak timing approximately log-linearly and yields peak magnitudes scaling approximately as $λ^{-1/2}$, consistent with this balance. Optimizer measurements further show that preconditioning sustains the large-channel cohort against decay even when raw maintaining forces are too small to do so. Together, these findings connect the observed life cycle to scale-regulating training dynamics and establish weight decay as a training-time lever on activation magnitude.

</details>


### [297] [Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01017)
*Xuehang Guo,Haoyu Wang,Shengyu Chen,Zach Chen,Wei Cheng,Qingyun Wang,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出InFlowOp框架，用无标签统一成本量化多智能体工作流中的每个决策，动态决定任务分解粒度、智能体分配及故障修正，并发布Braid基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建LLM多智能体工作流时，任务细分粒度、智能体信任分配、新专家创建时机等决策均需预先确定，但子任务成功与否运行前未知；改进工作流成本高昂，定位故障通常需参考、评分或训练评估器，且修复需重执行或重训练。

Method: InFlowOp将每个决策定价为无标签成本，衡量智能体能力与子任务需求的匹配度及运行代价；执行前双向确定任务分解粒度与智能体分配，执行中基于同一成本以最廉价操作修正故障；同时提出Braid基准，其任务需超越单智能体的多智能体协作。

Result: 跨领域与骨干模型，InFlowOp较单智能体基线最高提升11.97%，流内优化实现9.64%提升。

Conclusion: InFlowOp以统一成本贯穿工作流构建与运行，实现无标签动态优化，显著优于单智能体基线，并公开项目页面。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly construct multi-agent workflows that decompose a complex task and assign specialist agents from a pool. However, building such a workflow well remains challenging: how finely to divide the task, which agent to trust with each subtask, and when to create a new specialist are all critical decisions a workflow constructor needs to settle up front. Thus, whether each subtask succeeds remains unknown until the workflow runs. Yet, improving a workflow is costly. Locating a fault usually requires a reference answer, a graded outcome, or a trained assessor, and the fix is applied to the whole workflow through re-execution, re-search, or retraining. We propose InFlowOp, which prices every decision in one label-free cost that weighs how well an agent's competence meets what a subtask demands against how much that agent takes to run. Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template. During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs. Facing the workflow-level evaluation challenge, we introduce Braid, a benchmark whose tasks require multi-agent coordination beyond single-agent capability. Across various domains and backbones, InFlowOp outperforms single agent baselines by up to $+11.97\%$, achieving $+9.64\%$ with in-flow optimization. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/InFlowOp/.

</details>


### [298] [Every Batch Is Its Own Validation Set: Leave-One-Out Gradient Matching for Online Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00436)
*Hongyu Chen,Xinyi Luo,Ming Zhao,Lin Tang,Zihan Xu,Jing Li,Yuxuan Wang,Haoran Deng,Wei Zhang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了在线批选择中样本内梯度匹配为何难以超越全批训练，并提出无偏的留一法目标LOOM，通过去除梯度Gram矩阵对角线并按信噪比加权选样，显著提升微调效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线批选择旨在从每个候选批中挑选最有用的样本进行语言模型微调。基于梯度匹配的选择器无需留出数据，具有吸引力，但实际很少能超越全批训练，其失败原因尚不明确。

Method: 作者从理论上指出，样本内梯度匹配将每个样本自身作为目标的一部分，导致目标函数将样本自身的梯度噪声计入其贡献，形成协方差惩罚并位于梯度Gram矩阵对角线上，从而偏向噪声大的样本并使全批成为最优解。为此提出留一法目标：对每个样本，利用其他候选样本作为独立同分布样本，移除对角线后得到对总体梯度更新误差的无偏估计。该目标的极小值按梯度信噪比（SNR）加权样本，并在SNR异质性足够时，半批样本可产生比全批更低误差的更新。基于此实现LOOM，在普通反向传播中计算Adam预条件子度量下的Gram矩阵，以(1-e^{-γ})保证贪心选择加权子集，且无需留出数据。

Result: 在四个微调任务和七个1.5B至8B参数的骨干模型上，LOOM优于全批训练：在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上分别提升2.3和2.4个点；超过所有样本内梯度匹配器2.4个点，超过验证集引导的GREATS和OPUS 1.6–2.0个点；对注入标签噪声的选择率低于其基础率的五分之一。

Conclusion: 样本内梯度匹配因对角线协方差惩罚而次优，移除对角线得到的留一法无偏目标能按梯度信噪比选样，LOOM据此在多种模型和任务上稳定超越全批训练及现有选择方法，且无需留出数据。

Abstract: Online batch selection fine-tunes a language model on the most useful part of each candidate batch. Selectors that match the gradient of the candidate batch are attractive because they need no held-out data, yet they rarely beat training on the whole batch. We show why. In-sample gradient matching uses every example as part of its own target, so its objective credits each example with its own gradient noise. This is the covariance penalty that makes training error optimistic, now sitting on the diagonal of the gradient Gram matrix: it steers selection toward the noisiest examples and makes the full batch the best solution the objective can reach. The fix costs nothing. For each example, the other candidates form an independent sample of the data distribution, so removing the diagonal turns the matching objective into an unbiased estimate of the update's error with respect to the population gradient. The minimizer of this leave-one-out objective weights examples by their gradient signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and whenever per-example SNR is heterogeneous enough, half of a batch yields a lower-error update than the whole batch; we give the exact condition. We build \method{} on this principle. It computes the Gram matrix in the metric of the Adam preconditioner during the ordinary backward pass, selects a weighted subset greedily with a $(1-e^{-γ})$ guarantee, and uses no held-out data. Across four fine-tuning tasks and seven backbones from 1.5B to 8B parameters, LOOM improves on full-batch training by 2.3 and 2.4 points on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, exceeds every in-sample gradient matcher by 2.4 points and the validation-guided GREATS and OPUS by 1.6--2.0, and selects injected label noise at under a fifth of its base rate.

</details>


### [299] [Exact information accounting for SGD methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00446)
*Akshay Balsubramani*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文从信息论角度对随机梯度下降（SGD）及其变体进行了精确分析，将预条件SGD步解释为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，并将一步遗憾分解为内在时间成本与比较器信息变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准几何分析无法充分解释SGD及其变体的行为，作者希望提供一种替代性的信息论分析框架，统一解释收敛性、泛化、学习率调度、自适应优化器以及多种SGD变体。

Method: 将预条件SGD步建模为高斯贝叶斯模型的后验均值更新，推导一步遗憾的分解恒等式，并扩展至目标函数本身；在合成数据和真实训练运行中测量各项；分析梯度自由SGD的曲率预条件子；推导基于锐度的泛化证书。

Result: 凸收敛、严格鞍点逃逸、平坦性与泛化联系、标准学习率调度、自适应优化器及噪声、动量、重尾、梯度自由等SGD变体均对应恒等式中的某项或特例；在真实网络上，该恒等式将经典收敛界的松弛归因于推导中丢弃的项，并能区分达到相同训练损失的优化器；区分依据是步数的数量和一致性，而其与泛化好坏的关系因网络而异；梯度自由SGD的恒等式确定了曲率预条件子如何进入更新。

Conclusion: 该信息论恒等式为SGD及其变体提供了统一分析工具，但基于锐度的泛化证书在数据独立各向同性先验下，除非曲率谱在所有参数上几乎平坦，否则在网络尺度上是空洞的。

Abstract: As an alternative to the standard geometric analyses, we give an exact, information-theoretic analysis of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants. We show that a preconditioned SGD step is the posterior-mean update of a Gaussian Bayes model, and that its one-step regret splits into an intrinsic-time cost and a change in comparator information. The split extends to an identity for the objective itself. Convex convergence, strict-saddle-point escape, the link between flatness and generalization, the standard learning-rate schedules, adaptive optimizers, and the noisy, momentum, heavy-tailed, and gradient-free variants of SGD each correspond to a term or a special case of this identity. We measure its terms on synthetic and real training runs. On real networks it attributes the slack of classical convergence bounds to the terms their derivations drop and separates optimizers that reach the same training loss. That separation follows the number and consistency of their steps. Its relation to which of them generalizes better differs between networks. For gradient-free SGD the identity determines how a curvature preconditioner should enter the update. The sharpness-based generalization certificate it yields, with a data-independent isotropic prior, is vacuous at network scale unless the curvature spectrum is nearly flat across all parameters.

</details>


### [300] [YouRA: A Persistent-State Architecture for Evidence-Traceable Autonomous Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01097)
*Yoonkyu Woo,Woojin Lee,Jin-Xia Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出YouRA架构，通过状态保持与证据追踪，解决端到端研究智能体论文声明与实验不符的问题，在MLR-Bench上性能优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端研究智能体可生成完整论文，但论文声明常与执行实验脱节，根源在于研究状态、失败历史和声明-证据对齐未作为持久可验证状态在长周期流程中维护。

Method: YouRA集成三组件：验证状态架构（VSA）追踪假设、门控和证据指针；独立控制器将状态与反思记录转化为生命周期、恢复和辩论/评审控制，分离控制与执行；状态化反思将失败记录为结构化教训，并通过有界修复、重新设计或重置引导恢复。

Result: 在MLR-Bench预定义十任务端到端子集上，YouRA在三个匹配骨干网络上均比MLR-Agent和AI Scientist V2提升标量Overall；基于幻觉分类的自动诊断报告四类事实性失败的交集/并集计数，数据溯源诊断显示更多基于真实数据的输出；消融VSA、独立控制器、MCP工具访问和反思引导恢复四个组件支持其可分离贡献，移除任一核心状态组件均使YouRA低于完整系统。

Conclusion: YouRA通过状态化、证据可追踪的架构有效提升了自主研究的一致性与可靠性，各组件贡献可分离，核心状态组件不可或缺。

Abstract: End-to-end research agents can now produce complete scientific papers, yet manuscript claims often diverge from executed experiments. This gap is structural: research state, failure histories, and claim-evidence alignment are not maintained as persistent, verifiable state across long-horizon pipelines. We present YouRA (Your Research Agent), an architecture for stateful, evidence-traceable autonomous research. YouRA preserves research state, execution evidence, and failure history across the research trajectory by integrating three components: a Verification State Architecture (VSA) that tracks hypotheses, gates, and evidence pointers; an Independent Controller that turns state and reflection records into lifecycle, recovery, and debate/review control while separating control from execution; and Stateful Reflection that logs failures as structured lessons and routes recovery through bounded repair, redesign, or reset. On MLR-Bench's predefined ten-task end-to-end subset, YouRA improves over both MLR-Agent and AI Scientist V2 on scalar Overall across all three matched backbones. An automated diagnostic using MLR-Bench's hallucination taxonomy reports intersection/union counts for four fact-based failure types, and data-provenance diagnostic shows more real-data-based outputs. Ablating each of the four components (the VSA, the Independent Controller, MCP tool access, and reflection-guided recovery) supports their separable contributions. Removing either core-state component drops YouRA below the full system. Code: https://github.com/PrayPrey/Your-Research-Agent.

</details>


### [301] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF)连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归模型的噪声-数据耦合，实现少步高质量文本生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步语言生成方法在采样质量与效率上存在不足，需要借助预训练自回归模型的知识来提升连续流模型的少步生成性能。

Method: 理论证明自回归模型诱导的Gumbel噪声与one-hot token序列耦合形成非相交线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，其中切向（速度）条件由AR教师模型直接引导，以增强少步路径采样。

Result: 在预训练及下游任务等多个基准上，GSF超越当前少步语言生成基线。

Conclusion: GSF通过结合AR模型的噪声-数据耦合与流映射半群目标，有效提升了少步语言生成的质量与效率。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [302] [Grounding Large Language Models in DSGE Simulators for Policy Generation and Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01128)
*Aditya Dubey,Namah Gupta,Vinti Agarwal*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 将指令微调语言模型置于六个DSGE模拟器中，测试其政策行动是否与动态经济一致，而非仅语言合理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成看似合理的经济政策回应，但无法证明其行动符合经济动态，需通过模拟环境验证。

Method: 使用PPO和GRPO两种强化学习方法，在Snowdrop支持的DSGE模拟器中进行多轮模拟，包含持久冲击、状态克隆和滚动预测，并测试语义信号、奖励视野、跨模拟器迁移等。

Result: PPO通过学习价值函数和广义优势估计能传播延迟奖励，而GRPO因无价值函数且组内归一化优势为零，无法区分早期行动的影响。

Conclusion: 政策行动应基于模拟经济后果而非仅语言合理性来评判。

Abstract: Large language models can produce economic policy responses that sound reasonable, but this does not show that their actions are consistent with economic dynamics. We test this by placing an instruction-tuned language model inside six Snowdrop-backed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) simulators. At each turn, the model observes the economy and a change in economic discourse, selects a bounded policy action, and receives the next simulated state and an economic reward. We implement a common Python interface for repeated rollouts, persistent shocks, state cloning, and rolling-horizon simulation.
  This setting creates a long-horizon credit-assignment problem. Policy effects may appear several quarters after an action is taken. PPO has a learned value function that can propagate delayed reward to earlier tokens through generalized advantage estimation. GRPO has no learned value function and instead assigns a group-relative advantage from complete rollout returns. It therefore cannot distinguish which earlier turn caused the outcome; if every rollout receives the same return, the normalized advantage is zero. We use PPO as the primary method and GRPO as a matched critic-free baseline. The experiments also test directional semantic signals, reward horizon, trajectory warm starts, cross-simulator transfer, and historically anchored pandemic and monetary-policy shocks. The objective is to judge policy actions by their simulated economic consequences rather than by plausible language alone.

</details>


### [303] [Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00564)
*Kailen Hargenrader,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文研究概率测度上的算子学习，发现softmax注意力在重尾测度下积分发散，提出使用增长更慢的注意力核，并通过基准测试验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对于具有多项式尾的概率测度，softmax中的指数加权会导致测度级注意力积分发散，因此需要替换为增长更慢的函数。

Method: 构建了两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准，用于研究后范数Transformer中注意力核增长和数据变换的影响；对比softmax与三种增长更慢的核，并测试symlog预处理。

Result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上出现集成崩溃，而三种慢增长核避免崩溃；symlog预处理使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免崩溃，但在剪切交换任务上无效；高斯控制下四种核表现相似；还分析了样本量对经验能量和Wasserstein距离敏感性的影响。

Conclusion: 这些结果支持将增长更慢的注意力核作为后范数Transformer从重尾集成中学习的有效设计选择。

Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

</details>


### [304] [From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00580)
*Hojat Allah Salehi,Mehrdad Mahdavi,Andrew Arash Mahyari,M. Hadi Amini*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文研究客户端内部与之间存在复合异构性的联邦微调场景，提出通过将输入路由到任务专家来提升性能的FedSEE方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习仅处理客户端间异构性，未显式解决单个客户端内部潜在的任务混合问题，导致负迁移和性能下降。

Method: 在共享冻结表示上，利用平方损失下任务混合的最优模型为底层任务最优模型的凸组合这一性质，借助少量任务标注公共样本，通过凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配任务，进而设计输入依赖的专家路由机制FedSEE。

Result: 实验表明FedSEE避免了基线中的负迁移，整体性能提升2.9个百分点，最差服务四分位组提升3.7个百分点。

Conclusion: 任务对齐的输入依赖路由能有效应对复合异构性，FedSEE在联邦微调中显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

</details>


### [305] [ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00672)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Ivan Garibay,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，结合Walsh交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计，探究ESM-2表征层级中高阶上位性信息的保留情况；复现实验显示高阶与低阶信息保留差异不稳健，方向性结论待定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型的预测性能无法揭示其表征深度中保留何种形式的生物交互信息，作者追问ESM-2在其表征层级中保留高阶上位性信息的能力是否与一阶、二阶信息同样强。

Method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，将基于Walsh的交互分解与子集条件神经依赖估计相结合；先在具有已知交互结构的合成适应度景观上验证，再应用于使用冻结ESM-2表征的密集四站位GB1适应度景观。

Result: 初次运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO=-0.107）；在匹配GPU硬件和相同critic种子的完整测量网格独立复现中，该差异大幅缩小（Δ_HO-LO=-0.017），且在同样训练critic的不同合理评估配对选择下符号不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。

Conclusion: 目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性地丢失高阶上位性信息，也不能断言各阶保留程度相等，方向性问题仍开放；测量协议本身（包括对池化critic中位置子集捷径的去除）仍然有效；ORBIT-FMIB可作为探测蛋白质基础模型交互结构的诊断框架，而本研究的复现结果说明此类探测在将输出视为生物学发现前需要充分把握度的可复现性检验。

Abstract: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

</details>


### [306] [Verify Claims, Not Scores: Evidence-Based Verification of Modular Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01348)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出一种针对模块化智能体的声明级验证审计协议，不评分智能体本身，而是对每个结论及其证据进行评分与分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合任务分数无法说明改进是否可达、哪个组件损失了价值以及智能体自身检查能证明什么。

Method: 记录每个结论的证据、四种判定（支持、不支持、未解决、未评估）及其成立边界；使用三种工具：预言机策略度量可达改进、逐一替换组件为完美对应物定位价值损失、单独测试验证器分数是否标识其声称界定的量。

Result: 在合成市场约束投资组合分配智能体上：完美制度信息的价值取决于度量动作集；场景生成器丢弃大部分制度信号，更好局部保真度不改善决策；运行时验证器可被绕过而无可见结果变化。

Conclusion: 贡献是所提出的协议及其强制的证据区分；实证发现特定于所研究的智能体与环境。

Abstract: When developers change one component of an agent, such as its controller, a learned model or its verifier, they usually judge the change by an aggregate task score. That score cannot tell whether improvement was attainable, which component lost value, or what the agent's own checks certify. We introduce a claim-specific verification audit for modular agents that plan, act, check and refine. Instead of scoring the agent, the audit scores the evidence: each conclusion is recorded with the evidence behind it, one of four verdicts (supported, unsupported, unresolved or not evaluated) and the boundary within which it holds. Three tools supply that evidence. Oracle policies measure attainable improvement under an explicitly stated action set, so that a low value can be traced to the evaluation rather than to the environment. Replacing one component at a time with a perfect counterpart locates lost value, with null results read as unresolved whenever a downstream component could mask them. A separate test asks whether the verifier's score identifies the quantity it is read as bounding. Applied to a constrained portfolio-allocation agent in a synthetic market with known hidden regimes, the audit shows that the value of perfect regime information depends on the action set used to measure it, that the scenario generator discards most of the regime signal while better local fidelity does not improve decisions, and that the runtime verifier can be bypassed with no visible change in outcomes. The contribution is the protocol and the evidential distinctions it enforces; the empirical findings are specific to the agent and environment studied.

</details>


### [307] [Grand Canonical Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00683)
*Andreas Burger,Malte Franke,Luka Mucko,Kjell Jorner,Alan Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出大正则生成器（GCG），将玻尔兹曼生成器扩展至大正则系综，通过两种设计实现粒子数和构型的联合采样，并在Lennard-Jones流体和甲烷吸附中验证了准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有玻尔兹曼生成器主要针对正则系综，无法直接处理粒子数可变的开放系统，而大正则系综在物理化学和材料科学中至关重要。

Method: 提出两种GCG设计：1）以化学势为条件，联合采样粒子数和构型；2）将大正则分布因子化为粒子数分布与对应正则玻尔兹曼密度的乘积，可利用任意现有玻尔兹曼生成器，解析编码化学势线性依赖，并支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。

Result: 在Lennard-Jones流体和沸石中甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG准确重现了大正则系综可观测量，展示了跨化学势的泛化能力，并通过SNIS和大正则蒙特卡洛进行校正。

Conclusion: GCG为开放系统提供了一种灵活高效的生成建模框架，能够准确采样大正则系综并泛化至不同化学势，并可通过SNIS或蒙特卡洛进一步校正。

Abstract: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

</details>


### [308] [Generation Provenance Before Behavior Attribution: Auditing Synthetic Speech Research Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01378)
*Sidi Chang,Peiying Zhu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 论文提出一种生成溯源基板，用于绑定合成训练数据的来源规格与产物，并在日语护理交接管道中审计，指出生成溯源是行为归因的必要但不充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将模型行为归因于合成训练数据，需先知道每个训练项的产生过程，而波形-标签对无法保留此知识。

Method: 提出生成溯源基板：合成研究对象绑定源规格、生成内容、波形、目标、事实需求、质量信号、审核谱系和不可变清单身份；在私有日语护理交接管道中审计113个资产（1.552小时合成语音，六个场景族）。

Result: 所有项目有链接音频、转录、候选笔记和事实清单，但人类证据有选择性和来源特异性；两个仅忠实清单场景种子不相交且不可变版本化，但精确上游归因受阻于浮动生成器别名、缺失逐片段TTS和代码戳、未版本化检查提示。

Conclusion: 生成溯源是行为归因的必要但不充分条件：它定义候选因果图和审计单元，而贡献性归因仍需冻结训练运行和干预/影响证据；贡献了紧凑溯源契约、审计协议和有界案例研究，不声称因果训练数据归因、临床有效性或无限制公开发布。

Abstract: Attributing model behavior to synthetic training data requires knowing what produced each training item before estimating what that item caused. A waveform-label pair does not preserve this knowledge. We propose a generation-provenance substrate in which a synthetic research object binds source specification, generated content, waveform, target, fact requirements, quality signals, review lineage, and immutable manifest identity. Producer and selection mechanism determine evidentiary meaning; storage location and variable name do not. We audit this substrate in a private Japanese care-handoff pipeline. A 113-asset review population contains 1.552 hours of synthetic speech across six scenario families; all items have linked audio, transcripts, candidate notes, and fact checklists, but human evidence is selective and source-specific. Two faithful-only manifests are scenario-seed-disjoint and immutably versioned, while exact upstream attribution remains blocked by floating generator aliases, missing per-clip TTS and code stamps, and an unversioned checking prompt. We argue that generation provenance is necessary but not sufficient for behavior attribution: it defines the candidate causal graph and audit units, whereas contributive attribution still requires frozen training runs and intervention or influence evidence. The paper contributes a compact provenance contract, an audit protocol, and a bounded case study for synthetic-data attribution; controlled research access may be offered, but we do not claim causal training-data attribution, clinical validity, or unrestricted public release.

</details>


### [309] [Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00708)
*Honglei Brinkmann,Lucas Ng,Georgios Batzolis,Mark Girolami,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Willem Diepeveen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出一种面向混合流形数据的拉回几何，用高斯混合潜变量定义黎曼度量，实现高似然路径插值与可解释局部结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展拉回几何多采用单峰高斯潜分布，假设数据接近单一流形；对多模态数据，将分离模态映射到同一高斯区域会引入较大传输形变并损害几何质量。

Method: 以潜高斯混合构造拉回度量，取责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方；证明其光滑正定且在单分量极限下退化为原高斯构造；对结构化重叠混合给出测地线上对数密度凹性的条件及局部曲率关系；并在带自适应混合学习的归一化流中实例化，支持分量级重建与局部有效维估计。

Result: 在合成几何数据、具有已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像以及MNIST上，减少传输畸变、保持有竞争力的路径支撑、接近参考轨迹恢复并提升插值真实感。

Conclusion: 该工作将可扩展拉回几何推广到不接近单一流形的数据集，同时保持局部结构的可处理性与可解释性。

Abstract: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

</details>


### [310] [AiSearch: Interactive Multi-Modal Search with VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01389)
*Ali Koksal,Mei Chee Leong,Vicky Sintunata,Ching Ling Chin,Wee Teck Fong*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出AiSearch，一个利用视觉语言模型零样本能力实现图像和视频自然语言检索的灵活多模态框架，支持交互式细化与模型基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代检索系统需兼具自动化与交互性，以支持用户实时搜索和优化结果，而现有系统在多模态检索和用户反馈整合方面存在不足。

Method: AiSearch基于视觉语言模型的零样本能力，构建多模态检索框架，支持自然语言查询图像和视频，并通过用户反馈进行交互式结果优化，同时提供多模型视觉基准测试。

Result: 实现了图像和视频的自然语言检索，支持交互式细化以符合用户意图，并允许用户跨多个视觉语言模型进行基准测试以选择最适合任务的模型。

Conclusion: AiSearch框架有效结合了零样本多模态检索与交互式反馈，提升了检索系统的灵活性和用户定制能力。

Abstract: Modern retrieval systems must both be automated and interactive, allowing users to search and refine results in real time. We present AiSearch, a flexible multimodal retrieval framework that leverages the zero shot capabilities of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for natural language search over images and videos. AiSearch supports interactive search refinement through user feedback to tailor results to the user's intent, and allows visual benchmarking across multiple VLMs, enabling users to select the most suitable model for their task.

</details>


### [311] [Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00729)
*Morgan Byrd,Maks Sorokin,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文提出基于奖励的策略，仅以奖励和动作为条件，实现观测空间完全不同的源环境与目标环境之间的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略在适应新环境时往往表现不佳且需要大量样本，而人类具有出色的适应能力，因此探索更高效的迁移方法。

Method: 提出一种新颖的基于奖励的策略，仅以奖励和动作为条件，并讨论其挑战与可行性，进而设计出实用的训练算法。

Result: 在Pointmass、Cartpole和2D Car Racing三种环境中训练基于奖励的策略，并零样本迁移到颜色调色板不同、3D渲染或Habitat-Sim中Stretch机器人导航等观测完全不同的环境；该策略还能进一步指导目标环境中基于观测的策略训练。

Conclusion: 基于奖励的策略能够实现跨观测空间的零样本迁移，并可作为目标环境策略训练的引导。

Abstract: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

</details>


### [312] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究在自监督学习框架下，探究网络宽度和深度如何影响贪婪逐层训练与端到端反向传播的训练效果，发现宽度增加可缩小二者差距，极宽浅层网络中逐层训练甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习主导训练方式，但局部优化网络在何种架构条件下能学到与端到端训练相当的表示尚不明确，尤其在自监督学习背景下。

Method: 在卷积网络中，对比贪婪逐层自监督训练与端到端自监督训练，系统变化网络宽度和深度，并分析所形成表示的几何特性。

Result: 网络越宽，端到端反向传播相对贪婪逐层训练的优势越小；在相对浅且极宽的网络上，贪婪逐层训练性能更高；极宽贪婪训练网络展现出比端到端反向传播网络更有利的表示几何。

Conclusion: 网络宽度可以补偿受限的信用分配，表示几何差异是贪婪逐层训练性能提升的潜在机制。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [313] [Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00767)
*Peter Nutter,Dani Roytburg,Clément Dumas,Jinghua Ou,Shi Feng*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出嫁接（grafting）方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将权重更新加至已后训练模型，以低成本近似忠实的中训练干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练阶段形成的信念影响模型后续泛化，但每次修改预训练语料都需完整后训练才能评估效果，迭代慢且昂贵；而常见的对已后训练模型直接做SDF会留下伪影、损害能力，并导致“现实漂移”——把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实。

Method: 在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将其学到的权重更新加到已后训练模型上，从而复用现有后训练流程；在多达284B参数的多个模型家族上，通过植入虚假事实、训练错位模型有机体和应用宪法式中训练干预进行验证。

Result: 嫁接在已后训练模型上安装目标信念的强度与直接SDF相当，但平均将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失降低一半以上，且更接近忠实的真实中训练运行。

Conclusion: 嫁接无需后训练，同一适配器可应用于任意后续检查点，使研究者仅需一次微调运行即可快速迭代预训练干预。

Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

</details>


### [314] [Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00771)
*Yimiao Yu,Florentin Guth*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文研究随机输入输出映射的记忆任务间的迁移学习，发现两种迁移模式并分解其机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题是预训练为何能加速或提升另一任务的表现，其内在机制尚不明确。

Method: 通过随机输入输出映射的记忆任务进行预训练与微调实验，并利用消融实验分解迁移效应。

Result: 发现等价迁移（每多一个预训练epoch约节省一个微调epoch）和非等价迁移（不匹配任务预训练比直接训练下游任务更高效）；迁移可分解为最后一层的“平凡”幅度驱动迁移和其他层协方差部分贡献的“非平凡”结构驱动迁移。

Conclusion: 结果深化了对迁移学习机制的理解，有望指导有原则的预训练策略。

Abstract: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

</details>


### [315] [Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00778)
*Daisuke Yamada,Travis Pence,Vikas Singh*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束评论家价值梯度，解耦动态可达性与边界几何，提升目标条件强化学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拟度量学习在目标条件强化学习中，其局部约束未充分体现有限时域控制组合的方向依赖效应与环境可行性。

Method: 基于状态约束最优控制，从数据中分别估计动态可达性与边界几何，并以此约束评论家的价值梯度。

Result: 在OGBench上，ReQRL优于或媲美现有拟度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。

Conclusion: 有限时域可达性约束能有效改进拟度量学习，实现更优的离线目标条件强化学习。

Abstract: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

</details>


### [316] [On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00820)
*Fabio J. Fehr,Philip Torr*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出并验证了一种概念：通过少量示例（few-shot）可直接生成小型专家模型参数，而无需任务特定训练，且生成的权重空间支持组合泛化与未见任务泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用模型虽可基于上下文适应任务，但参数量大；专用模型虽轻量却需任务特定训练或适配。作者希望探索能否直接从少量演示中生成专用模型，从而避免显式训练。

Method: 以ARC-1D为受控测试平台，用超网络根据上下文生成小型专家模型的参数；专家模型代表单个变换，并分析生成参数构成的权重空间结构；在有无显式任务标识符两种设置下评估泛化能力。

Result: 生成的专家模型参数量极小；其参数形成结构化权重空间；专家模型展现出部分的组合泛化能力以及对训练中未见变换的泛化能力；去除显式任务标识符可提升对训练变换之外的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 少样本任务上下文可被即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且由此形成的权重空间支持重用和超越已知函数的泛化，为按需生成专家模型提供了概念验证。

Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

</details>


### [317] [TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00835)
*Jiawei Yu,Jian Liu*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出TrueMuse基准，用于系统评估文本到音乐生成中的数据归因方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到音乐生成模型依赖大规模音乐数据训练，但缺乏可靠真实标签，难以严格评估数据归因方法的有效性。

Method: 构建TrueMuse受控数据集与基准，微调三种扩散式文本到音乐模型，覆盖旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家风格和流派模式四类归因设置，包含133个属性、648个微调模型和95,456个生成样本，并在两种提示类型下从微调提升、提示类型难度、多任务训练和微调数据规模四个维度评估现有黑盒归因方法。

Result: 现有归因方法在不同评估设置下表现差异显著，整体归因仍然困难。

Conclusion: 文本到音乐生成需要更可靠且可泛化的数据归因方法，TrueMuse为后续研究提供了受控评估基准。

Abstract: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [318] [The AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator: A Framework to Support Technical Assessment in AI Regulatory Sandboxes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01539)
*Alessio Buscemi,German Castignani,Daniele Pagani,Maxime Cordy,Jordi Cabot*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》要求成员国在2027年前建立AI监管沙盒（AIRS）的背景，提出了11项架构与治理需求，并介绍了开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator，以支持沙盒内结构化技术测试的可比性、可追溯性和可复用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AIRS要求将国家主管机构、技术专家和被评估组织聚集在受监管环境中，当涉及结构化技术测试时，大规模运行需要专用基础设施；然而现有工具生态结构性碎片化，异构工具输出难以比较、追溯和复用。

Method: 从AIRS参与的程序条件和《AI法案》对高风险系统的义务中推导出11项架构与治理需求；据此设计开源框架AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator，包括通过稳定插件API访问的测试与控制目录、统一异构输出的共享数据模型、面向多学科解读的角色特定仪表盘，以及按受众分段的报告。

Result: 描述了框架架构和当前版本；报告了一个早期试点，在真实AIRS参与中运行了协调与报告层，并为官方退出报告做出贡献。

Conclusion: 讨论了路线图、目录分层贡献模型引发的治理问题，以及开源评估生态在成员国间形成的制度路径。

Abstract: The EU's Artificial Intelligence Act requires all Member States to establish AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRS) by August 2027: supervised environments bringing together national Competent Authorities, technical experts, and the organisations under assessment. When AIRS engagements include structured technical testing, running such testing at scale demands dedicated infrastructure, yet the tooling ecosystem remains structurally fragmented, with heterogeneous tools producing outputs that are difficult to compare, trace, and reuse. From the procedural conditions of AIRS engagements and the AI Act obligations for high-risk systems, we derive 11 architectural and governance requirements for the infrastructure that operationalises technical testing within an AIRS. In response to these requirements, we introduce the AI Assessment Sandbox Configurator, an open-source framework combining a curated Catalogue of tests and controls accessed through a stable plug-in API, a shared data model that harmonises heterogeneous outputs, role-specific dashboards for multi-disciplinary interpretation, and audience-segmented reporting. We describe the architecture and current release, and report an early-stage pilot that exercised the harmonisation and reporting layers within a live AIRS engagement and contributed to an official Exit Report. We discuss the roadmap, the governance questions raised by the Catalogue's tiered contribution model, and the institutional pathways through which an open-source assessment ecosystem could emerge across Member States.

</details>


### [319] [SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00838)
*Xinchen Du,Zhengze Zhou,Wenhui Zhu,Han Yu,Sen Na,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出SHARPO，一种在环境交互片段层面重加权GRPO优势的信用分配机制，用于长程多步智能体强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习中单点局部错误会导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励难以为单个决策分配信用，因此需要更细粒度的信用分配。

Method: 受在线策略自蒸馏(OPSD)启发，SHARPO在每个环境交互片段内计算教师-学生对数概率差，据此生成有界的乘子，对GRPO优势进行重加权，该乘子由片段内所有token共享，使信用可跨片段变化。

Result: 基于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上超越GRPO、SDAR、RLSD和StepOPSD等基线。

Conclusion: 片段级事后优势重加权能有效改进GRPO的信用分配，提升长程多步智能体任务表现。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

</details>


### [320] [Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Edwin Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 通过在专家构建的智能体编程任务上仅用强化学习对Kimi K2.7 Code进行后训练，可显著提升其跨基准、跨测试框架的最后一公里编程能力，且效果能泛化到训练分布之外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体常失败于“最后一公里”：遗漏需求、只测已实现用例、破坏原有行为或基于未经验证的假设。作者想探究在专家构建的智能体编程任务上做强化学习能否弥补这一差距，以及所学能力能否迁移到训练分布之外。

Method: 对1T参数（32B激活）的开源权重混合专家模型Kimi K2.7 Code，仅用强化学习在1700个任务上后训练：1000个仓库任务用隐藏的fail-to-pass测试和已有行为的pass-to-pass测试评分，700个终端任务用专家编写的隐藏验证器评分；奖励为目标检查通过比例，任一pass-to-pass测试失败则奖励归零。在rank-32 LoRA适配器上做一epoch GSPO。

Result: 在六个外部基准、三种智能体测试框架下pass@1均提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8，DeepSWE 31.0→43.4，Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0，Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1，Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6，SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0。五个独立任务集汇总提升显著（p<0.001），在训练数据收集后发布的三个集合上仍显著（p=0.004），且在训练未用的两种测试框架下也提升。DeepSWE和Terminal-Bench 3的中位轨迹智能体步数缩短24-35%。

Conclusion: 仅用强化学习后训练即可有效弥补编码智能体的最后一公里失败模式，且能力可跨基准、跨测试框架泛化到训练分布之外；失败轨迹多为近失，训练后新解任务中配对轨迹显示其避免了上述四种失败模式。

Abstract: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

</details>


### [321] [vFedProtoQNAS: Prototype-Guided Personalized Quantum Neural Architecture Search for Virtual Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01718)
*Seok Bin Son,Samuel Yen-Chi Chen,Soohyun Park,Joongheon Kim*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出 vFedProtoQNAS，通过原型共享实现个性化量子神经架构搜索的虚拟联邦学习，避免异构 QNN 参数聚合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子联邦学习中设备能力差异导致单一共享 QNN 架构不适用，而个性化 QNAS 后参数平均会混合语义不一致的电路操作。

Method: 各客户端独立搜索并训练专属 QNN，从潜在表示计算类级局部原型，并利用服务器全局原型作为联邦语义锚进行细化；客户端间不聚合模型参数。

Result: 相比 FedAvg 准确率提升 3.70%，并增强类一致表示对齐。

Conclusion: 原型引导的个性化 QNAS 可有效支持异构设备上的量子联邦协作，规避结构不同 QNN 参数聚合的语义冲突。

Abstract: Quantum federated learning (QFL) has emerged as a promising approach for collaboratively training compact quantum neural networks (QNNs) over distributed private data on resource-constrained devices. However, differences in device capabilities make a single shared QNN architecture unsuitable for all clients. While personalized quantum neural architecture search (QNAS) allows each client to select a device-specific QNN, averaging parameters across structurally different QNN architectures mixes semantically inconsistent circuit operations. To address this, prototype-guided personalized QNAS for virtual FL (vFedProtoQNAS) is proposed, where model parameters are never aggregated across clients and federated collaboration is achieved through class-wise prototype sharing. Each client independently searches and trains a client-specific QNN, computes class-wise local prototypes from latent representations, and refines them using global prototypes from the server as federated semantic anchors. Experiments demonstrate that vFedProtoQNAS improves accuracy by 3.70\% over FedAvg and enhances class-consistent representation alignment.

</details>


### [322] [VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01766)
*Bingjun Luo,Yuhuan Fan,Jialin Guo,Siqi Li*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出VideoEvolve框架，自动演化围绕冻结视频-语言模型构建的智能体测试架，以提升视频时序定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工优化测试架需诊断定位失败并协调工作流与指令修改，成本高、难度大。

Method: 采用Cloze-Structured Harness Representation保持阶段接口同时开放工作流与指令演化；使用Branch-Guided Harness Evolution保留有潜力的代码分支，借助执行反馈引导局部编辑并以验证决定保留哪些改进。

Result: 在多个基准上提升了定位性能；组件分析表明指令优化是稳定增益来源，而演化代码的收益因评测设置而异。

Conclusion: 自动化测试架演化是提升视频时序定位的有效途径。

Abstract: Video temporal grounding aims to localize events in videos from natural-language queries. For agents built around frozen video-language models, the harness determines how queries guide temporal predictions and how those predictions are refined. Manually refining these harnesses requires diagnosing grounding failures and coordinating changes to both agent workflows and instructions. We introduce VideoEvolve, a framework that automatically evolves agent harnesses for video temporal grounding. VideoEvolve uses a Cloze-Structured Harness Representation that preserves stage interfaces while leaving agent workflows and instructions open to evolution. Branch-Guided Harness Evolution preserves promising code branches for continued refinement, using execution feedback to guide local edits and validation to determine which improvements are carried forward. Experiments demonstrate improved grounding performance across multiple benchmarks. Component analyses identify instruction refinement as a consistent source of gains, while the benefits of evolved code vary across evaluation settings. Together, these results support automated harness evolution as an effective approach to improving video temporal grounding. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/VideoEvolve .

</details>


### [323] [Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00903)
*Zhanming Zhang,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出“入口状态锐化”方法，在TTRL前用无数据训练调整检查点状态，以提高无标签适应效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTRL依赖模型自身采样生成监督信号，若初始策略熵高（模糊），自监督噪声大且适应预算多消耗于概率集中，而非表达已有能力。

Method: 在TTRL前进行无数据训练（多种目标函数），将同一基座模型移动到不同入口状态；用入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号，以可达能力为约束。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B的五个无数据检查点、相同15步TTRL协议下，入口熵与端点转换效率强负相关（Spearman ρ=-0.90；控制入口可达性后ρ=-0.99）。R-Zero熵3.39 nats，在MATH、GPQA、AMC的6/6匹配比较中低于未调优基座；SPIRAL熵0.07 nats，在MATH和GPQA上取得最高TTRL后准确率。域内无标签自蒸馏可主动锐化入口状态。

Conclusion: 应将检查点准备视为状态控制问题：用无数据训练提升TTRL就绪度，以入口熵为无标签控制信号，以可达能力为约束。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states.
