Our analysis yields six key findings: (i) a neighboring-layer sanity check shows CBA is more sensitive than PCA- or CKA-based linear baselines; (ii) layer-by-layer alignment matrices reveal two block structures in intermediate and late layers, consistent across models and obscured by linear metrics; (iii) concept composition remains syntax-dominated through most of the network before giving way to increasingly mixed syntactic-semantic concepts in later layers, with increasing output-orientation toward the final layers; (iv) multilingual concept sharing between English and Mandarin is training-dependent rather than universal, strongest in Qwen, weaker in Llama, and absent in GPT-2; (v) inter-model alignment mirrors this structure, with strong correspondence between same-family Qwen models of different scale but weak alignment across model families; and (vi) across Tulu-3 training stages, alignment is highest between adjacent stages, with the largest shift between the base model and SFT, while subsequent preference-alignment stages (DPO, RLVR) leave early layers largely unchanged and RLVR mostly preserves DPO's concepts in late layers.

</details>


### [359] [Scientific Discovery under Validation Congestion via Multi-Fidelity Pairwise Rankings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01827)
*Kevin Tirta Wijaya,Alston Lo,Michael Sun,Wojciech Matusik,Vahid Babaei*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出PRISMS框架，主要利用专家成对排序而非绝对分数进行候选科学设计筛选，并通过Fisher信息准则在多保真度专家间升级查询。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代计算方法产生大量候选设计，但实验验证能力有限，形成验证拥堵；现有筛选方法依赖数据驱动的回归模型预测绝对分数，需要大量实验数据，而科学设计发现常具比较性，成对排序更易获取。

Method: PRISMS使用一个或多个专家（可跨多个专业水平，从经验法则到智能体工作流和资深科学家）的成对排序，识别最有希望的候选者，不依赖数据饥渴的回归器；当专家保真度和成本不同时，基于Fisher信息准则将成对查询从低保真度升级到高保真度排序器。

Result: 在固定药物发现库的迭代筛选中，PRISMS达到50%的top-10发现召回率，比仅回归的主动学习少约42%轮次，比无选择性升级的基于排序方法少约15%轮次；在无预定义库限制生成新设计的优化中，PRISMS的超体积比贝叶斯优化基线高约18.8%。

Conclusion: PRISMS表明，主要利用专家成对排序进行筛选可有效识别有希望的候选设计，减少对大量实验数据的依赖，并在迭代筛选和优化任务中优于回归主动学习和贝叶斯优化基线。

Abstract: Modern computational methods can now propose candidate molecules, materials, and other scientific designs at an unprecedented scale, creating a validation congestion where candidates are abundant, but experimental capacity to physically evaluate them remains scarce. Discovering novel scientific designs has therefore become increasingly dependent on curation: selecting a small set of promising designs for slow and costly experiments. Existing curation methods typically rely on data-driven regression models that predict absolute scores, but training these models requires substantial experimental data to begin with. Yet, useful curation signals do not have to take the form of absolute measurements, as scientific design discovery is often comparative in nature. Here, we propose that curation can instead be primarily driven by expert pairwise rankings, which are substantially easier to gather. The expertise can come from computational tools or human input of multiple levels of fidelity, ranging from empirical rules of thumb to agentic workflows and experienced scientists. We introduce PRISMS, a framework that uses pairwise rankings from one or more experts, potentially spanning multiple levels of expertise, to identify the most promising candidates without relying on data-hungry regressors. When experts differ in fidelity and cost, PRISMS escalates pairwise queries from lower- to higher-fidelity rankers based on a Fisher-information criterion. In iterative screening that selects designs from fixed drug discovery libraries, PRISMS achieves 50% top-10 discovery recall in ~42% fewer rounds than regression-only active learning, and in ~15% fewer rounds than the ranking-based method with no selective escalation. In optimization that generates new designs without restriction to a predefined library, PRISMS achieves ~18.8% higher hypervolume than the Bayesian optimization baseline.

</details>


### [360] [Flowing Faster to Coordinate: One-Step Online Multi-Agent Flow Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01882)
*Zhuoran Li,Yunzhan Li,Xun Wang,Yihan Du,Longbo Huang*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出OMAF，一种基于一步流模型的在线多智能体强化学习框架，兼顾表达力与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散策略能建模复杂多峰动作分布，但迭代采样开销大，难以扩展至在线多智能体场景。

Method: 采用Transformer流策略与近似路径分数代理，实现同步流策略优化；结合softmax Q值估计与联合流策略目标进行联合优化，消除迭代采样。

Result: 在MPE和MAMuJoCo的10个标准任务上，OMAF性能持续领先，回报最高提升3.4倍，样本效率提升10.5倍。

Conclusion: OMAF是一种表达力强且计算高效的在线MARL一步流策略范式。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a powerful framework for learning coordinated behaviors through interactions with the environment. Developing MARL policies requires balancing expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions with efficient training and execution. Generative policies, particularly diffusionbased policies, can faithfully capture complex and multimodal behaviors, but costly iterative sampling hinders their scalability in online multi-agent settings. We propose an Online MARL framework via one-step Flow model (OMAF) that combines expressive generative policies with efficient one-step action generation. OMAF employs a Transformer-based flow policy to capture complex coordination behaviors, while its approximate path score surrogate provides a principled route to synchronized flow policy optimization. To enable stable and sampleefficient learning, we further develop a joint optimization scheme coupling softmax Q-value estimation with a joint flow policy objective for coordinated policy learning. By eliminating iterative sampling, OMAF dramatically reduces training overhead without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across 10 standard tasks from MPE and MAMuJoCo show that OMAF consistently achieves superior performance, with up to 3.4x higher returns and 10.5x sample efficiency improvement compared with baseline methods. These results validate the effectiveness of OMAF as an expressive and computationally efficient one-step flow policy paradigm for online MARL.

</details>


### [361] [A foundation for systematic analysis of transformers and RNNs for tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01894)
*Emmanuelle Renauld,Philippe Poulin,Hugo Larochelle,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了RNN和Transformer在扩散磁共振成像纤维束成像中的迭代追踪性能，通过生成-验证阶段实现流线级监督，在ISMRM2015数据集上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散MRI纤维束成像受限于局部扩散信息与全局解剖合理性之间的内在矛盾；机器学习虽具潜力，但训练策略、输入表示和超参数选择等关键因素缺乏系统评估。

Method: 采用RNN和Transformer进行迭代纤维束成像；研究训练策略、输入表示（CNN嵌入和EOS标记）及超参数选择；引入生成-验证阶段，在训练中实现流线级监督，缓解局部损失与全局流线质量不匹配的问题；使用ISMRM2015挑战数据集和Tractoinferno活体数据；通过控制实验量化缺失纤维束、噪声或不完美训练流线及无效纤维的影响。

Result: 在ISMRM2015数据集上取得迄今报道的最高性能；量化了训练集中缺失纤维束、噪声或缺陷流线以及无效纤维的影响；最佳模型成功应用于Tractoinferno活体数据。

Conclusion: 序列型深度学习模型（如Transformer和RNN）在纤维束成像中兼具潜力与局限；强调需要改进体模和评估方法以进行活体验证，并为未来基于序列的监督纤维束成像方法的训练与验证提供了建议。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has emerged as a promising approach for improving diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography, a task that remains limited by the intrinsic tension between local diffusion information and global anatomical plausibility. In this work, we systematically evaluate recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and Transformer models for iterative tractography, with particular attention to training strategies, input representations (including convolutional neural network (CNN)-based embeddings and end-of-sequence (EOS) tokens), and hyperparameter selection. We introduce a generation-validation phase enabling supervision at the streamline level during training, allowing supervision despite the mismatch between local loss functions and global streamline quality. Using the ISMRM2015 tractography challenge dataset, our models achieve the highest reported performance to date. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the impact of missing bundles, noisy or imperfect training streamlines, and invalid fibers in the training set. Finally, we demonstrate the applicability of our best-performing models for in vivo data from the Tractoinferno database. Overall, our results highlight both the potential and the limits of sequence-based deep learning models such as Transformers and RNNs for tractography, and emphasize the need for improved phantoms and evaluation methods for in vivo validation. We provide takeaways and recommendations for future researchers training and validating sequence-based supervised methods for tractography.

</details>


### [362] [Same Reward, Different Skills: When Multimodal RL Learns to Look](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01908)
*Haocun Ye,Xinlong Jiang,Qile Chen,Bingyu Wang,Teng Zhang,Shubai Chen,Tingyu Wu,Zhenkun Zheng,Yiqiang Chen*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 论文提出视觉可解性设计原则，要求视觉证据对正确答案必要且任务可学习，在反事实坐标场景中验证了该原则能显著提升视觉语言模型的发现能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR训练能在无视觉信息时提升视觉语言基准分数，但图像提示不等于学习信号中的图像；需要明确什么条件下RL才能真正学习视觉信息。

Method: 采用标准GRPO和正确性-格式奖励，在反事实坐标场景中训练7B模型，该场景问题固定且目标不命名，正确答案必须依赖图像定位目标；通过灰画布测试、灰画布训练对照和添加答案描述等控制实验分析增益来源。

Result: 7B模型在比训练集更密集的保留场景中发现准确率从0.425提升至0.875，并泛化到未训练的问题类型；测试图像替换为灰画布时发现率降为零；灰画布训练无增益；添加答案描述使增益减少近三分之二。

Conclusion: 改变奖励要求会改变RL学习内容；视觉可解性原则确保视觉证据成为学习信号的必要部分，从而有效学习视觉定位技能并泛化到独立构建的grounding任务。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves vision-language benchmark scores even without visual information during training. With images at test, blind-trained models recover roughly half of the real-image gain at 3B and nearly four fifths at 7B. Prolonged real-image training can erode grounding while benchmark gains persist. Both findings expose the same gap: an image in the prompt is not an image in the learning signal. Our design rule, visual resolvability, asks that visual evidence be necessary for a correct answer and that the task remain learnable. We test it on counterfactual coordinate scenes in which the question stays fixed and the target is never named, so a correct answer requires finding the target in the image. With standard GRPO and correctness-and-format rewards, a 7B model raises its accuracy at finding the target (discovery) from 0.425 to 0.875 on held-out scenes denser than any it trained on, and it improves on question types it never trained on. Two controls locate the source of the gain. Replacing test images with gray canvases drops discovery to zero; training on gray canvases instead, at matched step 30 and in each of four seeds, yields essentially none of the gain even when the model is then tested with real images. The learned skill carries over to grounding tasks built independently of the training corpus. A caption that answers the training question, added to the same images, reward and budget, cuts the gain by nearly two thirds. Changing what reward requires changes what RL learns.

</details>


### [363] [Learning to Predict Distributions over Weight Updates for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01934)
*Azal Ahmad Khan,Keshav Ramji,Tahira Naseem,Ali Anwar,Ramón Fernandez Astudillo*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出查询条件超网络与分布超网络，仅用输入查询生成LoRA分布，实现权重更新采样以进行适应和测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究仅凭LLM输入查询能获取多少适应信号，并探索超网络在LoRA估计中的潜力。

Method: 研究查询条件超网络估计LoRA，引入分布超网络生成LoRA分布；采用可微蒙特卡洛近似端到端损失，探索回归和凸组合等分布参数化。

Result: 学习分布的均值即超越确定性超网络；采样权重更新优于令牌采样基线，性能随样本增加而提升；生成的更新可跨查询迁移。

Conclusion: 查询条件权重更新分布能同时支持模型适应与测试时扩展，表明超网络学习到可重用的适应结构。

Abstract: Hypernetworks have recently shown success in dynamically adapting the parameters of Large Language Models (LLMs) at runtime based on signals such as task descriptions or additional demostrations. Here we ask: how much adaptation signal can be obtained using only the input query to an LLM?. To answer this, we study query-conditioned Hypernetworks for LoRA estimation. Further, we introduce distributional Hypernetworks, able to produce not only point estimates of parameter adaptors, but also a distribution over possible LoRAs. For this we propose a simple end-to-end loss using a differentiable Monte Carlo approximation and explore multiple distribution parametrizations including regression and convex combination variants. Results show that even using the mean of the learned distribution can outperform deterministic hypernetworks. Crucially, the learned distribution enables a different form of test-time scaling: instead of spending additional compute only by sampling more token sequences from a fixed model, we sample weight updates, yielding multiple adapted models for the same query. Performance improves as more weight samples are considered and remains stronger than corresponding token-sampling adaptation baselines. Finally, we find that generated updates can transfer across queries, suggesting that the hypernetwork learns reusable structure in how the model should adapt. Together, these results show that query-conditioned distributions over weight updates can support both adaptation and test-time scaling.

</details>


### [364] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出FERPO，一种基于前向KL与熵正则的最大熵在线强化学习算法，无需对critic关于动作求导即可进行策略改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续控制在线强化学习依赖critic的动作梯度更新策略，但critic以预测回报为目标，其值预测准确并不保证动作导数准确，可能导致不可靠的策略更新。

Method: FERPO从经熵与KL散度正则化的策略改进目标中推导最优目标动作分布；利用rollout策略采样的动作，通过自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计前向KL目标并拟合actor。KL正则限制目标分布偏离rollout策略，使重要性权重保持良好；前向KL鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上的实验和消融显示具有竞争力的性能与样本效率提升；计算基准表明actor更新快于REPPO。

Conclusion: FERPO避免对critic关于动作求导，借助前向KL目标实现更可靠且促进探索的策略改进，兼顾性能、样本效率与更新速度。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [365] [FastCI: Efficient GPU-Intensive CI for LLM Training Frameworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01967)
*Tianshuo Qiao,Naiqian Zheng,Xiaopeng Liu,Shuguang Wang,Diandian Gu,Xuanzhe Liu,Xin Jin*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: FastCI通过运行时证据选择受影响测试、剪枝等价上下文测试、优先高风险测试并优化负载，将LLM训练框架CI延迟降低77.5%、GPU资源减少63.9%，已集成到字节跳动的CI流程中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM训练框架的CI依赖GPU密集型测试（完整训练或评估），导致CI自身成为快速迭代开发的瓶颈。

Method: FastCI利用运行时证据选择受影响测试，剪枝在等价上下文中执行变更代码的测试；优先执行高风险测试以尽早暴露失败；在测试预期验证范围之外的维度优化测试负载。

Result: 在LLM训练框架的CI工作负载上，相比现有部署的CI流水线，FastCI将CI延迟降低77.5%，GPU资源使用减少63.9%，同时将修改代码覆盖率保留率提升3.2%。

Conclusion: FastCI有效提升了LLM训练框架CI的效率，并已集成到字节跳动的LLM训练框架CI流水线中。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) keep growing in size and complexity, their training frameworks evolve at a rapid pace as well. Therefore, continuous integration (CI) is critical for maintaining the quality and stability of these frameworks. However, unlike traditional software, CI for LLM training frameworks relies on GPU-intensive tests, which usually involve complete model training or evaluation. This leads CI itself to become a new bottleneck for fast-paced development. In this paper, we introduce FastCI, a framework that improves the efficiency of CI for LLM training frameworks. FastCI leverages runtime evidence to select affected tests and prune tests that execute changed code in equivalent contexts. Then FastCI prioritizes high-risk tests to expose potential failures earlier, and optimizes test workloads along dimensions outside the intended validation scope of each test. Evaluated on the CI workload of our LLM training framework, FastCI reduces the CI latency by 77.5% and the GPU resource usage by 63.9%, while improving the modified code coverage retention by 3.2%, compared with the currently deployed CI pipelines. FastCI has now been integrated into the CI pipelines of our LLM training framework at ByteDance.

</details>


### [366] [Sim+Real: Joint Simulation - Experiment Training Improves Balanced Prediction in Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01974)
*Mahindra Rautela,Alexander Scheinker,Ayan Biswas,Diane Oyen,Nathan DeBardeleben,Earl Lawrence*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 将仿真到实验的预测建模为多目标学习问题，联合训练在仿真与实验域上取得最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准仿真到实验微调仅优化实验目标，会导致仿真性能退化，需要兼顾两个域的性能。

Method: 在RealPDEBench的四个流体系统和两种模型容量上，比较仅仿真、仅实验、Sim→Exp和联合训练，并在两个域的留出集上评估。

Result: Sim→Exp更偏向实验数据但造成仿真域遗忘；联合训练在广泛的评估权重范围内取得最佳平衡性能，并显著提升仿真保持度。

Conclusion: 联合训练能更好地平衡仿真与实验预测，并保留实验测量中缺失的仅仿真场。

Abstract: Simulation and experimental measurements provide complementary data for learning spatiotemporal physical systems, but standard simulation-to-experiment fine-tuning optimizes only the experimental objective after transfer and can degrade simulation performance. We formulate simulation--experiment prediction as a multi-objective learning problem with domain-specific simulation and experimental risks. On four fluid systems from RealPDEBench and two model capacities, we compare Simulation only, Experiment only, Sim$\rightarrow$Exp, and Joint training, evaluating every final model on both held-out domains. Sim$\rightarrow$Exp tends to specialize more strongly to experimental data at the cost of simulation-domain forgetting. Joint training consistently achieves the best balanced performance over a broad range of simulation--experiment evaluation weightings, while substantially improving simulation retention over Sim$\rightarrow$Exp. Joint also better preserves simulation-only fields absent from experimental measurements. Project page: https://mahindrautela.github.io/morph.

</details>


### [367] [The Curvature of Regret in Contextual Linear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01980)
*Konstantinos Ziliaskopoulos,Alexander Vinel,Alice E. Smith*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 本文揭示了决策聚焦学习中线性优化器不连续点的平均行为呈局部二次特性，并基于该曲率提出一种可计算近似及场景生成方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策聚焦学习因线性优化器的不连续性导致梯度信息缺失，难以直接优化。

Method: 通过数据分布平均化处理非光滑点态行为，推导出闭式曲率（支撑于法扇壁的矩阵值测度），并给出只需一次可行集投影的可处理近似，证明其弱收敛于真实总体曲率。

Result: 实验验证了二次与弱收敛规律，在电池套利任务上相比均匀分配实现了30.8%的遗憾值改进。

Conclusion: 该曲率分析为决策感知场景生成提供了理论基础，并显著提升了线性优化决策的质量。

Abstract: Decision-focused learning for linear optimization is complicated by the discontinuity of the optimizer, where small cost errors may leave the decision unchanged or move it to a different vertex. We show that this non-smooth pointwise behavior becomes locally quadratic after averaging over the data distribution, and we derive the curvature in closed form, specifically, a matrix-valued measure supported on the walls of the normal fan. This measure depends only on the feasible set, with the data distribution entering only as a weight. We then offer a tractable approximation for this curvature, computable with just one projection to the feasible set. We prove that the approximation weakly converges to the true population curvature. We offer one application of our findings, a decision-aware scenario generation method for expected-cost linear optimization. Our experiments test the quadratic and weak convergence laws and show a 30.8% regret improvement over uniform allocation on battery arbitrage.

</details>


### [368] [Bellman Meets Lyapunov: Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning via Mastering Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02012)
*Tristan Shah,Wooyoung Chung,Volodomyr Makarenko,Juan Wachs,Stas Tiomkin*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 提出F-CIP，一种无需领域专家设计信息变量的无监督强化学习内在动机目标，仅基于系统动态定义，能发现基础行为并配合简单奖励学会复杂运动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督强化学习的内在动机目标仍需选择信息变量，重新引入了领域专家知识，违背了减少工程干预的初衷。

Method: 将可控信息产生（CIP）目标重新表述为强化学习原生的形式F-CIP，该目标仅由系统动态定义，无需选择信息变量；并证明其与强化学习兼容，与现有算法结合训练智能体。

Result: F-CIP使智能体无监督地发现平衡、维持可控性等基础行为；配合简单的前向速度奖励，能产生跳跃、奔跑等协调步态，而传统方法需要奖励工程才能学会。

Conclusion: F-CIP消除了内在动机目标中对信息变量的选择需求，为无监督强化学习提供了一种无需领域专家设计奖励信号的有效方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful paradigm for training agents, yet its success rests on domain expertise of human engineers who design informative reward signals for every new task. Unsupervised RL aims to reduce this engineering with intrinsic motivation (IM): reward signals that emerge from the agent environment interaction itself. Existing IM objectives, however, involve the selection of information variables, which re-introduces domain expertise the field has sought to eliminate. We introduce Forward CIP (F-CIP), an RL-native formulation of the Controllable Information Production (CIP) objective, which is defined by the system's dynamics alone and requires no such selection. We prove that F-CIP is compatible with RL and demonstrate its effectiveness with existing algorithms. Training agents with F-CIP results in unsupervised discovery of primitive behaviors such as balancing and maintaining controllability, which are essential for more complex robot behaviors. Paired with a simple forward-velocity reward, our method produces coordinated gaits such as hopping and running which otherwise require reward engineering to learn.

</details>


### [369] [When Do Intrinsic Rewards Lead to Exploration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02159)
*Scott W. Viteri,Laura Gomezjurado Gonzalez,Clark Barrett*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于反事实信息获取的探索准则，指出常见内在奖励（计数、预测误差、赋能、信息增益）在特定环境中可能无法实现最优探索，并给出成功条件及更优目标函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中的内在奖励（如预测误差、学习进度）常被用于引导探索，但最大化这些奖励未必能产生最具信息量的经验，因此需要更严谨的探索评价标准。

Method: 提出一个形式化准则：通过比较策略所获取的反事实信息——即其历史在替代策略下能多大程度替代实际经验——来评价探索策略；并构造一个简单环境，使计数、预测误差、赋能和信息增益等现有目标的最优策略在反事实信息获取上帕累托次优。

Result: 在该环境中，指定现有内在奖励的最大化策略均无法最优获取反事实信息；论文解释了这些失败原因，并建立了现有内在奖励能成功鼓励最优探索的条件；同时构造了一个新目标，当探索按该准则严格改进时赋予更高价值。

Conclusion: 现有内在奖励并非普遍最优，反事实信息准则能识别其局限并提供改进方向，新目标函数在特定条件下可促进更优探索。

Abstract: Intrinsic rewards are designed to guide exploration in reinforcement learning by assigning value to an agent's experience, for example through prediction error or learning progress. However, maximizing these rewards need not produce the most informative experience available. We propose a formal criterion for exploration that compares policies by the counterfactual information they acquire: how well their histories can substitute for experience under alternative policies. We construct a single, simple environment in which specified count-based, prediction-error, empowerment, and information-gain objectives have maximizing policies that are Pareto-suboptimal at acquiring counterfactual information. We explain these failures and establish conditions under which existing intrinsic rewards successfully encourage optimal exploration. We also construct an objective that assigns a higher value whenever exploration strictly improves under our criterion.

</details>


### [370] [Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02189)
*Jason X. Liu,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Soojung Yang,Xinyu A. Feng,Abigail Park,Anagha Aneesh,Lacramioara Bintu,Alexander R. Dunn,Grant M. Rotskoff*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: 该研究提出IDiom模型与RL-SAE方法，实现内在无序蛋白区域（IDR）的可解释、可组合功能设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IDR在转录调控、信号转导和亚细胞定位等细胞过程中发挥关键作用，但基于结构的设计方法不适用于IDR，而现有蛋白质语言模型在全长序列上训练，先验偏向折叠结构域，导致IDR功能设计困难。

Method: 构建了从AlphaFold数据库整理的5400万条预测IDR数据集IDiom-DB，训练自回归蛋白质语言模型IDiom；并提出基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习后训练方法RL-SAE，通过奖励激活指定特征集的序列生成，以控制功能相关序列模式。

Result: IDiom可生成在组成、模式、基序和预测无序性上接近天然IDR的多样序列；在8项IDR设计任务中，RL-SAE生成序列平均激活30个目标特征中的90%，而激活引导仅为24%；相比引导和监督微调，RL-SAE提升了预测亚细胞定位和转录活性，并能将不同生物功能的特征组合到单条序列中。

Conclusion: IDiom与RL-SAE通过显式控制功能相关序列特征，实现了可解释、可组合的IDR设计，并可推广到其他以可解释特征为设计目标的蛋白质设计场景。

Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

</details>


### [371] [Trust the Direction, Search the Step: Zero-and-First-Order Methods for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02190)
*Cristian McGee,El Houcine Bergou,Aritra Dutta*

Main category: Training

TL;DR: ZFO 框架将方向选择与步长选择解耦，利用一阶优化器确定方向，并通过零阶评估在低维子空间选择曲率感知步长，实现高效自适应步长选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模神经网络优化中步长选择困难：保守步长收敛慢，激进步长易不稳定。现有线搜索成本高，需要更轻量且可靠的自适应步长机制。

Method: 提出 ZFO（Zero-and-First-Order）框架：使用可信的一阶优化器确定更新方向，仅沿该一维子空间进行零阶评估。利用当前梯度信息和两次额外目标函数评估，构造沿该方向的局部目标模型，在有界搜索区间内选择曲率感知步长。理论分析证明共享样本评估能可靠估计有限差分曲率、局部模型能选出近最优步长，且算法收敛到稳定点邻域。

Result: 在多种语言模型和数据集上，ZFO 相比固定步长的一阶基线方法经常能改善优化过程和最终性能，改善幅度和最佳局部模型依赖于具体目标。

Conclusion: ZFO 以低于完整线搜索的成本实现了自适应步长选择，在理论和实验上均验证了其有效性，为大规模神经网络优化提供了一种轻量且鲁棒的步长选择方案。

Abstract: Step-size selection remains a central challenge in large-scale neural network optimization; conservative steps slow convergence, while aggressive steps can destabilize it. We combine \textbf{Z}ero-and-\textbf{F}irst-\textbf{O}rder optimization~(ZFO) and propose a lightweight framework that decouples direction selection from step-size. ZFO uses a trusted first-order optimizer to determine the direction and performs zeroth-order evaluations only along this one-dimensional subspace to choose how far to move. Using the current {gradient information} and two additional objective function evaluations, ZFO instances construct a local model of the objective function along the proposed direction and select a curvature-aware step within a bounded search interval. This yields an adaptive step-selection mechanism that costs less than a full line search. We provide theoretical guarantees to show that shared-sample evaluations produce reliable finite-difference curvature estimates, that the induced local model selects a near-optimal step along the search interval, and that ZFO converges to a neighborhood of a stationary point. Across the evaluated settings, language models and datasets, ZFO frequently improves optimization and final performance relative to fixed-step first-order baselines, with the magnitude and preferred local model depending on the objective. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/nizswan/Zeroth-First-Order-Framework.

</details>


<div id='Sec'></div>

# Sec [[Back]](#toc)

### [372] [Safety in Self-Evolving Agents: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00093)
*Jiahao Chen,Zhou Feng,Oubo Ma,Yichen Yan,Ruixiao Lin,Hangtao Zhang,Linkang Du,Hengyu An,Yong Yang,Jun Liu,Junhao Li,Naen Xu,Chunyi Zhou,Yuan Su,Zehao Jin,Qianli Ma,Leyi Qi,Yiming Wang,Zhe Ma,Yuwen Pu,Mengyao Du,Yuanyi Song,Enhao Huang,Zhihui Fu,Jun Wang,Jinfeng Li,Yuefeng Chen,Hui Xue,Yiming Li,Tianyu Du,Shouling Ji*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文提出以状态转移为中心的SAVER框架，系统综述自演化智能体（参数、记忆、工具、技能、工作流持续更新）的安全问题，指出合法经验在积累、泛化与跨上下文复用中可能转化为不安全影响，并呼吁纵向评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM部署后参数固定，难以从新交互中学习，因此需要自演化智能体持续更新可复用状态；这一转变使过去经验成为未来诱因，安全属性是否能在经验积累、泛化与跨上下文复用中保持成为新问题。

Method: 提出SAVER转移中心框架，包含五个维度：Substrate（定位可复用影响）、Adaptation（刻画其如何变化）、Violation（识别受损的安全属性）、Exposure（标记失败可观测之处）、Response（评估遏制、修复或撤销）；并据此综述现有工作。

Result: 综述发现失败未必源于有害信息，合法状态在适应过程中超出其原有效条件而扩展持久性、权威性或作用范围时即可变为不安全；现有研究在准入、检索、激活、暴露与局部遏制方面证据较强，但在后代修复及适应恢复后的评估方面证据明显不足。

Conclusion: 主张开展纵向评估：将不安全影响追溯至其起源转移、验证跨后代的修复效果，并检验其在持续演化下是否会重新出现。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities, yet their parameters typically remain fixed after deployment, limiting learning from new interactions. In open-ended environments, this motivates self-evolving agents that continually update reusable state-including model parameters, memories, tool definitions, skills, and workflows-from data, feedback, and accumulated experience. This shift changes the safety problem: once experience becomes reusable state, past events become future causes, and information harmless in one context may later influence decisions with greater persistence, authority, or scope. Self-evolving agent safety therefore asks not only whether a response is aligned or an action authorized, but whether safety properties survive the accumulation, generalization, and cross-context reuse of locally useful experience. We introduce SAVER, a transition-centered framework in which Substrate locates reusable influence, Adaptation captures how it changes, Violation identifies compromised safety attributes, Exposure marks where failures become observable, and Response assesses containment, repair, or revocation. Our survey reveals that failures need not originate from harmful information: legitimate state can become unsafe when adaptation expands its persistence, authority, or scope beyond the conditions under which it was valid. Existing work provides comparatively strong evidence for admission, retrieval, activation, exposure, and local containment, but much less for descendant repair and evaluation after adaptation resumes. We therefore argue for longitudinal evaluation that traces unsafe influence to its originating transition, verifies repair across descendants, and tests whether it can re-emerge under continued evolution.

</details>


### [373] [Characterizing and Codifying Malware Sophistication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00098)
*Angelo Porcella,Zachary Wadhams,Clemente Izurieta,Jonathan Crussell,Ann Marie Reinhold*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文系统化现有基于静态二进制分析的恶意软件评估方法，通过重新解释ISO/IEC 25010软件质量标准中的可靠性、可维护性、灵活性和安全性，定义恶意软件复杂性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶意软件常被描述为‘复杂’，但学术文献中缺乏一致定义；现有软件质量和复杂性度量无法捕捉影响实际威胁潜力的对抗性和操作特征。

Method: 系统化现有静态二进制分析评估方法，重新解释ISO/IEC 25010标准中的部分特性，并评估其对恶意软件二进制的适用性。

Result: 识别出既与恶意软件相关又可通过静态分析度量的质量特性，为在无源代码或动态执行不可行时一致评估恶意软件复杂性奠定基础。

Conclusion: 该工作为未来框架提供了基础，能够一致地评估恶意软件复杂性，尤其在源代码不可用或动态执行不可行的情况下。

Abstract: 'Sophisticated' is widely used to describe malware, yet it lacks a consistent definition within academic literature. While existing software quality and complexity metrics offer some insight into malware structure, they do not capture the broader adversarial and operational traits that contribute to real-world threat potential. This paper presents a systematization of existing approaches for assessing malware quality using static binary analysis. We define malware sophistication through a quality-focused lens by reinterpreting select characteristics from the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality standard, including reliability, maintainability, flexibility, and security, and evaluating their applicability to malware binaries. We identify which characteristics are both relevant to malware and measurable through static analysis, forming the basis for future frameworks that consistently assess malware sophistication when source code is unavailable or dynamic execution is infeasible.

</details>


### [374] [A Comprehensive Review of One-Pixel Attack: Research Status, Taxonomy, Applications, Regulation Policy and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00125)
*Mirza Niaz Morshed,Md. Masudul Islam,Galib Muhammad Shahriar Himel,Md. Aslam Uddin,Hui Liu,Md. Shafiqul Islam*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文对单像素攻击（OPA）进行PRISMA综述，构建多轴分类体系，分析算法、防御与领域漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPA虽能仅改一像素就导致高置信误分类，但现有对抗攻击综述对其覆盖零散且浅显，缺乏系统梳理。

Method: 遵循PRISMA指南，综合2017至2026年高质量研究，从算法基础、黑盒进化优化、混合与程序合成攻击、防御机制、可解释性工具及领域漏洞等维度建立统一分类。

Result: 发现差分进化策略占主导，效率优化与显著性引导方法兴起；数据集多样性、迁移性和标准化评估存在持续空白；总结像素恢复、异常检测、输入空间变换和鲁棒训练等防御范式及其在鲁棒性、不可感知性和计算开销间的权衡。

Conclusion: 提出选择性像素恢复、Transformer特定漏洞分析、显著性驱动优化和领域自适应防御等未来方向，并建议涵盖鲁棒性测试、事件披露和AI安全治理的监管框架，为理解与缓解超稀疏对抗威胁奠定基础。

Abstract: One-Pixel Attacks (OPAs) represent one of the most extreme demonstrations of adversarial fragility in deep learning, where modifying a single pixel can reliably induce high-confidence misclassification across domains such as medical diagnosis, autonomous driving, biometrics, and quantum communication. Despite their conceptual simplicity, OPAs remain underexamined in existing adversarial-attack surveys, which provide only fragmented or cursory coverage. This PRISMA-guided review synthesizes high-quality studies from 2017 to 2026 and delivers a unified, multi-axis taxonomy of OPA research spanning algorithmic foundations, black-box evolutionary optimization, emerging hybrid and program-synthesis attacks, defence mechanisms, interpretability tools, and domain-specific vulnerabilities. Our analysis reveals the dominance of Differential Evolution-based strategies, the rise of efficiency-optimized and saliency-guided methods, and persistent gaps in dataset diversity, transferability, and standardized evaluation. We summarized and assess defence paradigms including pixel restoration, anomaly detection, input-space transformations, and robust training highlighting their trade-offs in robustness, imperceptibility, and computational overhead. Building on these insights, we outline future research priorities involving selective pixel recovery, transformer-specific vulnerability analysis, saliency-driven optimization, and real-world domain-adaptive defences. We further propose a regulatory framework emphasizing robustness testing, incident disclosure, and AI security governance. This review establishes a comprehensive foundation for understanding, evaluating, and mitigating ultra-sparse adversarial threats in contemporary AI systems.

</details>


### [375] [Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00002)
*Jung Min Kang*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该研究提出反向项目反应理论（reverse IRT），将癌症类型视为具有耐药能力的潜在“被试”、药物视为具有规避难度的“项目”，用于药物基因组学药物反应分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统简单平均在缺失数据下难以稳健恢复癌症类型耐药性与药物广谱活性的潜在排序，需要一种能在碎片化评估条件下保持稳健的方法。

Method: 基于GDSC2数据库的242,036条药物敏感性测量，构建反向IRT模型，在共享潜在尺度上估计癌症类型层面的体外耐药性和药物层面的广谱活性；在四种缺失机制下与简单平均比较，并进行留出预测、Bootstrap置信区间及PRISM跨平台复现。

Result: 在60%缺失率下，MCAR、癌症偏倚和药物偏倚稀疏条件下，反向IRT恢复全数据潜在排序优于简单平均，Delta-rho为+0.089至+0.095；留出预测中IRT在五种方法中Brier分数最优；Bootstrap显示28种癌症类型中19种具有稳定耐药/敏感分类；PRISM跨平台复现方向一致率为82%，但秩相关较弱（rho=0.25）。

Conclusion: 该贡献在于碎片化评估下的方法学稳健性，而非普适的临床耐药排行榜；跨平台弱秩相关提示其不适用于直接生成通用临床耐药排序。

Abstract: We introduce reverse Item Response Theory (IRT) to pharmacogenomic drug-response analysis by treating cancer types as latent "subjects" with resistance ability and drugs as "items" with evasion difficulty. Applied to 242,036 drug sensitivity measurements from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC2) database, the model estimates cancer-type-level in-vitro resistance and drug-level broad activity on a shared latent scale. Validation across four missingness regimes demonstrates that reverse IRT better recovers the full-data latent ranking than simple averaging, with advantages of Delta-rho = +0.089 to +0.095 at 60% missingness under MCAR, cancer-biased, and drug-biased sparsity. Held-out prediction confirms IRT achieves the best Brier score among five evaluated methods. Bootstrap confidence intervals show 19 of 28 cancer types have stable resistant/sensitive classifications. Cross-platform PRISM replication shows 82% directional agreement but weak rank-order correlation (rho = 0.25), indicating the contribution is methodological robustness under fragmented evaluation, not a universal clinical resistance leaderboard.

</details>


### [376] [The Cognitive Continuity Test: Verifying Governed State Transitions in Persistent AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00132)
*Jun He,Deying Yu*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出认知连续性测试（CCT）框架，用于验证持久AI代理的过渡声明，并构建IdentityLineageBench基准进行合成一致性评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久AI代理会修改信念、整合记忆并替换执行基板，但合理发展与不当过渡可能产生相似的后续状态，需要区分合法过渡与违规过渡。

Method: CCT是一种策略相对契约，包含授权范围、来源、确定性应用、语义谓词和候选持久性收据，区分已验证可接受性、肯定违规和未决必需证据；IdentityLineageBench提供24个生成的过渡家族，参考后解析验证器与词汇状态相似度及仅谱系诊断基线进行对比，并加入签名对抗回归测试。

Result: 参考验证器匹配全部576个规范留出标签；词汇状态相似度和仅谱系诊断基线分别接受60.0%和80.0%的无效样本；在18000次有效路径研究中，默认中位执行时间为6.21毫秒。

Conclusion: CCT在合成基准上展示了合规性，但未证明优于策略感知的部署系统；实际模型迁移和SIT行为尚未测量，部署还需额外激活与恢复义务。

Abstract: Persistent AI agents revise beliefs, consolidate memory, and replace execution substrates. Similar successor states can accompany differently authorized transition claims, while legitimate development can change state substantially. We introduce the Cognitive Continuity Test (CCT), a policy-relative contract for verifying submitted transitions using scoped authority, provenance, deterministic application, semantic predicates, and candidate-persistence receipts. CCT distinguishes verified admissibility, affirmative violation, and unresolved required evidence. Separation results concern transition claims rather than live runtime identity; soundness is conditional on the specified checker and evaluator assumptions.
  IdentityLineageBench provides 24 generated transition families. The reference post-resolution verifier matches all 576 canonical held-out labels; lexical state similarity and a lineage-only diagnostic baseline admit 60.0% and 80.0% of invalid fixtures. These comparisons establish synthetic conformance, not superiority to a policy-aware deployed system. Signed adversarial regressions cover fabricated interaction counts, unsupported belief changes, and mixed missing/contradictory evidence. SIT behavior and actual model migration remain unmeasured. An 18,000-execution valid-path study measures a 6.21 ms default median on resident inputs. We specify the additional activation and recovery obligations needed for deployment.

</details>


### [377] [Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00136)
*Parker Hummel,Ryne Skabo,Muhammad Abusaqer*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该论文通过可复现的教育性实验，对比图像分类与文本分类中的逃逸攻击，发现对抗脆弱性强烈依赖模态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究对抗样本在不同数据模态下的表现差异，并强调鲁棒性需通过实证测试而非仅凭干净准确率推断。

Method: 在MNIST上训练紧凑卷积网络，评估FGSM和PGD白盒攻击及位深缩减防御；在SMS Spam Collection上微调DistilBERT，施加预定义扰动（字符替换、空白噪声、良性后缀）。

Result: MNIST干净准确率98.63%，FGSM下ε=0.15和0.30时降至60.20%和1.72%，PGD下降至32.47%和0.41%，防御仅部分恢复；DistilBERT准确率98.75%、F1 94.96%，但扰动仅造成多数样例概率小幅偏移，无垃圾邮件误判。

Conclusion: 对抗脆弱性具有强模态依赖性，图像实验是清晰的逃逸演示，文本实验是受控鲁棒性评估，鲁棒性必须实证检验。

Abstract: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $ε$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $ε$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robustness evaluation. Robustness must be tested empirically rather than inferred from clean accuracy.

</details>


### [378] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出Praxa代理框架，通过显式状态管理使权限到效果的转换可测试，但当前证据未证明生产优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型代理能提出并执行动作，但提议、授权、调度、验证外部效果和服务推广是不同的声明，需要明确区分和可测试的架构。

Method: Praxa通过确定性准入、代理执行、外部读回、对账和审核推广显式表示状态；报告四个证据通道：本地审计、Terminal-Bench试点、开发比较、部署配置证据。

Result: 本地审计通过1027/1027单元测试和89/89 Workerd测试；试点中基线与可靠性层各通过17/36，可靠性层多耗37.49%输入和50.73%输出令牌；开发比较中候选与基线均完成180/180，候选少用37.11%令牌、33.84%成本、11.63%步骤。

Conclusion: Praxa的贡献是证据绑定的架构，使权限到效果的转换显式可测试，但未确立对抗安全、生产安全、通用专家优势、自主递归优化或用户收益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [379] [FourierQK: Filter Shape, Admissibility and the Leakage-Coverage Law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00009)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文通过消融实验系统检验了频域注意力中滤波器形状的五个假设，发现直流与奈奎斯特分量有害，段落尺度带通滤波器最优，双边FFT泄露随频谱覆盖单调增加，并提出双向注意力适用的FourierQK与自回归适用的MorletQK分工。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 频率坍缩注意力以带通滤波内积替代Q/K点积取得显著增益，但滤波器形状的最优选择及其机理尚不明确，需要明确何种频谱特性是增益来源。

Method: 在字符级语言建模（TinyShakespeare，6层GPT）上进行受控消融，检验五个假设：直流抑制、奈奎斯特抑制、带宽、中心频率与多尺度覆盖；比较可容许滤波器（零均值、Mexican Hat DOG m=2）与非可容许高斯滤波器，并分析双边FFT泄露与频谱覆盖的关系，同时评估因果时域Morlet。

Result: 直流与奈奎斯特分量有害（val≈2.0，等价于相位随机化）；最优单尺度带宽σ≈2 bins、中心位于段落尺度（约70 tokens），相对BASE-DOT增益Δ=+1.15 nats；可容许DOG滤波器在同尺度下优于高斯并部分抵抗双边FFT泄露；泄露随频谱覆盖单调增加，窄带（gap>+4）干净、宽带（gap<+2）泄露；因果Morlet在字符尺度无法超越BASE-DOT（K=128 taps仅覆盖T=256上下文的50%）。

Conclusion: FourierQK适用于训练与推理均可获得全序列上下文的双向注意力场景（编码器风格，如BERT）；自回归生成需采用因果频谱变体，如MorletQK（解码器风格，如GPT），字级因果Morlet的局限也由此推动词级实验。

Abstract: Frequency-collapse attention [Zeris, 2026e] achieves large gains over standard dot-product attention by replacing the Q/K dot product with a bandpass-filtered inner product at a learned frequency. A natural follow-up question is: which filter shape works best, and why? We test five hypotheses about filter properties -- DC suppression, Nyquist suppression, bandwidth, centre frequency, and multi-scale coverage -- using a controlled ablation on character-level language modelling (TinyShakespeare, 6-layer GPT). Our main findings are: (1) DC and Nyquist components are actively harmful (val ~= 2.0, equivalent to phase randomisation), confirming that oscillatory bandpass structure is essential, not just any low-dimensional spectral summary; (2) the optimal single-scale bandwidth is sigma ~= 2 bins centred at paragraph scale (~70 tokens), giving a clean gain of Delta = +1.15 nats over BASE-DOT; (3) admissible filters (zero-mean, Mexican Hat DOG m = 2) outperform non-admissible Gaussians at the same scale and provide partial protection against bilateral FFT leakage; (4) bilateral FFT leakage scales monotonically with spectral coverage -- narrowband filters (gap > +4) are clean, wideband filters (gap < +2) are leaky; and (5) causal time-domain Morlet at character scale cannot beat BASE-DOT (K=128 taps covers 50% of T=256 context), motivating word-level experiments in the companion MorletQK paper [Zeris, 2026f]. Together, findings (1)-(5) characterise FourierQK as effective in bidirectional attention settings (encoder-style, e.g. BERT), where full-sequence context is available at both training and inference time; autoregressive generation requires a causal spectral variant such as MorletQK [Zeris, 2026f] (decoder-style, e.g. GPT). Code available at: https://github.com/AthanasiosZeris/energy-gated-attention

</details>


### [380] [Intrusion Detection for Agentic Processes: Evidence-Based Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00151)
*Arslan Brömme*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出一种面向智能体流程本身的证据感知运行时入侵检测系统A-IDS，其概念贡献在于将受治理的动态期望与三值匹配结合，并将监控平面视为攻击面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体部署将语言模型推理与检索、委派、工具执行、外部系统访问、人工审批结合，安全相关偏差可能在整个演化流程中产生，而非局限于孤立的输入或动作。

Method: 基于作者此前的智能体流程黑盒架构与证据-主张模型，A-IDS将证据支持的观察结果与受治理、版本化的期望基线（工作流状态、授权、通信、强制事件）进行比较；概念上结合动态应到期望、可见性与三值匹配分离、显式未解决观察状态、以及将证据状态与操作影响分离的有界发现。

Result: 将该模型识别为监控平面本身构成攻击面：对抗性内容可经由合法观察路径到达语义证据生产者；提示注入既被视为输入安全问题，也被视为后续流程偏差与跨智能体影响路径的可能来源。

Conclusion: A-IDS不从异常行为推断恶意意图，不将未观察事件视为未发生证据，也不声称新异常检测器、时序逻辑或溯源模型；其贡献是概念性的，未验证实现、未展示实证检测性能、未建立因果归因、未提供执行机制。

Abstract: Agent deployments increasingly combine language-model inference with retrieval, delegation, tool execution, external-system access, and human approval. Security-relevant deviations can therefore emerge across an evolving process rather than in one isolated input or action. Building on the author's earlier black-box architecture for agentic processes and the subsequent evidence-claim model, this paper proposes an Agentic-Process Intrusion Detection System (A-IDS), an evidence-aware security interpretation layer for runtime intrusion detection whose monitored object is the agentic process itself. A-IDS compares evidence-supported observations with a governed and versioned expectation baseline for workflow state, authorization, communication, and mandatory events. Its conceptual contribution combines dynamically due governed expectations, visibility separated from three-valued matching, explicit unresolved observation states, and bounded findings that separate evidentiary status from operational impact. The model further identifies the monitoring plane itself as an attack surface when adversarial content reaches semantic evidence producers through otherwise legitimate observation paths. Some observations may be produced outside the operational agent's self-report path, but the model does not assume complete observability or universally trustworthy capture. Prompt injection is treated both as an input-security problem and as a possible origin of later process deviations and cross-agent influence paths. A-IDS does not infer malicious intent from anomalous behavior, does not treat an unobserved event as proof of non-occurrence, and does not claim a new anomaly detector, temporal logic, or provenance model. The contribution is conceptual: it does not validate an implementation, demonstrate empirical detection performance, establish causal attribution, or provide an enforcement mechanism.

</details>


### [381] [Integrating Fairness and Explainability in a Multiple Instance Reinforcement Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00035)
*Bente Hinkenhuis,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本研究提出结合强化学习多示例学习、对抗去偏与偏好条件超网络的多目标框架，用于学生风险预测，但发现超网络扩展出现模式崩溃，偏好标量无法连续控制公平性与性能的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 教育交互数据预测学生表现需兼顾准确性与透明度以支持干预，同时人口统计信息带来不公平预测风险，因此需探索可解释且公平的多目标建模方法。

Method: 采用多目标框架：RL-MIL将每个学生表示为弱标签交互包，RL智能体选择信息性实例用于分类；结合对抗去偏；评估两种超网络变体，检验用户定义偏好标量能否连续控制预测性能与Equalized Odds的权衡。

Result: RL-MIL基线分类性能强，但两种超网络扩展均出现模式崩溃，改变偏好权重几乎不产生沿预期公平-性能前沿的系统性移动。失败与目标支配、条件机制梯度传播弱及动态生成参数间交互有关。

Conclusion: 公平目标可纳入可解释RL-MIL流程，但仅靠偏好条件无法保证可控多目标行为；稳健的公平RL-MIL需显式梯度平衡、目标分离与稳定性分析机制。

Abstract: Predicting student performance from educational interaction data requires models that are both accurate and sufficiently transparent to support meaningful intervention, while demographic information introduces an additional risk of unfair predictions. This study investigates a multi-objective framework that combines reinforcement learning-based multiple instance learning (RL-MIL), adversarial debiasing, and preference-conditioned hypernetworks for student-at-risk prediction. MIL represents each student as a bag of weakly labeled interactions, while an RL agent selects informative instances for downstream classification. Two hypernetwork variants are evaluated to determine whether a user-defined preference scalar can continuously control the trade-off between predictive performance and Equalized Odds. The underlying RL-MIL baseline achieves strong classification performance, but both hypernetwork extensions exhibit mode collapse: changing the preference weight produces little systematic movement along the intended fairness-performance frontier. The failure is associated with objective dominance, weak gradient propagation through the conditioning mechanism, and interactions between dynamically generated parameters. The results show that fairness objectives can be incorporated into an interpretable RL-MIL pipeline, but preference conditioning alone does not guarantee controllable multi-objective behavior. Robust fair RL-MIL therefore requires explicit mechanisms for gradient balancing, objective separation, and stability analysis.

</details>


### [382] [Tokenized Key-Gated Adapter Routing: A Secure Access Control Mechanism Against Private Data Leakage in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00309)
*Mohamed Shaaban,Mohamed Elmahallawy*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出Locket框架，通过LoRA适配器与键控入口令牌实现LLM生成阶段的细粒度策略访问控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在隐私敏感领域易记忆和泄露PII，现有防御难以兼顾模型效用、隐私保护与私有知识访问。

Method: 训练多个轻量LoRA适配器分别编码不同访问策略，并用门控模块将键控入口令牌序列级硬路由到唯一适配器；有效令牌解锁私有知识，无效或缺失令牌触发隐私保护适配器进行脱敏或净化。

Result: 在Enron、ECHR、Yelp及Qwen3、Llama-3.2、Gemma-2-2B上评估，正确令牌时困惑度与原始数据微调相当；令牌缺失或无效时显著降低PII泄露，效用和困惑度与强基线防御相当。

Conclusion: Locket兼容现成LLM，可扩展部署，在满足监管与隐私要求的同时实现策略驱动的访问控制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in privacy-critical domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, and government), but their propensity to memorize and disclose personally identifiable information (PII) poses serious security and compliance risks. Existing defenses typically force a trade-off between model utility, privacy protection, and access to fine-tuned private knowledge. We propose LoRA-Oriented Control via Keyed Entry Tokens (Locket), a practical framework that embeds fine-grained, policy-driven access control directly into LLM generation. Locket trains a set of lightweight LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters, each encoding a distinct access policy (e.g., full reveal, partial redaction via PII masking, or reveal under a specified differential privacy level). A compact gating module is trained to associate a learned keyed entry token with exactly one LoRA adapter via sequence-level hard routing; the presence of a valid token acts as an authorization key that unlocks corresponding private knowledge, while an invalid or absent token triggers a privacy-preserving adapter that redacts or sanitizes sensitive content. This design ensures Locket remains fully compatible with off-the-shelf LLMs, supporting scalable deployment while satisfying regulatory and privacy requirements. We evaluate Locket across multiple datasets (Enron, ECHR, Yelp) and a diverse set of state-of-the-art LLMs, including Qwen3 (1.7B and 8B), Meta's Llama-3.2 (1B and 3B), and Google's Gemma-2-2B. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that, when the correct token is provided, Locket preserves perplexity comparable to fine-tuning on raw data (without any defense). Conversely, when the token is missing or invalid, it substantially reduces PII leakage while maintaining utility and perplexity on par with strong baseline defenses.

</details>


### [383] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文构建了4个微任务基准并预定义阈值，检验现成小语言模型（SLM）在LLM规划器周边微任务中是否达到可用阈值，以及量化是否改变结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体框架希望用SLM承担前沿LLM规划器周边的微任务（如自动批准shell命令、写记忆、选工具、排序历史轮次），但缺乏对现成SLM是否满足实践者设定阈值的系统评估，也不清楚失败原因及量化影响。

Method: 构建含4个微任务、固定提示与自动指标的基准，每个任务预设阈值τ（锚定廉价非LLM基线）并采用CI感知的合格规则（置信下界超过τ才合格）。在最佳设置（FP16、贪心、单一冻结提示、不调参）下扫描Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B，检查原始输出与解析行为；用logprob决策阈值诊断（T1/T3/T4，T2用上下文长度/级联探针）区分能力缺陷与阈值可调失败（4种情形）；再测试4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）影响。

Result: 16个配置（4任务×4模型）全部不合格；失败可分离为能力缺陷与可通过改变解码阈值解决的失败，共4种情形。4-bit量化损伤随模型规模变化，但无配置进入合格（T1/T3可重构硬标签认证，T2/T4用诊断/窗口稳健性），差距更多跟踪模型规模而非精度。结论在Llama-3.x上复现（12/12不合格），对锚点选择（τ扫描）和提示措辞（原版加3个中性改写共0/112合格）稳健。

Conclusion: 实践建议是将SLM置于满足CI-backed阈值的基线之后，仅在基线不达标处使用SLM；例如4B重排器在BM25短名单上优于BM25（+0.047 [0.020, 0.073]），但自身未认证合格。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [384] [Actions with Receipts: Jointly Binding Claims, Evidence, and Execution for Replayable Tool-Agent Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00327)
*Miaobo Hu,Shuhao Hu,Xiaobo Guo,Xin Wang,Bokun Wang,Yina Sa,Daren Zha,Jun Xiao*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出一种以声明为锚定的执行契约，将声明、源片段、有序执行前缀和源版本/访问状态联合绑定，并通过确定性完整性验证器检测跨对象替换攻击，同时分离完整性平面与可插拔支持平面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用智能体虽可展示引用和执行日志，但缺乏对“展示给用户的声明是否由已提交执行产生并受引用源支持”这一关键关联的审计，导致有效引用和有效追踪可被单独伪造并跨声明、动作、运行或源版本移植。

Method: 设计声明锚定执行契约：每条回执包含发射锚点以确定性定位已提交答案或声明承载动作中的声明，并包含源标识、偏移、哈希、引文和域分离执行承诺；确定性完整性验证器在接入语义或任务标签前重建绑定；将完整性平面与可插拔支持平面分离，避免以结构有效性替代蕴含判断。

Result: 在1,280次跨对象攻击中，联合契约检测出1,275次替换（0.9961）；移除任一目标属性后，其攻击检测率降至0.0156-0.0625；在独立裁决的384对拆分上，冲突感知支持守卫F1为0.8865、误接受率为0.0729；在未见失败族上，分别为0.8679和0.0938。

Conclusion: 该契约可独立测试七项属性（声明-发射绑定、源绑定、有序执行绑定、预言分离、持久对象重放、执行重跑一致性、版本/访问绑定），有效检测跨对象替换，且完整性验证与语义支持评估分离，为工具使用智能体提供可审计的声明锚定执行保障。

Abstract: Tool-using agents can expose citations and execution logs while leaving a critical association unaudited: whether the claim shown to a user is the claim emitted by the committed execution and supported by the cited source. A valid citation and a valid trace can therefore remain individually well formed while being transplanted across claims, actions, runs, or source versions. We introduce a claim-anchored execution contract that jointly binds the emitted claim, its exact source span, the ordered execution prefix that produced it, and the source version and access state observed by that execution. Each receipt contains an emission anchor that deterministically locates the claim inside a committed answer or claim-bearing action, together with source identifiers, offsets, hashes, quotes, and a domain-separated execution commitment. A deterministic integrity verifier reconstructs these bindings before semantic or task labels are joined. We separate this integrity plane from a pluggable support plane, so structural validity is not used as a proxy for entailment. The contract exposes seven independently testable properties: claim-emission binding, source binding, ordered-execution binding, oracle separation, persisted-object replay, execution-rerun consistency, and version/access binding. Across 1,280 cross-object attacks, the joint contract detects 1,275 substitutions (0.9961). Removing a targeted property reduces its attack-detection rate to 0.0156-0.0625. On an independently adjudicated 384-pair split, the conflict-aware support guard reaches F1 0.8865 and false acceptance 0.0729; on unseen failure families, these rates are 0.8679 and 0.0938.

</details>


### [385] [UnifiedAttack: Evaluating the Safety of Large Multimodal Models in Synergistic Harmful Image-Text Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00341)
*Bingjun Luo,Jialin Guo,Tony Wang,Siqi Li*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出UnifiedAttack基准评估大统一多模态模型在协同有害图文生成中的安全风险，并设计协同劫持框架验证漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大统一多模态模型发展，文本与图像协同生成有害内容的风险远超单模态威胁，现有安全评估缺乏对跨模态协同危害增益的针对性测试。

Method: 构建UnifiedAttack基准，包含经多模态潜力筛选的样本和合成的虚假信息查询子集；提出协同劫持框架，含上下文换壳（ICR）利用少样本学习将对抗意图包装为良性虚拟外壳以绕过安全过滤，以及认知规划注入（CPI）通过强制“先规划后执行”范式劫持推理路径，利用模型对一致性的内在追求诱导同步生成有害多模态内容。

Result: 在最新架构上的广泛评估表明，UnifiedAttack能持续绕过现代对齐机制，成功利用模型的结构化有用性和逻辑连贯性生成有害内容。

Conclusion: 统一模型的结构化有用性与逻辑连贯性可被系统性地武器化，亟需针对协同生成任务开发逻辑感知的防御方法。

Abstract: As Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) transition toward natively unified architectures, evaluating their safety in synergistic harmful image-text generation tasks becomes a critical challenge. Unlike unimodal threats, synergistic risks emerge when text and image modalities are coordinated to produce harm that significantly exceeds their individual components. We introduce UnifiedAttack, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LMM safety in collaborative scenarios by focusing on the harmfulness gain achieved through cross-modal synergy. The benchmark incorporates samples filtered for their multimodal potential alongside a novel subset of synthesized disinformation queries. To verify identified vulnerabilities, we propose a synergistic hijacking framework featuring In-Context Reskinning (ICR) and Cognitive Planning Injection (CPI). ICR utilizes few-shot learning to wrap adversarial intent in benign virtual shells to desensitize safety filters, while CPI hijacks the reasoning path by enforcing a plan-then-execute paradigm. By compelling the system to commit to a neutral logical plan, we exploit its internal drive for consistency to induce the synchronized generation of harmful multimodal content. Extensive evaluations on state-of-the-art architectures demonstrate that UnifiedAttack consistently bypasses modern alignment. Our findings reveal that the structural helpfulness and logical coherence of unified models can be systematically weaponized, highlighting the urgent need for logic-aware defenses in synergistic generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/UnifiedAttack .

</details>


### [386] [Removing the NEEDLE in the Haystack: Backdoor Removal in LLMs via Weight Orthogonalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00348)
*Minoo Kim,Vasileios Lampos,George Drayson*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出免训练的后门定向移除方法NEEDLE，通过估计后门方向与拒绝子空间并做权重正交化，在抑制后门的同时保持拒绝相关表示不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM后门防御在移除后门时会把模型对良性提示的输出分布发生偏移，导致性能与安全性下降，且通常需要干净参考模型或原始中毒训练数据。

Method: 识别触发器后，利用激活向量估计后门方向与拒绝子空间，再施加顺序权重正交化，以压制后门并避免改变拒绝相关表示；无需干净参考模型与原始中毒训练数据。

Result: 在多个模型家族和攻击类型上评估，NEEDLE取得所评估防御中最低的平均攻击成功率，在困难的代码注入攻击上达0% ASR，同时KL散度最低，能力与安全性变化最小。

Conclusion: NEEDLE是一种有效的免训练定向后门移除方法，能在不牺牲模型能力与安全性的前提下显著降低后门攻击成功率。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks can be implanted in Large Language Models (LLMs) during training, causing unwanted behaviour when a trigger appears in the input. Existing backdoor defences for LLMs attempt to remove the backdoor but inadvertently shift the model's output distribution to benign prompts, which can result in degraded model performance and safety. We propose NEEDLE, a training-free method for targeted backdoor removal. Once a trigger has been identified, our method estimates a backdoor direction and a refusal subspace through activation vectors, then applies sequential weight orthogonalisation to suppress the backdoor while preventing changes in refusal-related representations. NEEDLE requires neither a clean reference model nor the original poisoned training data. Evaluation is conducted across multiple model families and attack types. NEEDLE achieves the lowest mean Attack Success Rate (ASR) among the evaluated defences, including 0% on challenging code injection attacks, while resulting in the lowest KL divergence and minimal changes in capability and safety.

</details>


### [387] [Nous: Learning and Certifying Memory Decisions Before Source Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00094)
*Pranav Singh*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 该论文研究基于信念的智能体记忆在证据噪声、复制或过时的情况下，学习与认证决策改进是否必须先校准来源；结论是学习并认证有用决策可能比校准来源所需样本量少平方级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆系统需可靠决策，但证据可能不可靠，且来源校准成本高昂；作者希望区分学习、校准与修订认证，探究能否在不恢复来源可靠性的前提下改进并证明决策。

Method: 在四模型隐马尔可夫族上分析样本复杂度；在未知身份加背景报告信道下刻画策略改进的尖锐可识别区间，用可观测见证区域构造有限样本证书；扩展至有界历史依赖误设与条件复制，并采用分裂训练见证；结合策略边界收据与Nous Dimensions，在45,000条保留可变状态历史及三个外部MiniGrid记忆环境（含9,000回合）中测试。

Result: 学习未知贝叶斯决策需Θ(l^-2)条记录，认证其相对信息先验的改进需O(l^-2)条新记录，而固定精度来源估计需Θ(l^-4)；新证书在MiniGrid中接受9/9相对常数先验的改进和4/9相对最后写入胜出的改进，早期证书则无；强推理基线仍具竞争力或更优。

Conclusion: 该结果为记忆决策何时可学习并证明提供了统计解释，表明无需恢复来源可靠性即可认证改进，但并非普遍更优的记忆算法。

Abstract: Belief-based agent memory needs reliable decisions about current state, yet its evidence may be noisy, copied, or stale. Must a memory calibrate its sources before it can improve its decisions? We separate learning, calibration, and revision certification. On one four-model hidden Markov family, learning an unknown Bayes decision requires Theta(l^-2) records and certifying its improvement over an informative incumbent takes O(l^-2) fresh records from the same observation law, while fixed-precision source estimation requires Theta(l^-4) as persistence l vanishes. Thus learning and certifying useful decisions can require quadratically fewer records than source calibration. A broader model class retains the decision rate and source lower bound. Under an unknown identity-plus-background report channel, we characterize the sharp identified interval for policy improvement and derive a finite-sample certificate using observable witness regions, without pure-class anchors. A robustness extension tolerates bounded history-dependent misspecification and conditional copying; split-trained witnesses apply to arbitrary history spaces with explicit power conditions. We integrate policy-bound receipts with Nous Dimensions and test 45,000 held-out mutable-state histories and 9,000 episodes in three external MiniGrid memory environments with an introduced noisy-report interface. The new certificate accepts 9/9 improvements over a constant incumbent and 4/9 over last-write-wins, versus none for the earlier certificate in MiniGrid. Strong established inference baselines remain competitive or better. The result is a statistical account of when memory decisions can be learned and justified without recovering source reliability, not a universally superior memory algorithm.

</details>


### [388] [Proof-Gated Signing: Solver-Checked Transaction Guards that Hold Under State Drift for Onchain AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00354)
*Bravish Ghosh*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出Proof-Gated Signing（PGS），通过SMT策略证明与链上后置条件原子执行，抵御交易执行状态漂移导致的恶意交易。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI钱包代理可读取攻击者可达内容，可能被诱导提出有害交易；现有签名前检查（静态许可名单、LLM评审或交易模拟）均只描述检查时链状态，而交易在稍后状态执行，攻击者可通过抢跑、合约升级或代币参数变化塑造该状态，即状态漂移。

Method: PGS先模拟拟议交易、提取效果，在预言机不确定性区间内对每个价格用SMT求解器检查声明式价值与权限策略；随后编译链上后置条件（钱包余额边界、收款方到账、授权额度上限和所有权），并证明满足这些后置条件的每次执行也满足策略；由代理的智能合约钱包原子化强制执行。

Result: 在260个场景的开放测试床上（14类攻击，含5类漂移与2类自适应，12类良性；危害按攻击者余额而非策略衡量），PGS阻止了140个有害场景中的93.6%，通过97.5%的良性场景；仅模拟检查为57.9%，静态许可名单为71.4%；50个漂移场景下PGS均无攻击者收益；唯一未阻止的策略内抽水受每会话预算限制；还发现给LLM评审器干净漂移前模拟会增加其批准漂移攻击的概率；每次检查开销约41k gas、0.1-0.2秒。

Conclusion: PGS通过策略证明与原子链上后置条件，在任意状态漂移下为已执行交易提供保证，显著优于模拟和静态许可名单，且开销可接受。

Abstract: AI agents that control wallets read attacker-reachable content, so they can be steered into proposing harmful transactions. The usual last line of defense is a pre-signing check: a static allowlist, an LLM reviewer, or a transaction simulation. All three share a gap: the check describes the chain state at check time, but the transaction executes in a later state that an adversary can shape through front-running, contract upgrades or token-parameter changes. We call this state drift. We present Proof-Gated Signing (PGS), which simulates a proposed transaction, extracts its effects, and uses an SMT solver to check a declarative value-and-permission policy for every price in an oracle-uncertainty band. It then compiles on-chain post-conditions (wallet balance bounds, payee receipts, allowance caps and ownership) and proves that every execution satisfying them also satisfies the policy. The agent's smart-contract wallet enforces them atomically, so the guarantee applies to the executed transaction under arbitrary drift. On an open testbed of 260 scenarios (14 attack families including five drift and two adaptive families, and 12 benign families), with harm measured from attacker balances rather than from any policy, PGS prevented 93.6% of the 140 harmful scenarios and passed 97.5% of the benign ones. Simulation-only checking prevented 57.9% and a static allowlist 71.4%. None of the 50 drift scenarios produced attacker gain under PGS. The only unprevented family, an in-policy drain, was bounded by the per-session budget. We also find that giving an LLM reviewer a clean pre-drift simulation made it more likely to approve a drift attack. Overhead is about 41k gas and 0.1-0.2 s per check.

</details>


### [389] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 研究对话幽默训练中自动奖励的漏洞利用与对策，发现基于惊喜的奖励易受词序打乱欺骗，受众笑声预测奖励易受笑声线索攻击，对策虽能拦截部分攻击但会误伤或仍存漏洞，最终训练效果未达预期目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为语言模型在对话幽默场景中设计自动奖励时，存在奖励被“钻空子”的风险，需要探究这些漏洞并寻找对策，以平衡防作弊与保留目标行为。

Method: 采用两种奖励方法：基于嵌入的惊喜奖励和基于受众模型预测笑声的奖励；通过受控测试检验漏洞，并设计对策（流畅性过滤器、跨说话人笑声线索归一化）；进行三次强化学习训练，逐步修订奖励。

Result: 嵌入惊喜奖励可被词序打乱的回复欺骗，流畅性过滤器能检测但会误拒部分机智回复；受众模型易受双方笑声线索影响，归一化可阻断已知攻击但未匹配表情仍可被利用；最终训练将综合评分提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默专项提升未达预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动奖励设计面临普遍挑战：对策必须封堵可利用的捷径，同时保留奖励原本要鼓励的行为，二者难以兼顾。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [390] [On the Relationship between Model Quantization and Model Inversion Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00382)
*Rongke Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 本文研究模型量化对模型逆向攻击的影响，并提出一种隐私感知的训练后量化方法，以在保持模型效用的同时提升抗逆向能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型量化降低存储和计算成本，但可能改变模型逆向攻击的效果；量化如何影响逆向攻击以及数据特征如何调节这一关系尚不明确。

Method: 通过量化引起的输入与预测概率类别变量间互信息变化界定信息效应与优化障碍；识别数据相关的特征分布和逆向结果变化；提出隐私感知训练后量化，包括Fisher型任务敏感度代理的预算感知比特分配、激活范围校准、联合优化权重/激活缩放与舍入决策，以及任务恢复和几何保持目标与正则化。

Result: 在ResNet-50、Palm数据集4比特量化下，RL-MIA严格成功率从54%降至26%，准确率从99.01%降至96.55%（相对FP32）；在Iris数据集4.5比特下加入SSD（epsilon=0.1），BREP-MI严格成功率从63.33%降至37.33%，准确率从92.8%降至87.6%（相对仅量化）。

Conclusion: 量化对逆向攻击的影响具有数据依赖性和比特敏感性，所提方法能有效提升抗逆向能力并恢复效用，同时支持输出级防御。

Abstract: Model quantization reduces the numerical precision of neural network weights and activations to lower storage and computational costs. Model inversion attacks recover or reconstruct sensitive training data or inference inputs from model outputs or intermediate features, so quantization may also alter their effectiveness. However, two questions remain unresolved: How does model quantization affect model inversion? How do data characteristics influence this relationship? To address the first, we bound quantization-induced changes in mutual information between inputs and a categorical variable defined by prediction probabilities, distinguishing informational effects from attack optimization obstacles. To address the second, we identify data-dependent changes in feature distributions and inversion outcomes, with pronounced quantization sensitivity differences at 4 bits. These insights guide a privacy-aware post-training quantization method that improves inversion resistance while recovering utility. It uses a Fisher-type task-sensitivity proxy for budget-aware bit allocation, calibrates activation ranges, and jointly optimizes weight and activation scales and weight-rounding decisions with task-recovery and geometry-retention objectives and scale and rounding regularization. Experiments cover multiple metrics, neural network architectures, and face, palmprint, and iris recognition tasks. On ResNet-50, Palm at 4 bits reduces RL-MIA's strict success from 54% to 26%, while accuracy decreases from 99.01% to 96.55% relative to FP32. Our method also supports output-level defenses: adding Stealthy Shield Defense (SSD, epsilon = 0.1) to Iris at 4.5 bits reduces BREP-MI's strict success from 63.33% to 37.33%, while accuracy decreases from 92.8% to 87.6% relative to quantization alone.

</details>


### [391] [From A2A Attacks to Envelope-Layer Defense: Red-Teaming Evaluation of LLM Agents and a Three-Layer Isomorphic Attack-Defense Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00392)
*Yuelin Han*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出A2A-TIBA攻击原理与GDA Measurement评估方法，将ASR细化为四类结局，并建立ELA-ITL多层攻防模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体安全评估仅依赖单一攻击成功率（ASR），无法区分攻击失败是因LLM识别恶意内容还是智能体层机制拦截执行。

Method: A2A-TIBA通过植入-命令-外泄步骤诱导目标智能体部署回调交互程序，绕过智能体直接下发命令；GDA Measurement采用LLM网关原始上下文捕获、双数据保存与智能体自主评判；定义Class A/B/C/D四种结局，将ASR扩展为语义拒绝率、语义突破率、拦截率与穿透率；提出ELA-ITL三层同构攻防模型。

Result: 在15种智能体前端×LLM后端组合上测试并构建1000例数据集，验证了A2A-TIBA的攻击有效性与GDA Measurement的评估有效性，并确认在A2A、工具、记忆等信封通道中添加恶意提示标签能显著提升LLM对恶意内容的识别。

Conclusion: 信封层作为恶意内容进入智能体的通道是新的防御维度；ELA-ITL模型将防御分为信封封装、LLM识别与智能体拦截，攻击分为植入通道、提示优化与执行机制，为多智能体协作安全提供细粒度评估与防御框架。

Abstract: Agent interaction protocols such as ACP and A2A have moved LLM-based agents toward multi-agent collaboration, introducing new security threats. A task sent by a remote peer over A2A is treated as a legitimate request, providing a natural channel for indirect prompt injection. Existing agent security evaluations mostly rely on a single metric, the attack success rate (ASR), and cannot distinguish whether an attack failed because the LLM recognized the malicious content or because a mechanism at the agent layer blocked execution. To address this, we propose A2A-TIBA, an attack principle combining indirect prompt injection with bypass circumvention. Through implant-command-exfiltration steps, it induces the target agent to deploy a callback interaction program, after which the attacker issues commands bypassing the agent. To evaluate defenses finer, we design GDA Measurement, a red-team testbed method using raw context capture via an LLM gateway, dual data preservation, and agent-based autonomous judging. We propose four attack outcomes, Class A/B/C/D, extending ASR into semantic refusal rate, semantic breach rate, interception rate, and penetration rate. Experiments reveal the envelope layer -- the channel through which malicious content enters an agent -- as a new defense dimension. We accordingly propose ELA-ITL, a three-layer isomorphic attack-defense model, dividing defense into envelope packaging, LLM recognition, and agent interception, and attack into implant channel, prompt optimization, and execution mechanism. Testing on 15 agent front-end x LLM back-end combinations and building a 1,000-case dataset verifies the attack effectiveness of A2A-TIBA, the evaluation validity of GDA Measurement, and confirms that adding malicious prompt labels to envelope packaging such as A2A, tool, and memory channels significantly improves LLM recognition of malicious content.

</details>


### [392] [ZoneClaw: Mitigating Persistent Memory Attacks by Establishing Memory-Zoning in OpenClaw-Style Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00450)
*Haokai Ma,Chieh Lin,Yupeng Qiu,Ee-Chien Chang*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 提出持久记忆攻击并设计ZoneClaw，通过分层信任区将记忆持久性与行动权威分离，大幅降低攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CUA将外部内容与用户指令以同等权限持久存储于工作区记忆，导致记忆中的声明获得指导后续行为的权威，形成跨环境的持久记忆攻击。

Method: ZoneClaw用带显式权威等级的分层信任区替代扁平工作区记忆；外部声明仅存于低信任区，需跨越显式权威边界并经攻击者无法直接写入的区域交叉校验才能获得行动指导权；采用非对称权限的特定角色进程强制执行边界，确保无进程同时摄取外部内容并对外行动。

Result: 在四种攻击场景、两种注入设置和四个主干模型上，ASR从372/480降至6/480，同时在458/480次试验中保持实用性，并对部分防御感知攻击者仍有效。

Conclusion: 攻击者声明仍持久存于低信任记忆但极少跨越权威边界，表明ZoneClaw是保留权威而非拒绝对环境学习。

Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly operate as long-running assistants through persistent workspace memory, which OpenClaw-style CUAs realize as automatically reloaded files that hold user instructions, system summaries, and external claims at the same privilege level. Here, remembering a claim confers authority over later behavior. This enables a persistent memory attack, in which an attacker who controls only benign-looking external content induces the CUA to record attacker-favored claims during a legitimate task, and those claims later govern benign tasks the attacker never touches. The attack chain extends "malicious context -> malicious response" into "malicious context -> memory injection -> malicious execution", making this a cross-environment threat. Existing defenses studied intervene either before content enters memory or at the action it later induces, not whether stored content may guide action. We propose ZoneClaw, which separates persistence from authority by replacing flat workspace memory with hierarchical trust zones carrying explicit authority levels. External claims persist in a low-trust zone and acquire action-guiding authority only by crossing an explicit authority boundary, at which promotion is cross-checked against zones the attacker cannot directly write. Role-specific processes of asymmetric privilege enforce this boundary, ensuring that no process both ingests external content and acts outward. Across four attack scenarios, two injection settings, and four backbones, ZoneClaw drives ASR from 372/480 to 6/480 while retaining utility in 458/480 trials, and remains effective against some defense-aware attackers. Attacker claims still persist in low-trust memory yet rarely cross the authority boundary, showing that ZoneClaw withholds authority rather than refusing to learn from the environment. Our code is available at: https://github.com/euph00/ZoneClaw-code.

</details>


### [393] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: Sec

TL;DR: 在受限信号传递博弈中引入具有说服预算的对手，发现对抗鲁棒最优信号与显著性极点高度重合，且这种重合导致无法经验性区分模型是朝鲁棒最优还是朝显著性移动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在存在知情对手的受限信号传递中，什么样的信号能最好地保护真相，并检验对抗鲁棒最优与既有显著性启发式之间的关系。

Method: 在强制选择任务（抽象自《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》）中引入知晓目标、观察信号并利用说服预算β为错误答案辩护的对手；比较不同β下最优信号从后验最大化向边际最大化偏移的情况，并测试两种对手设定对七个语言模型选择的影响。

Result: 在108个确认性项目上，对抗鲁棒最优与显著性极点完全一致；在20万项目池中仅2748项不同，且差异恰好位于显著性-贝叶斯坐标未定义处。β=0时复现原始预言机模型（听众温度τ=1）。18.2%的项目在有限预算下最优信号发生偏移，每项临界预算精确。两种对手设定使七个语言模型在108项中的30至77项改变选择，但无法判断移动方向。

Conclusion: 对抗鲁棒目标与启发式目标在评估项目上重合是一个结构性限制，而非零结果；在评估对抗意识前，应廉价地检查鲁棒目标是否与启发式目标重合。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$.
